jobs.description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Software Engineering Intern to join a team that builds infrastructure and agentic AI services for teams across the company. Our job is to remove other teams' bottlenecks: we build and run core internal services that power large geo-distributed infrastructure, and a growing share of what we ship is driven by AI agents. As an intern, you will work alongside senior engineers to design, build, and ship production systems – from backend services that run automated workflows at massive scale to AI agents that take routine work off engineers' plates. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience with agentic AI and modern infrastructure while contributing to real products used by teams across NVIDIA.


What you'll be doing:

  • Work with senior engineers to design, build, and improve backend services and APIs for internal platforms that run automated workflows at massive scale
  • Build AI agents and agentic workflows that connect LLMs to tools and internal services, and integrate them into production systems
  • Help make agents reliable and safe in production – from access control and guardrails to evaluating agent quality
  • Assist in building data pipelines and GPU job orchestration for synthetic data generation and model evaluation at scale
  • Implement and improve observability (tracing, metrics, logging) for distributed services and agents
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging, and apply software engineering best practices in a production environment
  • Work in a product-minded way: talk to internal users, prototype quickly, collect feedback, and iterate

What we need to see:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • Strong programming fundamentals in at least one of: Go (preferred), Python, or C#
  • Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms
    Basic knowledge of software design patterns and API design concepts
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs – for example, a project, prototype, or coursework that uses LLM APIs
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git)
  • Understanding of database concepts and SQL
  • Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn new technologies
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience building AI agents or LLM-powered applications: tool/function calling, MCP, RAG, or agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit)
  • Experience with distributed systems concepts (REST APIs, microservices architecture) and containerization (Docker)
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), GPU workloads, and infrastructure automation
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes)
  • Experience with database technologies (MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch)

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the most desirable employers in the world. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If you are creative, autonomous and love a challenge, we want to hear from you. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. jobs.title: AI Delivery Manager
jobs.excerpt: The bright side of mortgages nesto is Canada's leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go – with total transparency and no haggling.
jobs.description:
The bright side of mortgages

nesto is Canada's leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go – with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands – CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud – our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services.

Work Location and Language Requirements

This role is open to candidates in Quebec and Ontario. It's primarily remote, with the option to work from any of our offices across both provinces. French is a strong asset, as we have partners across Canada.

Why We Are Hiring

We enable our partners to improve and streamline their mortgage lending operations through the Nesto Mortgage Cloud. As the most advanced cloud-based mortgage technology in Canada, our SaaS solution offers a world-class omnichannel experience that consistently boosts volume, increases productivity, and reduces technology costs.

Maestro, our AI-powered underwriting platform, already runs inside nesto, with AI agents making real-time, policy-based decisions, and we are now bringing it to financial institution clients through Nesto Cloud. To drive the execution of our upcoming projects, we are looking for an AI Delivery Manager for Maestro specifically, who will focus on functional mastery and SaaS delivery.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Implementation across the condition families. You support every agent in the workstream from start to finish: scoping, process mapping, golden-set (reference dataset) labeling queues, config logs, tuning, and shadow divergence queues (cases where agent output differs from underwriter decisions).
  • The client underwriter pod. You lead the client’s underwriter pod as an extended part of your team. First comes a calibration exercise: both pods label the same 50 documents, you measure disagreement, and you write the adjudication rules. Then production labeling begins, and you manage throughput.
  • Adjudication. You close every ambiguous label or policy question within SLA. You triage rigorously so only true policy calls reach the UW Expert.
  • Process mapping and value baselines. You co-own the signed process blueprints and the value baselines (touches, cycle time, rework). All results are measured against them.
  • The playbook. You document the patterns from the first workstream and build the repeatable playbook for future implementations.
  • Program artifacts and dependencies. You co-own the RAID and decision logs with the Project Manager. You run the bi-weekly platform-program dependency sync (live client data, environments, release schedules) and escalate risks early.

What You Bring

  • Relevant Experience: 3–5 years as an Implementation Manager, Functional Consultant, Solutions-Oriented Analyst, or a similar role focused on technology implementation or operational transformation.
  • System Mastery: You learn complex software platforms quickly and turn that knowledge into practical solutions for the client’s operations.
  • Client-facing Experience: You run client workshops and manage client teams with confidence.
  • Technical comfort: You don’t need to code. You do speak the language of Technical Product Managers and can lead in-depth discussions on system logic.
  • Ownership: You’ve led client implementations as the primary person responsible for the functional outcome, and you’ve owned deliveries end to end.
  • Influence: You guide executive client decisions and push product improvements back to our team.

Nice-to-Have

  • Knowledge of the lending lifecycle or the mortgage industry.
  • Experience with AI or automation rollouts in operations (labeling, QA sampling, exception handling).
  • Fluency in French and English.

You Shouldn’t Apply If

  • You are not interested in a role that involves frequent client-facing work or extensive communication with numerous internal and external stakeholders.
  • You prefer working with legacy or simple systems.
  • You have no passion for the fintech or mortgage technology space and are unwilling to develop domain expertise.

Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screen (30 min): A quick intro call to learn about your background and give you a real picture of the role.
  • Discovery Call (30 min): A conversation with the hiring manager to dig into your experience and assess mutual fit.
  • Case Study: A chance to showcase your skills through an open-ended, scenario-based exercise relevant to the role.
  • Case Study Interview (60 min): A deep dive into your submission, with time to get to know some team members and ask about the role and company.
  • Final Non-Technical Interview (60 min): You'll meet with the recruiter and two additional stakeholders for a final conversation before a decision is made.
  • Offer Stage: Pending successful background and role-specific vetting checks, you'll receive a formal offer to join the team.

Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

  • Competitive Rewards – Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.
  • Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.
  • Time to Recharge – Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.
  • Planning for the Future – RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.
  • Family Support – Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.
  • Learning & Growth – Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.
  • Tools for Success – Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, we are committed to working with you to meet your needs.

jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

Our Abbott story is one of delivering bold solutions in the face of complex healthcare challenges. At Abbott Electrophysiology (EP), we’ve been a leader for over 20 years, pioneering one of the first mapping systems, introducing the first contact force ablation catheter and creating a portfolio of products trusted in millions of procedures around the world. We have and will continue to redefine what’s possible in an evolving and challenging EP landscape.

When you join Abbott EP, you become part of a passionate group of individuals who are dedicated to driving the EP space forward and helping people live longer, fuller lives. We are committed to building a foundation for our people to be successful, investing in their development and growth, and creating a diverse, inclusive culture that welcomes different perspectives, experiences and backgrounds.

What You’ll Work On

Working under general direction, provides engineering, sales, educational and technical support in response to field inquiries from physicians, health care professionals, patients, and field sales staff, involving EP products. Performs work that involves a high degree of independence. Identifies and routinely uses the most effective, cost efficient and best business practices to execute processes; continually evaluates their effectiveness and appropriateness. Exercises independent judgment in planning, organizing and performing work; monitors performance and reports status to manager.

As a Clinical Associate on the U.S. Abbott EP team, you will provide clinical and technical support in a hospital setting, utilizing EP technology in the treatment of various cardiac arrhythmias. You will join a high-functioning, collaborative team, partnering closely with physicians and hospital staff to support the diagnosis and treatment of abnormal heart rhythms to achieve better patient outcomes. In this role, individuals will exercise independent judgment in planning, organizing, and performing day-to-day tasks. You will identify and routinely use the most effective, cost-efficient, and best business practices to execute processes, regularly communicating insights, feedback, and results to managers and team. Additional responsibilities include:

  • Gaining foundational knowledge of EP through a structured training program with a strong emphasis on hands-on learning and practical application.
  • Providing regional EP procedural case coverage in an Electrophysiology lab and/or operating room setting.
  • Acting as a clinical interface between the medical community and the business.
  • Demonstrating the ability to build and sustain credible clinical relationships with customers and sharing product expertise accordingly.
  • Demonstrating a thorough command of all EP products, including technical details, software utilization, and capabilities.
  • Providing engineering, sales, education, and clinical support on the safe and effective use of Abbott EP products, including cardiac mapping, diagnostic, and therapy systems.
  • Supporting EP Sales Representatives in the following areas:
    • Collaborating with sales personnel;
    • Facilitating regional training seminars;
    • Participating in clinical studies/data collection;
    • Troubleshooting; and,
    • Leading/supporting new product in-service trainings and/or demonstrations to physicians, nurses, and sales representatives.
    • Continuously develops engineering, sales and technical skills aligned with the overall territory strategy, including learning from senior sales personnel and management.
  • Staying up-to-date on the latest industry developments, regulatory requirements, and maintains strong knowledge of company and competitor products, market trends, and strategic goals.
  • Providing management with feedback on market trends and customer insights to inform strategic decisions and guide next-generation product development.
  • Participating in occasional travel for in-person instruction and live procedure coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Verification that you will satisfy all vendor credentialing requirements, which may include vaccination for COVID-19. If you require a medical or religious accommodation from these requirements or if you would like to understand more about these requirements, please advise HR so that we can provide additional information and if needed, we can explore any needed accommodation(s).

Apply Now

Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:

Our technology team is currently seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our growing team in our Worcester MA office, or via a remote work arrangement. This is a full-time, exempt position.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Senior Data Engineer will lead a team of developers (internal and vendor resources) for the end-to-end design, development, implementation, and optimization of our enterprise data integration and warehousing solutions. In this role, you will build and maintain robust ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines, bridge source systems with target analytics platforms, and establish scalable data models. The work is challenging and requires not only smart but natural curiosity and tenacity. Teamwork is also important to us – we work together and play together.

Title: Customer Success Manager

Department: Partnerships

Reports To: SVP, Channel and Partnerships

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: US, remote (East Coast Preferred)

As a Customer Success Manager on our Partnerships team, you'll be the advocate for our channel partners, resellers, and strategic alliances, and for their downstream clients. You'll learn each partner's business, go-to-market strategy, and goals, then use that knowledge to advise them, find co-selling opportunities, and turn partners into raving Prove fans. Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
  • High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

  • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

  • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
  • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat
  • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting to join our growing team.

Position Description:

The Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting will own the preparation of Oklo’s annual and quarterly financial statement and oversee all technical accounting-related analyses and memos. Reporting to the VP of Accounting and Controller, this role will also oversee the development of Oklo’s suite of accounting policies and SOX controls as the Company expands its operations. The Director will work closely with the internal audit department and be a primary contact for the Company’s external auditors. The role will also be a key partner to peers within Oklo’s finance team and across the organization, providing internal training and education on areas of accounting impacting Oklo today and in the future. This role will be a key resource to Corporate Development, Procurement and Business Unit Leaders, providing expert accounting advice as contracts and other transactions are being structured. The Director will play a critical role in optimizing Oklo’s accounting processes, policies and reporting, enabling the business to grow at pace.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Prepare the financial statements and footnotes for Oklo’s Form 10-K and Form 10-Q, including all supporting schedules, and related reporting packages. Partner with key stakeholders across the Company to prepare the MD&A.
  • Lead Disclosure Committee meetings and assist the VP of Accounting and Controller in the preparation of Audit Committee reports.
  • Lead monthly internal calls with Oklo’s finance team and the external auditors on the accounting for significant new transactions, and related disclosure considerations.
  • Perform technical accounting research on complex areas of accounting relevant to Oklo, including business combinations and asset acquisitions, power purchase agreements, consolidation and equity method accounting, financial investments, stock-based compensation, and capitalization of construction costs.
  • Lead the adoption of any new Accounting Standards and Accounting Standard Updates, including project management and reporting progress to senior management. Monitor developments at the FASB as it relates to potential new standards,
  • Serve as key contact for the Company’s external auditors, ensuring strong project management over all phases of the audit and identifying any areas for continuous improvement.
  • Own the Company’s suite of accounting policies and lead the development of new policies as the Company expands and new business transactions are executed.
  • Own SOX controls in the areas of SEC reporting and technical accounting, preparing robust documentation to support ICFR certifications and the external SOX audit.
  • Coach and develop the team, identify appropriate training and development opportunities for each team member, and lead organization-wide training on key accounting and reporting topics.
  • Monitor developments at the SEC and any rule changes that may impact Oklo’s filing requirements. Partner with Legal and Compliance on all SEC-reporting matters.
  • Develop accounting playbooks to educate and support the organization on key areas of accounting impacting Oklo.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting processes, workpapers, and controls to increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Partner with the Process and Systems team to identify AI implementation opportunities that would enhance Oklo’s financial reporting and technical accounting functions.
  • Partner with Accounting Operations to ensure transactions are accounted for accurately and in a timely manner and G/L architecture is optimally designed to streamline SEC reporting.
  • Partner with the FP&A team to ensure internal forecasts accurately reflect the accounting for significant new transactions.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or related field
  • 10+ years’ experience in accounting and financial reporting roles, including recent public accounting experience
  • SEC reporting experience required
  • Strong experience with ASC literature and Big 4 accounting guides; proven ability to research and document technical accounting analyses in a clear and concise manner
  • Proven project management experience
  • Active CPA

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Big 4 audit experience highly preferred
  • Experience in the energy sector (including experience with industry accounting topics, such as power purchase agreements, leases, derivatives, contracts with customers, and construction accounting, depreciation, nuclear fuel & asset retirement obligations) highly preferred.
  • Master’s degree in accountancy preferred
  • Experience with financial systems, such as NetSuite and ZIP
  • Fast growth startup experience

Competencies

We are looking for someone that is:

  • Analytical—the individual synthesizes complex or diverse information.
  • Process and public company oriented.
  • Pro-Active – as Oklo’s business evolves we want to be on the front foot in identifying potential accounting implications of new or proposed transactions, offering accounting advice to the business during contract negotiations.
  • Problem solving—the individual identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner and gathers and analyzes information skillfully.
  • Communication—the individual speaks clearly and persuasively, demonstrates group presentation skills, conducts productive meetings, and has excellent written communication. The candidate will be able to effectively communicate technical accounting matters in plain English.
  • Organization—the individual is highly-organized and embeds a culture of effective project management, ensuring the Company meets its internal and external deadlines.
  • Quality management—the individual looks for ways to improve and promote quality and demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness.
  • Judgment—the individual displays willingness to make decisions, exhibits sound and accurate judgment and makes timely decisions.
  • Planning/organizing—the individual prioritizes and plans work activities, uses time efficiently and develops realistic action plans.
  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer in a modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results in plain English

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $170,000-$210,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

jobs.excerpt: About AdvantixxRCMAdvantixxRCM is a healthcare revenue-cycle management company supporting medical practices and healthcare organizations with accurate, compliant, and service-focused billing operations.
jobs.description:
About AdvantixxRCM

AdvantixxRCM is a healthcare revenue-cycle management company supporting medical practices and healthcare organizations with accurate, compliant, and service-focused billing operations. Our culture values ethical billing, patient-conscious service, accuracy, ownership, respectful collaboration, continuous improvement, privacy, security, and speaking up.

Team members protect confidential patient and client information, use only authorized systems, and follow company, client, payer, HIPAA, and applicable legal requirements. AdvantixxRCM is an equal opportunity employer.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Verify patient insurance eligibility before scheduled services.
  • Confirm active coverage and effective dates.
  • Verify patient demographics and insurance information.
  • Verify primary and secondary insurance coverage.
  • Identify coordination-of-benefits issues.
  • Verify provider participation/network status when appropriate.
  • Review payer-specific requirements.
  • Determine whether prior authorization is required.
  • Determine whether a referral is required.
  • Submit prior authorization requests.
  • Obtain and submit supporting clinical documentation as required.
  • Follow up with insurance companies regarding pending authorization requests.
  • Track authorization status through determination.
  • Document authorization numbers, effective dates, approved services/units, and expiration dates.
  • Monitor existing authorizations to prevent expiration or exhaustion of approved visits/units.
  • Coordinate referral requirements.
  • Communicate authorization or eligibility problems to the client before services whenever possible.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of all verification and authorization activities.

Benefits Verification

The Patient Access Specialist may verify:

  • Deductibles
  • Copayments
  • Coinsurance
  • Out-of-pocket amounts
  • Coverage limitations
  • Service-specific benefits
  • Visit limitations
  • Authorization requirements
  • Referral requirements
  • Network requirements
  • Primary/secondary payer information

The employee must accurately document information obtained from payer portals or insurance representatives and avoid representing benefit verification as a guarantee of payment.

Prior Authorization

Responsibilities include:

  • Determine whether authorization is required.
  • Initiate authorization requests.
  • Submit required documentation.
  • Communicate with payer utilization management departments.
  • Follow up on pending authorizations.
  • Track authorization decisions.
  • Document authorization/reference numbers.
  • Track approved CPT/services when applicable.
  • Track approved visits or units.
  • Track authorization effective and expiration dates.
  • Request extensions or additional visits when appropriate.
  • Escalate authorization denials requiring clinical review or appeal.
  • Notify the appropriate client/team when services are not authorized.

Denial Prevention

A major responsibility of this position is preventing avoidable denials before claims are submitted.

The Patient Access Specialist should identify potential issues involving:

  • Inactive insurance
  • Incorrect member information
  • Incorrect payer
  • Coordination of benefits
  • Missing prior authorization
  • Expired authorization
  • Exhausted visits/units
  • Missing referral
  • Out-of-network provider
  • Service exclusions
  • Benefit limitations
  • Incorrect provider/service location information

Issues should be communicated promptly to the appropriate client or AdvantixxRCM department.

Internal Coordination

The Patient Access Specialist works closely with the:

Medical Billing Specialist for claim-related insurance information.

A/R Specialist for eligibility-related unpaid claims.

Denial Management Specialist for authorization and eligibility denials.

Credentialing Specialist for provider participation/enrollment concerns.

Client Account Manager for information needed from healthcare clients.

Operations Manager for escalated issues and payer trends.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 1–2 years of healthcare insurance verification, prior authorization, medical billing, patient access, or RCM experience preferred.
  • Experience verifying insurance eligibility and benefits.
  • Experience obtaining prior authorizations.
  • Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care, and commercial insurance.
  • Experience using insurance payer portals.
  • Understanding of healthcare insurance terminology.
  • Knowledge of deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, and out-of-pocket responsibilities.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to manage multiple pending authorizations and deadlines simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous RCM or medical billing company experience.
  • Experience with multiple healthcare specialties.
  • Experience with Availity and other payer portals.
  • Familiarity with CPT/HCPCS terminology.
  • Experience working with Medicare and Medicaid.
  • Experience handling referrals.
  • Experience with medical necessity documentation.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on:

  • Eligibility verification accuracy
  • Prior authorization completion
  • Authorization turnaround
  • Follow-up timeliness
  • Documentation accuracy
  • Authorization tracking
  • Prevention of eligibility/authorization-related denials
  • Productivity
  • Client communication
  • Compliance with payer requirements

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who understands that successful revenue cycle management begins before the claim is submitted.

The Patient Access Specialist should proactively identify insurance, eligibility, authorization, and referral issues so they can be addressed before they become denials or lost revenue.

We need someone who takes ownership of pending authorizations and does not consider the job finished simply because an authorization request was submitted.

Why Join AdvantixxRCM?

AdvantixxRCM is building a comprehensive revenue cycle organization focused on improving reimbursement while preventing avoidable revenue loss for healthcare providers.

We value accuracy, accountability, urgency, communication, and problem-solving.

jobs.title: Chief Customer Officer
jobs.excerpt: Work from anywhere, impact everywhere Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
jobs.description:
Work from anywhere, impact everywhere

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position

Work from anywhere!

Position overview

Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship.

Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible.

The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision.

The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against.

This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep.

The mandate

  1. Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional.
    You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down.
  2. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would.
    You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved.
  3. Win the right members, efficiently.
    You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it.
  4. Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances.
    Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost.
  5. Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless.
    You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay.
  6. Build one Customer organisation, not four.
    Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week.
  7. Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call.
    You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations.

How you'll operate

This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here.

  • You lead from inside the work. You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them.
  • You move people with the business case, not the whip. When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title.
  • You have extreme ownership. You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach.
  • You have genuine gravitas. Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger.
  • You diagnose before you prescribe. You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom.

What you'll have done

  • 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime).
  • Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either.
  • Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC.
  • Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app.
  • Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage.
  • Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite.
  • A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove.

The first 90 days

Day 30: The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board.Day 60: The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads.Day 90: At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week.

What this role is not

  • Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions.
  • Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed.
  • Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed.
  • Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached.

Other requirements

  • A dedicated workspace.
  • A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
  • Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

  • Shape the Future
    Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

  • Great work-life balanceBuild amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.

  • Expect ExcellenceCollaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

jobs.description:
About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

About Trase

Co-founded in 2023 by Joe Laws and Grant Verstandig, Trase Systems is AI, Uncomplicated. Trase empowers enterprise leaders to harness the full potential of AI without the associated complexity and risks. We are an end-to-end solution for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI in the enterprise. Our platform specializes in bridging the “last mile” of AI adoption, unlocking AI's full potential while driving efficiency and significant cost savings. Trase is at the forefront of AI Agent innovation, topping the Hugging Face GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, ahead of industry giants such as Google, Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI. We are leveraging our cutting-edge technologies to develop mission-critical agentic applications in complex industries such as Healthcare, Oil & Gas, and National Security.

About the Role

We are seeking an Engineering Leader to build and lead our Production and Infrastructure Engineering organization. You will manage engineers across DevOps, SRE, DevEx, MLOps, and lead a dedicated support team. You will be accountable for team performance, development, and delivery across these functions.

You will bring a strong foundation in infrastructure and software engineering and stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions, guide technical decisions, and help engineers resolve difficult problems. Your hands-on involvement will focus on design and code reviews, technical investigation, and pairing when needed, while developing technical leads and delegating implementation to the team.

This role calls for a nimble, adaptable leader who can organize ambiguous work, adjust plans as priorities change, and bring different technical disciplines together around clear outcomes. You will create focus, make timely decisions, and build a team that delivers consistently.

Responsibilities

  • Build and Develop the Team: Own hiring, onboarding, one-on-ones, career development, and performance management. Coach junior engineers, develop technical leads, and give senior specialists clear expectations and candid feedback. Build the skills and ownership needed for the team to operate effectively.
  • Lead Across Technical Disciplines: Set shared priorities and clear responsibilities across infrastructure, reliability, developer experience, testing, and application delivery. Delegate technical execution to the appropriate leads, resolve disagreements, and hold engineers at every level accountable to agreed decisions and commitments.
  • Own Planning and Delivery: Lead sprint planning, backlog grooming, capacity planning, and delivery reviews in partnership with technical leads and TPMs. Turn ambiguous goals into actionable work, manage dependencies and scope, and balance roadmap delivery with incidents and customer support. Replan quickly and communicate tradeoffs when conditions change.
  • Provide Hands-On Technical Leadership: Participate in design and code reviews, ask informed questions, and join investigations or pairing sessions when the team is blocked. Use your infrastructure and software background to connect application behavior with deployment and operational concerns and guide practical solutions.
  • Lead Production and Release Readiness: Make reliability, release and change management, QA, and E2E validation part of the team's delivery process. Assign accountable owners, establish readiness criteria with feature teams, and ensure testing, operational documentation, and rollback plans support release decisions.
  • Strengthen Operations and Developer Experience: Lead the team's improvements to cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD, observability, on-call readiness, and incident response. Prioritize work that reduces recurring incidents and developer friction. Use delivery, reliability, recovery, and support metrics to assess results and guide investment.
  • Lead Dedicated Red Cell Partners Support: Manage a cross-functional team of full-stack engineers, DevOps engineers, and a dedicated TPM. Align priorities, staffing, delivery commitments, and support expectations with stakeholders. Resolve dependencies across application and infrastructure teams and maintain clear escalation paths.
  • Partner Across the Organization: Work with Product, Platform, Applied AI, and Security/GRC on delivery priorities, operational readiness, and applicable customer requirements. Surface risks early, secure decisions when needed, and ensure follow-through on engineering commitments.

Requirements

  • Engineering People Leadership: 10+ years of relevant engineering experience, including 5+ years of direct engineering people management, or equivalent demonstrated experience. A track record of building teams, coaching engineers (platform, infrastructure), managing performance, and delivering through technical leads. Director-level candidates should demonstrate leadership across multiple engineering functions.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Experience leading teams with different technical specialties and seniority levels. Strong planning, prioritization, delegation, and stakeholder communication; able to resolve technical disagreements and keep teams aligned to shared outcomes.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: A strong technical foundation in at least one major cloud platform, such as GCP, AWS, or Azure, with practical experience in Kubernetes, containers, networking, identity, and production operations.
  • Infrastructure as Code and Delivery Automation: Practical experience with Terraform, Git-based development workflows, GitOps, and CI/CD. Able to guide the team's approach to repeatable environments, configuration control, and reliable deployments.
  • Software Engineering: A strong background building and shipping production software, with working depth across backend services, APIs, data stores, and full-stack integration. Able to review code and designs, reason about application failures, and pair with engineers to unblock delivery.
  • Operational and Quality Leadership: Experience leading production delivery and support, including reliability, incident response, release and change management, and collaboration with engineers on automated testing and E2E readiness.
  • Adaptability and Ownership: Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguity, learn unfamiliar technical domains, and make timely decisions with incomplete information. Comfortable shifting between people leadership, delivery issues, and technical discussions while maintaining team focus.
  • Customer and Partner Collaboration: Experience managing technical commitments and escalations with internal or external customers, and translating their needs into feasible priorities and delivery plans.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with MLOps, model serving, or operating AI/ML and agent workloads; able to learn from and partner with specialists in these areas.
  • Experience supporting customer-managed environments, multiple cloud providers, or enterprise deployments with complex integration needs.
  • Experience in national security, federal, regulated, or other security-sensitive environments and partnering with Security/GRC on engineering requirements.
  • Experience scaling an engineering organization or building a new team or operating function in a fast-changing company.

Certain national security assignments may require U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a security clearance, depending on confirmed customer and contract requirements. Some travel is required.

If you want to be on the cutting edge of technology, building AI solutions for the future, and are up for a challenge, let’s talk!

Salary Range: $240,000-290,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

Our Red Cell Partners Benefits (may differ for each incubation):

For full-time roles

  • Career track opportunity with potential for rapid advancement with strong performance as the firm grows
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health care including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family.
  • Paid maternity and paternity for 14 weeks at employees' normal pay.

Account Executives will be given a territory of Large Enterprise clients.

In our End-User Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$1bil in annual revenue.

In our Tech Vendor Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$500mil in annual revenue.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityShyftLabs is a fast-growing data and technology company partnering with Fortune 500 organizations to deliver innovative, data-driven solutions.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

ShyftLabs is a fast-growing data and technology company partnering with Fortune 500 organizations to deliver innovative, data-driven solutions. We specialize in building scalable, enterprise-grade platforms that help businesses unlock the value of their data through modern cloud technologies, advanced analytics, and AI-driven capabilities.

We are seeking an experienced Data Architect to work directly with enterprise clients, providing architectural leadership and hands-on technical expertise across modern data engineering initiatives. This is a client-facing role that combines solution architecture, technical consulting, and delivery oversight, requiring the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and reliable data solutions.

You will collaborate closely with client stakeholders, engineering teams, and technology partners to define architectural direction, establish engineering standards, and guide data platform implementations from design through production. You will also review partner-developed architectures, code, data models, and pipelines to ensure solutions meet enterprise requirements and align with established best practices.

The ideal candidate is a technically strong, hands-on architect who can confidently engage with senior client stakeholders, communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and influence architectural decisions while supporting distributed engineering teams.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead Client-Facing Architecture Discussions: Work directly with client stakeholders to understand business objectives, technical requirements, existing data environments, and architectural challenges. Translate these needs into practical, scalable data architecture solutions.

  • Define Enterprise Data Architecture: Design and recommend modern data platform architectures using Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, and cloud-based data engineering technologies, ensuring alignment with client objectives and enterprise standards.

  • Drive Technical Discovery and Solution Design: Facilitate technical workshops, discovery sessions, and architecture reviews to assess current-state environments, identify gaps, evaluate solution options, and define target-state architectures.

  • Provide Hands-On Technical Leadership: Develop, validate, and review data engineering solutions using SQL, Python/PySpark, Apache Airflow, and dbt Core, balancing architectural oversight with practical implementation expertise.

  • Guide Data Pipeline Development: Establish architecture and implementation standards for ingestion pipelines that integrate APIs, databases, files, and cloud data sources using Databricks-native capabilities such as Lakeflow Connect and Auto Loader.

  • Establish Data Architecture Standards: Define and promote reusable architectural patterns, implementation guidelines, and engineering best practices across client projects and distributed delivery teams.

  • Implement Medallion Architecture: Design and guide the implementation of Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers to support reliable ingestion, standardized transformations, curated data products, and downstream analytics.

  • Drive Data Governance and Modeling: Establish appropriate practices for Unity Catalog, data access controls, lineage, semantic modeling, data discoverability, and enterprise data governance.

  • Oversee Technical Delivery and Quality: Review partner and engineering team deliverables, including architecture designs, code, data models, and pipelines, ensuring alignment with requirements, performance expectations, security standards, and long-term maintainability.

  • Champion Data Quality and Reliability: Define standards for data validation, automated testing, pipeline monitoring, error handling, and operational readiness to ensure reliable production data products.

  • Support CI/CD and Engineering Automation: Guide implementation of Git-based workflows, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and controlled deployment practices across development, testing, and production environments.

  • Advise on Performance and Cost Optimization: Evaluate platform performance, processing efficiency, scalability, and cloud consumption, recommending improvements that balance technical requirements with business value.

  • Drive AI-Assisted and Spec-Driven Development: Encourage the effective use of AI-assisted development tools and specification-driven engineering practices while maintaining architectural integrity, code quality, and delivery standards.

  • Coordinate Distributed Engineering Teams: Provide technical direction, resolve architectural questions, and facilitate collaboration between client stakeholders, internal engineers, and external technology partners.

  • Communicate Progress and Technical Risks: Clearly communicate architectural decisions, implementation trade-offs, dependencies, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Support End-to-End Delivery: Maintain architectural ownership throughout the project lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing optimization.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years of overall experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related technical roles, with strong hands-on experience designing and delivering production-grade data platforms.

  • Proven experience in a client-facing technical role, such as Data Architect, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, or Lead Data Engineer, working directly with enterprise customers or stakeholders.

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Azure Databricks, including the design and implementation of scalable enterprise data solutions.

  • Deep understanding of Delta Lake, including data management, processing patterns, and performance optimization.

  • Experience with Unity Catalog, including data governance, access controls, lineage, and enterprise data management.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python/PySpark for data processing, transformation, and pipeline development.

  • Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow for orchestration and dbt Core for data transformation, testing, and modeling.

  • Experience designing ingestion pipelines across APIs, relational databases, files, and other enterprise data sources.

  • Familiarity with Databricks-native ingestion technologies, including Lakeflow Connect and Auto Loader.

  • Strong understanding of Medallion Architecture, data products, semantic modeling, and data quality frameworks.

  • Experience with CI/CD, Git, automated testing, monitoring, and production data pipeline management.

  • Demonstrated ability to review and challenge technical architectures, code, data models, and engineering deliverables while providing constructive, actionable feedback.

  • Experience translating business requirements into technical specifications, architectural designs, and implementation roadmaps.

  • Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and communicate recommendations clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, and client leadership.

  • Experience working with external technology partners, third-party delivery teams, or distributed engineering organizations.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and spec-driven development practices.

  • Strong communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and build trusted relationships with clients while maintaining technical credibility.

Salary Range

  • $160,000 - $190,000 (CAD)

Why You’ll Love Working at ShyftLabs

At ShyftLabs, your work matters. We’re a growing data product company making a big impact with Fortune 500 clients and as we scale, you’ll have the chance to shape solutions, influence strategy, and grow your career alongside us.

Inclusion at ShyftLabs

We’re building something big, and we want you on the journey with us. If you’re ready to use data and innovation to make an impact, apply today and let’s grow together.

Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Integration Cloud Developer to design, build, and operate enterprise integration scenarios that connect Oracle Cloud Applications, on-premises Oracle systems, and third-party platforms. In this role you will own the full integration lifecycle, from analysis and design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support. The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on experience with OIC integrations, processes, and visual builder applications, and will combine that with a clear understanding of integration patterns, API management, and Oracle Cloud Applications data models.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop integration flows in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) connecting Oracle Cloud Applications (ERP, HCM, CX) with on-premises and third-party systems.
  • Build app-driven and scheduled orchestrations, including complex mappings, error handling, and recovery flows.
  • Configure and operate a wide range of OIC adapters (REST, SOAP, FTP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, custom).
  • Develop process automation flows using OIC Process Cloud Service for human-centric workflows.
  • Build Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) applications integrated with OIC and Oracle Cloud Applications.
  • Implement API management strategies, including security policies, throttling, and developer portals.
  • Design robust error-handling and notification patterns, including retries, escalation, and resubmission workflows.
  • Optimize performance of high-volume integrations through batching, parallelism, and asynchronous patterns.

Workforce Management & Operations Research

  • Build WFM capabilities including demand forecasting, shift scheduling, real-time adherence monitoring, and capacity planning — applying operations research techniques to optimize workforce utilization.

  • Design and implement optimization algorithms for headcount modeling, skill-based routing, and workload balancing across multi-site, multi-timezone contact center operations.

  • Deep expertise in building real-time, data-intensive systems.

  • Strong foundation in data stores and storage systems: relational databases, time-series stores, columnar analytics engines, and caching layers — with the judgment to choose the right tool for the workload.

  • Experience building quality software using AI-driven tools and workflows.

  • Track record of taking products from 0→1 and iterating rapidly based on customer feedback.

Founded in 2004, Crestview is a value-oriented private equity firm focused on the middle market with approximately $10 billion in capital commitments. Based in New York, Crestview focuses on
industrials, media, and financial services.

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Network & Security Engineer to design, implement, manage, and secure enterprise network infrastructure across multiple locations. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Layer 3 networking, enterprise firewalls, cybersecurity technologies, and IT security best practices. This role will be responsible for maintaining secure and reliable connectivity between sites, cloud environments, remote users, and manufacturing or business operations.

The successful candidate must be proactive, security-focused, and capable of independently troubleshooting complex network and security issues in a remote work environment.

Candidates must demonstrate hands-on experience with both wired and wireless enterprise networking environments and be capable of independently designing, implementing, securing, and troubleshooting Layer 3 and Wi-Fi network infrastructures. Preference will be given to candidates with experience supporting manufacturing facilities, warehouses, and multi-site operations.

Key Responsibilities

Network Engineering:

  • Design, deploy, and maintain enterprise Layer 3 network infrastructure. Configure and manage routing protocols including BGP, EIGRP (preferred), Static Routing.
  • Implement and manage VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, subnetting, IP addressing plans, and network segmentation.
  • Troubleshoot complex LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and VPN connectivity issues.
  • Manage network switches, routers, wireless infrastructure, and edge connectivity.
  • Design, deploy, and manage enterprise Wi-Fi across multiple sites, including site surveys, RF and coverage optimization, troubleshooting, controllers, access points, guest networks, and security policies.
  • Optimize network performance, redundancy, and high availability.

Security Engineering:

  • Manage remote-access and site-to-site VPNs, firewalls, and security appliances.
  • Maintain firewall policies, NAT rules, VPN configurations, security zones, and remediate vulnerabilities.
  • Monitor and respond to security events using Zero Trust and least-privilege principles.

Cybersecurity Operations:

  • Deploy and administer EDR, SIEM, vulnerability management, MFA, IAM, email security, and PAM tools.
  • Participate in incident response and forensic investigations.
  • Support cybersecurity audits, compliance assessments, and security reviews.
  • Develop and maintain security documentation, standards, and procedures.

Required Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related field.
  • Preferred Certifications: CCNP, CISSP, CISM, Security+

Experience:

  • 5+ years in enterprise networking and 3+ years in cybersecurity or security engineering.
  • Proven experience designing and supporting Layer 3 networks, multi-site enterprise Wi-Fi, firewalls, and VPNs.
  • Experience supporting multi-site environments, remote users, and secure wireless access.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing or industrial environments, securing OT/IT networks.

Technical Skills:

Networking:

  • Layer 3 networking: OSPF, BGP, VLANs, STP, VRRP/HSRP, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, and SD-WAN.
  • Multi-site enterprise Wi-Fi design, deployment, and troubleshooting, including Wi-Fi 5/6/6E, site surveys, RF planning, coverage optimization, controllers, access points, guest networks, and security policies.
  • Enterprise wireless platforms (Cisco Meraki/Catalyst, Aruba, Extreme, Ruckus, or Ubiquiti) and secure authentication using WPA2/WPA3 Enterprise, 802.1X, RADIUS, and NAC.

Security:

  • Firewall administration, IDS/IPS, VPN technologies, and Network Access Control (NAC).
  • Security hardening, network segmentation, and endpoint security solutions.

Cybersecurity Platforms:

  • Experience with one or more of, Microsoft Defender Suite, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Tenable, Rapid7, Qualys

Firewall Platforms:

  • Experience with one or more of: Sophos, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet FortiGate, Cisco Firepower, Check Point, SonicWall

Cloud:

  • Microsoft Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365 Security

Competitive compensation in USD (Dollar Pledge).
100% remote role from anywhere from India OR Pakistan
Supportive and inclusive work environment.
Career growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding global organization.

This includes providing product feedback, comments and suggestions and Competitive information to the Product Planning and Marketing groups.
