Columbus Radiology Corporation (CRC) and Radiology Associates of Canton (RAC) are seeking full-time remote general and neuroradiologists to support our growing practice throughout the state of Ohio.

POSITION SUMMARY

CRC and RAC are seeking a Board-Eligible or Board-Certified General Radiologist or Neuro Radiologist to join our remote evening team. These roles offer flexible scheduling, and both Associate and Partnership Track opportunities. Radiologists can choose start times that best fit their schedule, maintaining an excellent work-life balance while working alongside a highly collaborative, physician-led group. The ideal candidate will be comfortable interpreting a broad range of diagnostic imaging studies and performing non-subspecialty reads. Radiologists of all subspecialties are encouraged to apply.

Remote Evening General Associate (1 week on / 2 weeks off)

  • Schedule: 1 week on / 2 weeks off (ending at 10pm-12am, you choose)
  • Total Starting Compensation: $425K (inclusive of 401K profit sharing)
  • Commencement Bonus: $50K

  • Schedule: 1 week on / 2 weeks off (ending at 10pm-12am, you choose)

  • Schedule: 1 week on / 2 weeks off + 28 additional half evening shifts (ending at 10pm-12am, you choose)
  • Total Starting Compensation: $490K (inclusive of 401K profit sharing)
  • Commencement Bonus: $50K

Remote Evening General Partner (1 week on / 1 week off)

  • Schedule: 1 week on / 1 week off (ending at 10pm-12am, you choose)
  • Total Starting Compensation: $600K (inclusive of 401K profit sharing)
  • Commencement Bonus: $125K

Remote Evening Neuro Partner (1 week on / 1 week off)

  • Schedule: 1 week on / 1 week off (ending at 10pm-12am, you choose)
  • Total Starting Compensation: $660K (inclusive of 401K profit sharing)
  • Commencement Bonus: $125K

All associate/partnership eligible roles with CRC include full benefits, home workstation, and offer substantial moonlighting and incentive pay opportunities with some radiologists earning over $1 million in annual total compensation and partner compensation averaging $800K annually.

  • Comfortable with all modalities within subspecialty
  • Comfortable reading general radiology for outpatient, inpatient and emergency medicine
  • Opportunities to grow in both clinical and non-clinical roles within the practice

DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Licensed or able to be licensed in the state of Ohio
  • Board certified or Board eligible in Diagnostic Radiology by the American Board of Radiology

Physician Owned. Physician Led. Founded in 1946, Columbus Radiology Corporation is the fifth largest and one of the fastest growing practices in the country, now with 180+ board-certified and subspecialty trained radiologists who are committed to excellence – in patient care, physician relations, continuous quality improvement and professional development. This clinical team is an extension of our Radiologists, which helps in reducing day to day administrative minutiae. The Advisory Board Company and the American College of Radiology have both recognized this as an innovative customer service function.

jobs.title: Finance Engineer
jobs.excerpt: SPRCHRGR (pronounced "supercharger") is a professional services consultancy providing highly skilled team members across a variety of complementary disciplines.
jobs.description:
SPRCHRGR (pronounced "supercharger") is a professional services consultancy providing highly skilled team members across a variety of complementary disciplines. We like to say, “cut out the vowels, get there faster!” because we prioritize creativity, efficiency, and performance in our work, and we have fun doing it.

Our exceptional staff + innovative approach set us apart from stuffy traditional accountancies and commoditized outsourced bookkeeping agencies. We think differently about our work supporting high-growth startups, forward-thinking SMBs, and nonprofits located all across the US.

We specialize in cutting-edge technology and partner with dynamic businesses across diverse industries. Our team culture emphasizes collaboration, learning, and process-driven efficiency.

We're looking for someone who reads a trial balance and writes software. You'll build the client-facing financial tools for our fractional CFO firm: interactive dashboards and forecasting models, AI assistants that answer finance questions from live accounting data, and automations that take real recurring work off our clients' plates. We're small, we move fast, and we build our own tools instead of buying and configuring someone else's platform.

Who we are

SPRCHRGR combines executive financial leadership, fractional CFO work and controllership with data, systems integration and workflow automation. Our clients run $1 million to $50 million in revenue and get a white-glove build, not a template. We're small, we move fast, and we build our own tools (when it makes sense) instead of buying and configuring someone else's platform.

What you'll do

  • Build and own our client dashboards. Interactive financial models delivered as web apps, with scenario sliders, drill-down tables, and Excel exports a client's own finance lead can audit.
  • Build AI automations. Small, versioned automations that do one job properly, like turning a client's billing spreadsheet into reconciled QuickBooks invoices with built-in approval gates.
  • Get the data in yourself. Write the database queries behind our reporting and connect them to live client accounting data. Our VP of Technology owns the platform and will hand you the tools and procedures to work independently, not a ticket queue.
  • Be the person we trust when two numbers disagree. Work discrepancies to a documented answer, and know a genuine variance from two figures that were never comparable.
  • Teach the rest of us. Help our accountants and operators build their own tools instead of depending on you for every one.
  • Work directly with clients. Meet (virtually) with key client stakeholders to work out what they need, then build it. No layer in between, although you'll have full access to collaborate with other accounting + finance experts within our firm.

Who you are

You have both halves. Finance + Engineering.

  • Finance: real depth in accounting, financial statements, month-end close, receivables and payables, reconciliation, how a general ledger actually works. CPA or CMA is a strong signal; demonstrated judgment matters more.
  • Building: you write and maintain real code and real database queries. Our VP of Engineering partners with you to architect, maintain, and enhance the secure data warehouses, APIs, and hosted web app platform underneath. You can take a system with wrong or missing documentation, work out what it actually does, and build against reality. You've built AI tools, not just used them.

Minimum requirements

  • Bachelor's degree with a focus in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of combined experience across accounting or finance and software or systems development.
  • CPA or CMA preferred, not required.
  • Proficiency in SQL preferred, not required.
  • Experience with at least one accounting system in depth, such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or Dynamics.
  • Clear and concise communication, both written and verbal.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.
  • A dedicated workspace and access to reliable, secure, high-speed internet.
  • An unwavering commitment to confidentiality.
  • Based in the United States
  • Embrace SPRCHRGR's Core Values.

What this job isn't

  • Not a reporting role. If you just want to produce monthly financial packages, this is the wrong job.
  • Not a coordinator between finance and engineering. You build.
  • Not a management role in year one.
  • Not a place to learn accounting on the job.

Compensation and benefits

  • Fully Remote: Work from home with a structured schedule.
  • Career Growth: Gain hands-on mentoring and opportunities to work directly with our Founder & CEO.
  • Team-Oriented Environment: Collaborate with Software Engineers, Sr. Controllers, CFOs, and Accounting Managers to synthesize bespoke solutions for our clients.
  • Competitive pay: $150,000 - $180,000 Base Salary, DOE.
  • Phantom Equity: Eligible for consideration after your first year.
  • Bonus: Annual performance-based bonus compensation plan.
  • 401k: Up to a 4% match and no vesting period.
  • Benefits: Customizable options.

What will make you stand out

Send us something you built: a repository, a working file, or a written account of an automation you shipped end to end, with the before-and-after time it took. That matters more to us than a cover letter. If your best example is client work you can't share, tell us what it did and how you'd rebuild it!

Application Notice

At SPRCHRGR, we value fairness, clarity, and attention to detail in our hiring process. To ensure an equitable process, we ask that you submit your application only through the official posting for this role.

  • Do not contact our hiring managers, team members, or leadership directly (via personal email, LinkedIn, or other channels). Applications received in this way will be automatically disqualified. Please direct all questions and inquiries to

Notice to External Recruiters
Please do not send unsolicited candidate submissions to our team. Our system automatically blocks domains that repeatedly send unrequested outreach.

WHO WE ARE

Ethical

We do good. We act with integrity, earning trust instead of asking for it, and we do what is right even when it isn’t easy. We are transparent, promptly sharing information and feedback directly and freely with all relevant stakeholders.

Positive

We love what we do. It shows in the positive and constructive attitude we bring every day. We realize work is more than just output; it’s about the life experiences we share along the way.

Passionate

We care. A lot. We expect high performance of ourselves and our teammates. We constantly look to innovate and improve. We play to win and keep raising the bar to deliver results.

Professional

We are one team, focused on the "we" rather than the "I." We’re consistently organized and accountable. Our work speaks for itself and stands the test of time.

Inclusive

By design, our team members believe, act, feel, and look differently from each other. We foster a sense of belonging and respect for every individual and we expect the same from our clients and partners.

HOW WE OPERATE

We focus on what matters

We work efficiently but don't cut corners or compromise on best practices. We prioritize long-term value over short-term gains. We value simplicity over complexity.

We reward it

We reward the effort of our peers with matched enthusiasm. We share the spotlight and credit generously. We celebrate our successes, even the small ones.

We own it

We take pride in our work. We see projects through from start to finish. We continuously update process documentation and fix things we find broken along the way.

We’re a service-first organization

We exemplify a customer-first mindset across everything we do internally & externally, always learning from our colleagues, partners, and clients. While the customer isn’t always right, we value their trust in us and strive to reciprocate value by anticipating their needs, priorities, and expectations.

ABOUT KLED

Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.

We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.

We are a consumer application where people upload their real photos, videos, and documents and get paid continuously.

We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.

Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:

• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
• Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors

• Processed 5M uploads per day

• Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more

Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

This listing is for one paid task in the Kled app: "Fine-Grained Similar Objects". There is no interview and no minimum hours: download the app, open the task, and you are paid per accepted submission.

What you will do

Photograph three or more things that look almost the same, then tell us what's different about them.

Steps

  1. Gather three or more similar items that differ subtly

  2. Arrange them in one frame

  3. Photograph close enough to see the differences

  4. Say what distinguishes them

  5. Upload

What gets rejected

  • Do not use obviously different objects

  • Do not use fewer than three

  • Do not shoot too far away to see detail

Accepted: Three or more genuinely similar variants in one frame with the distinguishing feature named.

Pay

$0.65 per accepted photo. At a typical pace of about 2.5 minutes per photo, that is about $16 per hour. A 20-minute session of about 8 photos pays about $5.20. Up to 10 photos per upload. You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).

Where and when

Open worldwide: the task runs in 100+ countries. Remote, on your own schedule. Independent contractor, piecework; this is not an employment position.

What you need

  • An iPhone running iOS 18.6 or later (the Kled app is iPhone-only right now)

  • 18 or older

  • Your own writing, typed in the app

How to start

  1. Download Kled from the App Store: (also at kled.ai/app).

  2. Create your account and open Tasks.

  3. Search "Fine-Grained Similar Objects", read the brief and follow the on-screen steps.

  4. Submit. Accepted submissions are paid in the app.

Every submission is reviewed, and you opt in to a commercial training license on each upload; accepted submissions are licensed to AI labs. Questions: .

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Paraplanner/Admin & Operations Specialist

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: A modern financial advisory firm that provides tailored financial advice to help clients make confident, long-term decisions. Operating as a collaborative team, it combines technical expertise with a thoughtful, client-first approach. The business is built on trust, transparency, and consistency in delivering high-quality advice. As the business grows, it continues to strengthen and grow its team in order to maintain its service offering precision and reliability.

Role Overview: The Paraplanner/Admin & Operations Specialist is responsible for the preparation of ongoing review documents, Statements of Advice (SOAs), Records of Advice (ROAs), and related technical research. In keeping with the company’s philosophy that every piece of advice should be intelligent, considered and personalized, this role also provides essential client administration support to ensure seamless, high-quality day-to-day operations that reflect the standard of the brand.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Paraplanning & Advice Document Preparation

  • Use AI tools to generate, structure, and refine Statements of Advice (SOAs) and Records of Advice (ROAs) in accordance with Australian regulatory requirements and best practice standards
  • Apply critical review skills to AI-generated advice documents, checking for accuracy, compliance, suitability, and client-specific relevance before adviser sign-off
  • Conduct investment, insurance, superannuation, and strategic research to inform and quality-check advice content
  • Prepare annual review documents, portfolio reports, and client review packs using workflows
  • Analyse client financial data to model scenarios and projections in support of advice strategy
  • Ensure all advice documents comply with relevant compliance frameworks, including AFSL requirements and the Best Interests Duty
  • Liaise with the adviser to refine advice strategies and ensure accurate reflection of client goals and circumstances
  • Maintain and update document templates to ensure consistency and efficiency

2. Ongoing Client Review Support

  • Coordinate and prepare for scheduled annual and semi-annual client reviews
  • Compile pre-meeting packs including portfolio valuations, asset allocations, and fee disclosure documents
  • Update client records and financial data in the CRM/practice management system following review meetings and as work is conducted throughout the year
  • Track review schedules and follow up on outstanding client actions post-meeting

3. Client Administration & Office Support

  • Handle client onboarding administration including data collection, file setup, and ID verification
  • Process new business applications, rollovers, and product instructions with fund managers, insurers, and super funds
  • Correspond with clients, product providers, and third parties via email and phone in a professional and timely manner
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client files and records within the practice management system
  • Prepare Fee Disclosure Statements (FDS) and Opt-In notices as required
  • Assist with compliance documentation, file notes, and audit trail maintenance
  • Support invoicing, fee collection, and general office administration as required

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of paraplanning experience within an Australian financial planning practice
  • Demonstrated experience preparing SOAs and ROAs across investment, superannuation, insurance, and retirement planning
  • Solid working knowledge of the Australian financial planning regulatory environment (Corporations Act, FASEA, Best Interests Duty)
  • Proficiency using AI-powered tools and platforms to draft, refine, and quality-check Statements of Advice and related documents
  • Comfort working with large language models (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, or specialist financial planning AI tools) as part of an advice production workflow
  • Strong written English communication skills with the ability to produce clear, professional client-facing documents
  • High attention to detail with strong organisational and time management skills
  • Experience working remotely with Australian financial planning or professional services firms
  • Valid NBI/Police Clearance

  • Knowledge of Australian products including managed funds, platforms (e.g. Netwealth, HUB24, Macquarie Wrap), and life insurance

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering or working effectively with large language models to produce structured, compliant outputs
  • Experience with portfolio reporting tools and CRM/practice management systems Understanding of aged care advice, SMSFs, or estate planning as supplementary areas

jobs.title: Physical Security – Facilities Lead
jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyArmada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty.
jobs.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

Armada is seeking a Physical Security – Facilities Lead to own classified design, construction, and accreditation of Galleons for the U.S. Defense sector.

Galleons are built, configured, shipped, and stood up in months, not years. Defense customers need those units accredited as SCIFs, SAPFs, collateral open-storage or closed areas, and related secure processing environments. You will turn ICD 705, DoDM 5205.07, and NISPOM (32 CFR Part 117) physical construction standards into repeatable design requirements, factory and site practices, and accreditation packages that scale with the product line.

You will be the company authority on physical security for secure builds. You will sit with hardware, form-factor, manufacturing, deployment, federal, and security partners from concept through accreditation of the space. Where corporate facility protection overlaps a secure build, you will also set access control, intrusion detection, CPTED, and guard-force requirements as applicable. Corporate physical security is not a separate program. It is in scope only where it touches classified design, construction, or accreditation.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role. You will write the standard, walk the line, brief the Accrediting Official, and close the findings. You will exercise independent judgment on problems without precedent, be accountable for results across Armada's secure-build function, and direct the work of contractors, integrators, and cross-functional partners without having direct reports.

Location. United States (Remote). Travel to U.S. factory, integration, and customer sites as needed to support design reviews, construction surveillance, and accreditation.

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Classified design and construction standards

  • Own physical construction and accreditation requirements for defense Galleons, including SCIFs and SAPFs under ICD 705 and the ICS 705 Technical Specifications, SAPFs under DoDM 5205.07, and collateral open-storage, closed, and discussion areas under 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM).
  • Translate those standards into design criteria, drawing notes, BOM constraints, and factory work instructions that hardware, mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing teams can build to.
  • Lead security design reviews across the Galleon family. Read and redline architectural, structural, electrical, and low-voltage drawings against ICD 705, TEMPEST, and NISPOM.
  • Define perimeter, access-control, intrusion-detection, and video requirements for secure configurations, including door, lock, and wall assemblies, STC and acoustic performance, and inspectable materials.
  • Own TEMPEST and emissions-security design input. Set red/black separation, shielding, filtering, grounding, and penetration criteria, and coordinate countermeasure reviews with customer TEMPEST authorities.
  • Specify Protected Distribution Systems where a Galleon or site requires them and inspect against the applicable CNSSI standard.
  • Build a repeatable secure-Galleon configuration so accreditation is a productized path, not a one-off for every build.

Accreditation and government liaison

  • Serve as Armada’s liaison to Accrediting Officials, Special Security Officers, Facility Security Officers, DCSA Industrial Security Representatives, and customer security staff.
  • Author and maintain Construction Security Plans, Fixed Facility Checklists, inspectable-materials lists, TEMPEST questionnaires, and accreditation submittals.
  • Plan and run construction surveillance, site inspections, and quality assurance on factory, integration, and customer-site work. Hold general contractors, integrators, and internal build teams to the CSP.
  • Drive accreditation from design approval through inspection, remediation, and operational accreditation. Own the punch list.
  • Support capture and proposal teams on DD-254, contract security classification specifications, and physical-security volumes so bids do not promise a configuration that cannot be accredited.

Program execution

  • Own the security workstream on defense Galleon programs. Set milestones, dependencies, and risks against hardware design, factory slot, shipment, and customer required-accreditation dates.
  • Partner with Large Form Factor and Edge Hardware leads, deployment, logistics, and federal mission teams so security requirements are in the design before steel is cut.
  • Stand up the operating rhythm for classified builds: design gates, inspection hold points, documentation control, and lessons learned into the next hull.
  • Author and maintain Armada's internal physical-security policies and standards for classified builds, and mentor engineering, manufacturing, and deployment teams so secure-build expertise scales across the company.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship.
  • Active U.S. Secret clearance required.
  • Bachelor's degree and 12+ years (or Master's degree and 8+ years) in physical security, industrial security, or secure-facility construction, with at least 5 years hands-on in design, build, and accreditation of SCIFs, SAPFs, or collateral open-storage areas.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply ICD 705 Technical Specifications to construction drawings and field conditions, not just cite them.
  • Working knowledge of 32 CFR Part 117 physical safeguards and of DoDM 5205.07 as it applies to SAPF construction and accreditation.
  • Experience as the technical interface to an Accrediting Official, Cognizant Security Office, or DCSA representative through accreditation.
  • Experience authoring Construction Security Plans and fixed-facility or equivalent accreditation packages.
  • Ability to read construction documents and reject noncompliant details on walls, doors, penetrations, power, grounding, and electronic security systems.
  • Experience with access control, intrusion detection, and alarm monitoring on accredited spaces (UL 2050 or equivalent).
  • Track record of driving a build to a date with engineers, contractors, and government security staff in the same room.
  • Recognized subject-matter expert who has set physical-security standards or policy for an organization and persuaded diverse senior internal and government stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in Business Systems, Enterprise Applications, or related roles with increasing scope.
  • Platform-agnostic technical fluency in how enterprise systems work: relational database structures, data flows, API and webhook integration patterns, static vs. dynamic configuration, and how upstream changes propagate downstream. The right candidate can describe any enterprise system — regardless of whether they’ve used it before — in terms of its underlying data model and CRUD operations.
  • Ability to read (not necessarily write) JavaScript and Apex code: you need to understand what custom logic is doing and assess compatibility with proposed changes, not just know it exists.
  • Demonstrated experience owning and scaling core systems for G&A and/or Finance functions.
  • Solid integration and data fluency: APIs, iPaaS tools (e.g., Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft), data quality concepts, and reporting infrastructure.
  • Strong change management instincts: you bring stakeholders along, drive adoption, and create durable operating habits.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management — able to translate between business outcomes and technical implementation, facilitate cross-functional trade-off conversations, and influence without authority.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for and working knowledge of AI/LLM tooling — and a track record of helping teams actually adopt new tools, not just deploy them.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or implementing enterprise AI enablement programs (tool stack, training, workflow redesign).
  • Familiarity with GTM tooling (CRM, CPQ, forecasting) and/or R&D/engineering systems at a level sufficient to establish standards and ensure interoperability.
  • Experience with revenue workflows and controls (billing, collections, revenue recognition concepts).
  • Comfort prototyping or validating logic using SQL and/or scripting, or deep partnership with technical teams to do so.
  • Experience implementing security and compliance controls across business systems (audit readiness, access governance).
  • Relevant certifications (nice-to-have): NetSuite, Workday, Rippling, iPaaS platform certs.

Citizenship Requirements

For select roles, due to the nature of our clientele and the technologies involved, there may be specific nationality or citizenship indicated in the required qualifications section. These roles may involve access to sensitive information that is subject to export control regulations or other legal restrictions. In such cases, employment offers will be contingent upon your ability to comply with these requirements.

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the starting base salary range for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits (details available upon request).

We use a geographic pay structure based on cost-of-labor markets.

  • Tier 1 (e.g., SF Bay Area, NYC, Seattle): $187,500 - $234,370
  • Tier 2 (most U.S. metro areas): $163,040 - $203,800
  • Tier 3 (other cities): $154,890 - $193,610

Final compensation will be determined by experience, scope, and level, and may vary from the posted range.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary and equity
  • Medical, dental, and vision (subsidized cost)
  • Health savings accounts (HSA), flexible spending accounts (FSA), and dependent care FSAs (DCFSA)
  • Retirement plan options, including 401(k) and Roth 401(k)
  • Unlimited paid time off (PTO)
  • 14 paid company holidays per year
Compensation
$163,040—$203,800 USD

You're a Great Fit if You're

  • A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge
  • A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company
  • A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda
  • Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you

Equal Opportunity Statement

Unsolicited Resumes and Candidates

Experience with Linux-based infrastructure software, OS rollout and image management, kernel or driver interactions, firmware lifecycle, and hardware bring-up workflows.

  • Strong understanding of data center networking technologies and protocols, such as Ethernet, InfiniBand, RDMA, and fabric-level manageability. Experience with complex accelerator-based systems, including GPUs, DPUs, FPGAs, custom silicon, or other high-performance computing systems.

  • Experience crafting software intended for open source release, including API stability, modularity, documentation, community usability, and clean separation between shared software and deployment-specific integrations.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly as an engineering multiplier for coding, test generation, debugging, build iteration, and documentation.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, enabling clear explanation of complex hardware/software tradeoffs to engineering leaders, customers, partners, and executives.

  • Deep experience with rack- or cluster-scale systems spanning compute, networking, storage, accelerators, firmware, and infra management as one operational domain. Skilled at finding simple, durable abstractions in complex systems to align teams, customers, and long-term direction.

About the company

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and have since expanded into several other assets. We are also focused on incubating protocols that can support both tokenized real-world assets and traditional crypto.

Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the Role

We're looking for a Compliance Manager to lead and strengthen our monitoring and investigations program across both fiat and on-chain activity. You'll own transaction monitoring, secondary market and trade surveillance, investigations, and regulatory reporting, and you'll be a key partner to Legal, Product, Engineering, and Operations as we scale.

This role suits a hands-on investigator who's equally comfortable tracing funds through a blockchain explorer, analyzing trading patterns for manipulation, and writing a SAR narrative that holds up to regulatory scrutiny.

Responsibilities

  • Own the day-to-day transaction monitoring program for fiat and digital asset flows, including alert review, escalation, and disposition.
  • Design, tune, and document monitoring rules and scenarios based on the firm's risk assessment, typologies, and emerging threats.
  • Use blockchain analytics tools to assess wallet exposure, counterparty risk, and illicit-finance indicators such as sanctions, mixers, darknet markets, scams, and ransomware.
  • Track alert volumes, false-positive rates, and SLAs, and drive improvements in efficiency and coverage.
  • Build and run surveillance for trading activity on primary and secondary markets, including on-chain transfers, DEX/CEX activity, and OTC flows.
  • Detect and investigate potential market abuse, including wash trading, spoofing, layering, front-running, pump-and-dump schemes, and insider trading.
  • Work with Engineering and Data teams on surveillance tooling, data pipelines, and alert logic.
  • Maintain reporting procedures, quality control checks, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Support regulatory exams, independent audits, and responses to regulator inquiries.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in financial crimes compliance, with significant hands-on work in investigations, AML/BSA, and transaction monitoring.
  • Demonstrated experience with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis (Reactor, KYT), TRM Labs, or Elliptic, and the ability to trace funds independently on-chain.
  • Strong working knowledge of the BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, FinCEN guidance, and OFAC sanctions requirements.
  • A track record of writing high-quality SAR narratives and investigation reports.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work with large datasets and spot anomalous patterns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and the ability to handle sensitive matters with discretion.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with trade surveillance or market abuse detection at a broker-dealer, exchange, ATS, or digital asset trading venue.
  • Familiarity with securities regulations (SEC, FINRA) and how they apply to tokenized assets or digital securities.
  • Experience building or scaling a monitoring program at a high-growth fintech or crypto company.
  • Experience managing or mentoring analysts.
  • Certifications such as CAMS, CCAS, CFE, or CCI.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including but not limited to salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — We are well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation.
  • Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO).
  • Remote-first team across many countries — You will be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices.
  • A+ colleagues — Our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap.
  • Best-in-class investors — We are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures.

  • Help lenders, appraisers and other industry users with account access and system questions.

Most of the people we hire for this team will have a mortgage or real estate background. If this describes you, tell us about it in your application.
  • Three or more years of mortgage or real estate experience. Examples are loan officer, loan processor, underwriter, closer, post-closing, mortgage servicing, loss mitigation, mortgage call center, title and escrow, or licensed real estate agent.

jobs.description:
The bright side of mortgages

nesto is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at:

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

About the role

At nesto, we are building Maestro: an AI platform that makes mortgage professionals dramatically more productive across sales, underwriting, and loan servicing. This is not "AI theater"— Maestro is already live, actively assisting underwriters with real files today.

As the Product Manager for the AI Platform, you will help turn this early proof-of-concept into the platform that defines AI-augmented lending in Canada. You will sit at the intersection of complex operational workflows, machine learning, and real mortgage expertise to turn hard problems into shipped product.

Why nesto’s approach to AI is different:

  • We sit where the work happens: We have direct access to the workflows, policies, and expert feedback inside real mortgage operations across the full lending journey.
  • Built for a regulated industry: Most AI companies build isolated demos or point solutions. We embed AI directly into production, continuously learning from human underwriter judgment.
  • End-to-end integration: We don't just solve one piece of the puzzle; we connect the full lending stack to make AI practically and systemically useful.

What you'll be doing here

  • Turn complex operational reality into clear PRDs, decision logic, and shipped product
  • Work closely with ML, engineering, underwriting ops, and business stakeholders to define and deliver the roadmap
  • Define and improve the metrics that matter: throughput, time-to-decision, accuracy, and capacity gained
  • Build tight feedback loops between AI output and expert human judgment
  • Keep execution moving in a high-ambiguity, high-accountability environment
  • Stay ahead of how AI is reshaping mortgage origination and bring informed recommendations to the roadmap
  • Share what you discover — how you work should make the people around you better

Who we're looking for

The profile.

  • 3-5 years of experience in consulting or a high-ownership product role in a complex environment
  • Ability to write clearly, think structurally, and go deep on systems, data, and edge cases
  • Comfortable operating without perfect inputs — you find the truth, make the call, and drive the work forward
  • Proven, active fluency with AI tools across your PM workflow: discovery, testing, documentation, analysis, and measurement.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-experts in Product and Engineering

Preferred but not a must

  • Mortgage or regulated financial services experience — curiosity, rigor, and execution matter more
  • Familiarity with LOS systems, origination platforms, or lending technology
  • Exposure to AI or ML-assisted decisioning, document intelligence, or automation in a financial services context
  • Familiarity with broker and advisor-facing workflows and the nuances of supported versus self-serve client journeys

Interview process

How we get to know each other.

  • Recruiter Screen – 30 minutes
  • Discovery Call with Director of Product – 30 minutes
  • Take-home Assignment followed by Presentation and Q&A – 60 minutes
  • Final Stakeholder Interview – 45 minutes
  • Criminal Record and Reference Checks + Offer

Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

  • Competitive Rewards — Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.
  • Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.
  • Time to Recharge — Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.
  • Planning for the Future — RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.
  • Family Support — Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.
  • Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.
  • Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.


Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, we are committed to working with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Operations Associate (Hiring or Client Delivery)
jobs.excerpt: Grow our AI image service. The roleWe are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency.
jobs.description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

    1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
    2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
    3. Strong written English.
    4. Based in Romania.
    5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1500 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

Film any everyday task with your hands in shot, and say out loud what you're doing as you do it.

Steps

  1. Prop your phone or hang it round your neck so your hands are in shot

  2. Start recording in Kled and begin the task

  3. Say what you are doing as you do it, 'now I'm loosening this screw', 'this bit always sticks'

  4. Keep going to the end without stopping the recording

  • Do not narrate afterwards, talk while you work

jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Telematics Business Unit — the company's oldest business line and the core of its revenue — is looking for a Principal Product Manager to take on a highly strategic, commercially-oriented mandate that cuts across the entire BU. In this role, you'll move fluidly between influencing company-wide strategic initiatives and hands-on building with engineering, reporting directly to the leader of the Telematics Business Unit.

This role exists to drive two things in parallel: step-function improvement in the core telematics business, and new, adjacent product bets that grow out of our core vehicle gateway (VG) products. You'll act as a single-threaded owner on cross-cutting initiatives forming your own hypotheses and business cases, then building and shipping alongside engineering to prove them out.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US, based in the Eastern Time Zone.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Own cross-cutting initiatives that drive step function business & commercial impact for the entire Telematics business unit, working directly with the head of Telematics and with our GTM & field leaders.
  • Identify, scope, and incubate new product bets adjacent to our core telematics and vehicle gateway products — forming hypotheses, building business cases, and, once validated, pairing with a small engineering pods to prototype and get in front of real customers.
  • Operate as a deep individual contributor on highly ambiguous, complex problems — this is a path for someone who wants to stay hands-on.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Product management experience in B2B (ideally enterprise B2B), with direct, hands-on familiarity working with field, go-to-market, and sales teams, and finding product-market fit for a B2B SaaS product.
  • A track record of taking a product from 0 to 1 (or 1 to 10) in a B2B environment — you've built from a blank sheet of paper, not just optimized an existing roadmap.
  • Strong commercial and business judgment — comfortable sizing a market opportunity and building a business case from first principles.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to prototype and build quickly.
  • No deep telematics domain expertise required — you'll build that on the job.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Former founder or other high-ownership, self-starter experience.
  • Experience in a business with some physical-world tangibility, similar to Samsara's own focus on physical operations.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$137,200—$245,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

    1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
    2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
    3. Strong written English.
    4. Based in Indonesia.
    5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1000 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

Landmark Ventures is seeking a highly motivated, resourceful, technically capable, and detail-oriented Account Executive to join the Marketing team within our Business Development Advisory practice.

This is a high-output, execution-focused role for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment and enjoys combining research, technology, data, AI, communication, and problem-solving.

The Account Executive will help manage outreach and marketing campaigns across multiple clients, own lead generation and prospect research, maintain high standards of data quality, and support client-facing initiatives and strategic projects, including in-person executive events.

On any given day, you may move between building a targeted prospect list, researching executives and companies, using AI tools to accelerate research and content development, managing outreach campaigns, working within CRM and prospecting platforms, responding to client requests, preparing reports, and supporting an upcoming event.

Success in this role requires more than strong communication skills. We are looking for someone who can learn quickly, leverage technology and AI effectively, execute at a high level, manage significant detail, prioritize competing deadlines, and independently solve problems without sacrificing accuracy.

Key Responsibilities:

Campaign Management & Execution
  • Manage and coordinate outreach campaigns across multiple clients and initiatives.
  • Assess markets, companies, and decision-makers based on specific client objectives.
  • Build highly targeted prospect and account lists.
  • Coordinate outreach efforts and help maximize engagement through thoughtful, effective email communication.
  • Track campaign activity and identify opportunities to improve targeting and execution.
  • Manage multiple concurrent workstreams while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
Research & Strategic Thinking
  • Develop a strong understanding of each client's business, competitive positioning, technology, target markets, and key stakeholders.
  • Research industries, companies, executives, use cases, applications, and emerging market developments.
  • Translate broad client objectives into actionable research and prospecting strategies.
  • Connect information across different sources to identify relevant opportunities, relationships, and decision-makers.
  • Exercise judgment when information is incomplete rather than relying solely on predetermined instructions.
Lead Generation & Data Management
  • Independently identify and generate new contacts, accounts, and opportunities on behalf of clients and Landmark events.
  • Conduct executive-level prospecting using LinkedIn, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesforce, and other research tools.
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and actionable prospect and campaign data.
  • Identify and resolve duplicate, incomplete, outdated, or inaccurate contact information.
  • Take ownership of data cleanliness and quality across assigned projects.
AI, LLM & Technology Proficiency
  • Demonstrate strong working proficiency with leading LLM and generative AI tools, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms.
  • Use AI effectively to accelerate research, synthesize information, analyze companies and markets, develop prospecting strategies, improve written communications, and increase overall productivity.
  • Write effective prompts and iterate on AI outputs to produce accurate, useful, and contextually relevant work.
  • Understand that AI-generated output requires human judgment. Independently validate facts, identify potential errors or hallucinations, and ensure client-facing work meets Landmark's standards before use.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI, automation, and technology to improve existing workflows and increase both speed and quality of execution.
  • Become highly proficient with Landmark's technology and prospecting stack.
  • Use Excel and other tools to organize, analyze, clean, and manage prospect and campaign data.
  • Learn unfamiliar platforms and workflows quickly.
  • Independently troubleshoot routine technology, data, and workflow challenges.
Client & Team Support
  • Support strategic client projects and in-person executive events.
  • Communicate professionally and effectively with internal leadership, colleagues, clients, and senior external stakeholders.
  • Understand the nuances of client interactions and exercise sound judgment around communication and follow-through.
  • Take ownership of deliverables from initial assignment through completion.
What We're Looking For:
High-Output Execution
You are comfortable managing a significant volume of work across multiple clients and priorities. You can move quickly without allowing accuracy or attention to detail to deteriorate.

Technical & AI Aptitude
You are highly comfortable with technology and actively use AI and LLM tools to work more effectively. You understand how to use these tools to accelerate your work without outsourcing your judgment to them. When you encounter an unfamiliar platform, incomplete information, or unexpected problem, your instinct is to investigate, experiment, troubleshoot, and find a path forward.

Resourcefulness & Independent Problem-Solving
You do not need a playbook for every situation. You can take an objective, determine what information or tools you need, make reasonable decisions, and move the work forward. You know when to solve something independently and when an issue warrants escalation.

Research & Critical Thinking
You are curious and analytical. You can understand a client's business, identify relevant companies and executives, synthesize information from multiple sources, and translate broad objectives into targeted action.

Ownership & Urgency
You take responsibility for outcomes, not simply assigned tasks. You proactively identify what needs to happen next, communicate when something is at risk, and consistently follow through.

Attention to Detail
You notice things others miss. Whether reviewing contact data, evaluating AI-generated research, preparing a client deliverable, or launching an outreach campaign, you maintain a high standard for accuracy and quality.

Prioritization & Adaptability
You can calmly assess competing priorities, determine what matters most, and adjust quickly when deadlines or client needs change.

Communication & High EQ
You are an excellent written and verbal communicator who can work effectively with colleagues, clients, and senior executives. You understand nuance, communicate professionally, and know when to ask questions versus when to make a reasonable judgment and move forward.

Growth Mindset & Coachability
You welcome direct feedback, learn from mistakes, and apply what you learn. You are motivated by increasing responsibility and becoming an increasingly valuable contributor to the team.

Desired Experience & Proficiencies
  • 1 to 4 years of relevant experience in business development, account management, marketing, sales, research, client services, consulting, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated proficiency using LLMs and generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or comparable platforms in a professional or academic setting.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with LinkedIn and sophisticated online research is essential.
  • Experience with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar CRM and prospecting platforms is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies, software, and workflows.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Experience working under tight deadlines and managing multiple simultaneous
  • priorities.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Prior SDR or traditional sales experience is not required. We place significant value on demonstrated intellectual curiosity, technical and AI aptitude, resourcefulness, execution ability, critical thinking, and attention to detail.

The Environment

Landmark is a high-energy, entrepreneurial environment where priorities can move quickly and expectations are high. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys that pace and takes pride in producing a significant volume of high-quality work. We expect our team to embrace new technology and continuously look for smarter ways to work. AI and LLMs are increasingly important tools in how we research, communicate, analyze information, and execute for clients. The expectation is not simply to use these tools, but to understand how to use them thoughtfully, efficiently, and responsibly. We believe in giving talented people opportunities to grow. Team members who demonstrate strong execution, judgment, ownership, and initiative will have opportunities to take on increasingly significant client responsibilities and contribute across the firm. We are looking for a key addition to a talented, driven, and collaborative team who wants to learn quickly, take on meaningful responsibility, and grow professionally.

About Landmark Ventures
Landmark Ventures is a strategic advisory platform operating at the intersection of investment banking, business development, and curated executive events. For more than 20 years, Landmark has worked with leading public companies, investment funds, and growth-oriented private companies.

The firm brings together deep market insight and extensive executive relationships across enterprise software, cybersecurity, IoT, industrial technology, artificial intelligence, sports, marketing technology, and digital media. A significant portion of Landmark's work involves cross-border opportunities and relationships across the United States, Europe, Asia, and Israel.

Landmark Ventures is committed to building a diverse team that brings valuable perspectives to our work.
