  • Experience hosting private events or community gatherings in the region.

DPIAs and privacy by design

Data subject rights requests

Personal data breaches

Supplier and DPA reviews

Governance, advisory and awareness

  • Support ROPA, data mapping, policy updates and privacy champion engagement

  • 1–3 years' practical data protection, compliance, legal operations or privacy experience

  • Strong drafting, organisation, stakeholder management and document-review skills

  • Ability to manage deadlines, sensitive information and competing requests across multiple businesses, and maintain registers, trackers, MI and audit evidence

Desirable

  • IAPP CIPP/E, CIPM, BCS or equivalent privacy qualification (or active progress towards one)

  • Experience in professional services, financial services or a multi-entity group

  • Exposure to DPA negotiation, international transfers, AI governance or privacy-by-design reviews

  • Familiarity with SharePoint, workflow tools and data-mapping or privacy-management platforms

What we offer

  • A collaborative, purpose-driven working environment within a growing Group

  • Exposure to a broad range of data protection matters across multiple business lines

  • The opportunity to work closely with experienced legal and compliance professionals

Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning.     5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

    1. 1300 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

      2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
      3. Paid sick leave.
      4. A health allowance.
      5. A coworking allowance.
    4. Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

Everything you build feeds a high-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency distributed platform — voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI combined — so you think in latency budgets, throughput, and efficiency, not just features. Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward.

What you'll own. Windows native driver (WASAPI, virtual audio devices, kernel-adjacent hooks) · real-time bidirectional audio routing · the user-space app (audio router, DOM scraper, MCP server) · the desktop-to-cloud path onto the event bus (NATS-class, WebSocket) under a sub-300ms budget · AV co-existence and mass-deployment · your committed timelines.

Who you are. Self-starter, hacker, grit. You consider yourself exceptional at the systems level and can show it. You love new technology, adapt fast when it changes, demonstrate ideas with working code, and use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity. Team player who makes and hits committed timelines. Loves solving the problems nobody else can — and winning.

Requirements

  • 8+ years systems / native development; shipped a Windows desktop agent at real scale (>10k seats) with audio.
  • Strong C/C++ — mandatory. Strong Go for the service side — mandatory.
  • Comfortable building and interacting with drivers — virtual audio devices, virtual microphones/speakers, WASAPI / Core Audio, kernel-adjacent hooks.
  • Real-time audio pipelines under a sub-300ms budget — buffering, resampling, drift, glitch-free capture/playback.
  • Understands high-efficiency systems end-to-end — event-driven architecture, pub/sub, WebSocket streaming, and what state, race conditions, and locking mean at the native layer (lock-free audio buffers, real-time threads, priority inversion).

CentralReach is a leading provider of autism and IDD care software for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), multidisciplinary therapy, and special education. Trusted by more than 200,000 users, we enable therapy providers, educators, and employers to scale the way they deliver ABA and related therapies with innovative technology, market-leading industry expertise, and world-class customer satisfaction.

CentralReach's Data Products team is seeking a Senior Sales Consultant to own the technical side of every data opportunity we pursue. You will partner with Account Managers across our existing provider base and with new business Account Executives to understand customer data problems, design credible solutions and lead the technical evaluation from first discovery through close. You should be equally comfortable discussing business outcomes with a CFO as you are discussing data architecture with a head of data.

The Data Products team is a startup operating inside CentralReach. We are establishing our own playbook and processes as we build. We are looking for someone with low patience for heavy process and a high ownership mentality. You challenge weak requirements, you kill poorly scoped evaluations early and you do not wait for a playbook to be handed to you. You will have meaningful influence over product direction and the data sales process.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Own the technical portion of the sales process from discovery through technical validation and close
  • Partner with Account Managers and new business Account Executives on account strategy, qualification, deal planning and stakeholder management
  • Work with the VP of Data Products to evaluate the existing customer base, identify which accounts are ready for which products and help build target lists with Account Managers
  • Lead technical discovery to uncover the customer's architecture, workflows, pain points, decision criteria and business objectives, then translate what you find into clear solution designs across Advanced BI, Data Warehouse, APIs and Benchmarking
  • Deliver tailored demos that connect capability to measurable customer outcomes rather than scripted product tours
  • Scope and run proofs of concept and technical evaluations with success criteria defined up front, and drive each one to a yes or a no on a timeline
  • Build and defend the business case, including TCO and ROI comparisons against a customer building the capability in-house
  • Map each customer to the right product for their current stage and name what they will need at the next one
  • Handle technical objections spanning architecture, security, data access, scalability, deployment, APIs, entitlements and integration, and test what competitors actually deliver rather than absorbing what prospects believe they deliver
  • Create reusable evaluation plans, ROI models, solution patterns and technical collateral that let the broader sales organization participate
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering from customer conversations, competitive evaluations and recurring technical requirements, and support handoff after close so expectations, architecture decisions and success criteria are documented
  • Use AI tooling (LLMs, code copilots, semantic search) as a core part of your workflow. This is how the team works, not a nice-to-have

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years in sales engineering, solutions consulting or pre-sales architecture supporting a technical B2B product in data infrastructure, analytics, developer tools, observability or enterprise AI
  • A track record of evaluations that ended in a decision rather than in an indefinite pilot, and of deals you can point to as technically won
  • Experience selling to data and engineering leaders alongside business buyers such as CEOs, CFOs and COOs
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex methodology to a non-technical executive without losing precision
  • Comfortable in a team still building its processes, with a bias toward action

Commercial Judgment

  • Willingness to disqualify and to challenge weak requirements before an evaluation gets scoped
  • Understanding of how architecture and delivery decisions affect pricing, packaging and renewal outcomes, including consumption-based models
  • Sound instincts about where technical effort is worth spending across several live opportunities at once
  • Low ego, with real curiosity about how customers work rather than about what the product does

Contratar profissional para atuar no planejamento, acompanhamento, coordenação e orientação de projetos institucionais e estratégicos, promovendo a adoção de boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos, governança e gestão de portfólio, apoiando equipes com diferentes níveis de maturidade organizacional.

  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo dos projetos, desde a iniciação até o encerramento.
  • Planejar, acompanhar e monitorar projetos institucionais, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos, escopo, qualidade, orçamento, recursos, riscos e resultados.

The candidate must be comfortable actively monitoring and engaging on Reddit and YouTube while operating in the Purdue Global voice. The candidate must be ready to hit the ground running, and juggle multiple projects at once.

    • Monitor conversations and trends within relevant online education and career communities.

    • Engage in authentic, non-promotional discussions to build karma and credibility.

    • Respond to questions and comments to position Purdue Global as an expert who is an empathetic and informed participant.

    • Ability to identify and analyze emerging YouTube trends, translating insights into actionable content strategies.

  • Content Execution & Adaptation

    • Collaborate with the content and SEO teams to adapt Purdue Global content into Reddit-friendly or YouTube formats.

    • Draft and schedule posts that align with the brand’s tone and strategic priorities.

    • Coordinate and support live Reddit activations, such as AMAs, with internal subject matter experts.

    • Deliver monthly insights highlighting wins, risks, and learnings to inform ongoing strategy.

    • Consistent participation in high-visibility discussions relevant to online education.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Journeyman Asset Manager to oversee IT asset lifecycle management, equipment accountability, inventory accuracy, maintenance records, audit support, and disposition activities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Journeyman Asset Manager to oversee IT asset lifecycle management, equipment accountability, inventory accuracy, maintenance records, audit support, and disposition activities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Asset Manager will support Hand Receipt Holders and the USMEPCOM Property Book Office in maintaining accurate records for Government-Furnished Property and other assets covered by the task order. This role will coordinate physical inventories, reconcile discrepancies, maintain maintenance and support agreements, prepare disposition packages, and produce Asset Audit Reports and Monthly Status Report inputs.

The successful candidate will work with Government property personnel, infrastructure teams, site personnel, procurement, finance, configuration management, cybersecurity, and program leadership to maintain complete and traceable asset records throughout the lifecycle.

This position is remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area. Travel or on-site support may be required for physical inventories, site validations, equipment transfers, or disposition activities.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Asset Manager will:

  • Manage IT assets throughout acquisition, receipt, assignment, deployment, maintenance, transfer, refresh, recovery, and disposition.
  • Maintain accurate records for hardware, software, appliances, network equipment, peripherals, and Government-Furnished Property covered by the task order.
  • Support primary Hand Receipt Holders in accordance with applicable DoD property-accountability requirements.
  • Coordinate with the USMEPCOM Property Book Office on property records, accountability, inventory, transfers, discrepancies, and disposition.
  • Maintain asset identifiers, serial numbers, model information, ownership, assigned users, custodians, locations, status, condition, warranty, and lifecycle dates.
  • Ensure asset repositories and systems of record contain current, complete, consistent, and traceable information.
  • Reconcile asset-management records with configuration-management, procurement, shipping, receiving, deployment, maintenance, and service records.
  • Investigate missing, duplicate, incorrectly assigned, retired, or otherwise discrepant asset records.
  • Coordinate corrective actions with Hand Receipt Holders, site personnel, technical teams, logistics personnel, vendors, and Government property personnel.
  • Plan, coordinate, and support physical asset inventories and audits at USMEPCOM and supported locations.
  • Develop inventory schedules, audit instructions, tracking sheets, evidence requirements, and reconciliation procedures.
  • Validate equipment existence, location, serial number, assignment, operational status, condition, and accountable custodian.
  • Document inventory results, discrepancies, corrective actions, responsible parties, deadlines, and resolution evidence.
  • Prepare formal Asset Audit Reports documenting scope, methodology, results, discrepancies, corrective actions, and recommendations.
  • Track audit findings and inventory discrepancies through validated closure.
  • Maintain maintenance agreements, warranties, licenses, support contracts, renewal dates, service coverage, and vendor contact information.
  • Identify expiring agreements, warranty gaps, unsupported assets, obsolete equipment, and upcoming renewal or refresh requirements.
  • Coordinate with procurement and financial personnel on maintenance renewals, support agreements, warranty coverage, and replacement planning.
  • Support lifecycle planning and equipment-refresh activities by identifying asset age, condition, support status, compatibility, and replacement needs.
  • Maintain records for equipment installations, moves, additions, changes, relocations, transfers, and removals.
  • Coordinate asset-record updates following equipment refreshes, site relocations, replacements, repairs, or configuration changes.
  • Prepare and maintain disposition packages for obsolete, excess, surplus, damaged, or no-longer-needed equipment, hardware, and software.
  • Follow USMEPCOM Property Book Office guidance for return, transfer, sanitization, disposal, and disposition of Government property.
  • Verify required approvals, data-sanitization evidence, transfer documentation, shipping records, and disposition records.
  • Ensure repositories of record are updated following transfer, return, retirement, or disposition.
  • Maintain documentation supporting asset accountability, chain of custody, property transfers, auditability, and record retention.
  • Develop asset metrics covering inventory accuracy, audit completion, discrepancies, corrective actions, refresh status, support coverage, and dispositions.
  • Prepare asset-management inputs for Monthly Status Reports and other Government reporting requirements.
  • Identify recurring recordkeeping problems, accountability gaps, process weaknesses, and opportunities to improve asset controls.
  • Develop and maintain asset-management procedures, standard operating procedures, templates, checklists, user guides, and reporting tools.
  • Support integration of asset-management activities with configuration, change, incident, request, procurement, financial, and cybersecurity processes.
  • Protect sensitive asset and property information in accordance with applicable Government requirements.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Active Secret clearance or higher.

Bachelor’s degree or a relevant technical degree.

Minimum of 5 years of relevant IT asset management, property management, logistics, inventory control, management analysis, or equipment-accountability experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing Government-Furnished Property in a federal or Department of Defense environment.
  • Experience supporting Hand Receipt Holders and Government Property Book Offices.
  • Knowledge of DoD property-accountability, inventory, audit, transfer, and disposition requirements.
  • Experience conducting physical inventories and reconciling results against authoritative asset records.
  • Experience developing Asset Audit Reports, discrepancy reports, corrective-action trackers, and Monthly Status Report inputs.
  • Experience maintaining maintenance agreements, warranties, licenses, support contracts, and renewal schedules.
  • Experience preparing disposition packages for obsolete, excess, surplus, damaged, or no-longer-needed equipment.
  • Experience maintaining chain-of-custody, transfer, sanitization, shipping, return, and disposal records.
  • Experience using ServiceNow Hardware Asset Management, Software Asset Management, configuration-management databases, or comparable asset-management platforms.
  • Experience with automated inventory, discovery, barcode, RFID, or asset-reconciliation tools.
  • Familiarity with ITIL asset management, configuration management, change management, and service-request practices.
  • Certified Hardware Asset Management Professional, Certified Software Asset Manager, Certified IT Asset Manager, ITIL Foundation, or comparable certification.
  • Experience coordinating asset activities with procurement, finance, logistics, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and configuration-management teams.
  • Strong attention to detail, data-reconciliation, documentation, audit-support, organizational, and stakeholder-coordination skills.
  • Ability to travel to supported locations for physical inventories, asset validations, transfers, or disposition activities when required.

It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.

jobs.excerpt: Grow our AI image service. The roleWe are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency.
jobs.description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

  1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
  2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
  3. Strong written English.
  4. Based in North Macedonia.
  5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1500 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: Hi 👋 I'm Emily, Director of Growth Marketing at Pinpoint.
jobs.description:
Hi 👋 I'm Emily, Director of Growth Marketing at Pinpoint.

We build and sell software that helps in house recruitment teams attract, hire and onboard the right people. We're a team of about 100 across the UK and the US, with a mature product, strong product market fit and happy customers.

Pinpoint ships fast. Our product team releases new features every few weeks, and some of them change how we talk about the whole product. That pace is one of our biggest advantages, but only if customers, prospects, and our own team actually hear about it. Today most launches get positioned after they've gone live, so good work lands late and quietly.

We need one person to close that gap and be the connection between Product and the rest of the company. That's why we're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager. You'll know what's coming before it ships, decide how each feature is positioned, and make sure every launch is ready on day one. That way Sales can sell it and customers adopt it.

What you should know up front
  • Fully remote and UK based, with London coworking sessions, quarterly strategy days, and the occasional industry event.
  • You'll join a marketing team of 6, including you, covering growth, content, customer marketing, events, and marketing ops. You report to me, and as our sole dedicated product marketer, you'll set how product marketing works here.
  • The pace is the hard part. Something meaningful ships most weeks, so you'll be working ahead of the roadmap, chasing dates and detail with product managers, and deciding which launches get a big push and which get a light touch.
  • The team runs the website, customer campaigns, and events, and Sales owns the deck. You set the positioning and the plan (what's launching, what we call it, why it matters, and who does what), and make the core launch pieces yourself, from the launch copy and one pager to the enablement pack and whatever else the campaign needs.
  • We're AI forward. Everyone here uses AI every day to research, write, and build faster, and we'd expect you to bring that into how you plan and make launches.
  • This isn't a strategy only role. If you're used to a big team doing the making for you, it won't suit you.
  • Our values actually matter here. We hire people who reflect them in how they work, collaborate, and make decisions.

What you'll do

  • Feature level positioning. Own how we describe every significant feature: what it is, who it's for, the problem it solves, what we call it and how it compares. Bring a clear recommendation to Product and leadership, take their input, then make the call, and keep it consistent everywhere it shows up.
  • Outcome based stories. Translate what we ship into the results customers get, tying features together to show what's possible, backed by proof points and customer stories.
  • The Product and Marketing relationship. Sit close enough to Product that nothing is ever released as a surprise. Live in the roadmap in Fibery, read the specs and early designs, keep dates honest with product managers, and decide which launches get a big push and which get a light touch.
  • Launch planning and execution. Plan and run each launch with the rest of marketing: agree the customer adoption plan with our customer marketer, brief content on feature and integrations pages, and line up events, podcasts and social. Build the core launch assets yourself, then keep good features in market so they don't fade after a week.
  • Sales enablement. Give Sales what they need to sell what's new: messaging, talk tracks and enablement packs, plus briefs to keep the sales deck current.
  • Company wide product awareness. Make sure everyone who talks to customers (Sales, CS, Implementation, Support) knows what's shipped, why it matters and how to talk about it.
  • Product messaging across every asset. Be the source of truth for product messaging. After every priority release, flag what's out of date and get it fixed, briefing the owner or doing it yourself.
  • Making the pieces. Make what plays to your strengths yourself (product video, social, ad creative, simple designs, launch copy) and brief the rest. If you're great at one of them, it's yours.

What you'll bring

  • Product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, with features positioned and launched end to end and the work to show for it.
  • Launch and campaign management experience: a track record of running launches across lots of people (product, content, sales, customer marketing), with briefs that bring the work back right first time.
  • Technical depth: comfortable getting into how the product actually works, and able to explain technical features simply to any audience.
  • Startup or scale up experience: small teams, few handoffs, and a willingness to do whatever the launch needs that week.
  • Strategist and doer in the same day: writing the positioning in the morning and making the launch banner in the afternoon, with no direct reports to hand the work to.
  • Embedded early with product teams: in the roadmap and the specs before anything ships, and trusted by product managers because their launches get better for it.
  • The knack of turning a spec, a roadmap entry or a rough demo into positioning people actually use.
  • A doer who runs with a goal: sets it up, plans it and delivers it without hand holding or a big team behind them.
  • The judgement to stop and ask why: what a launch is meant to achieve, whether it's working, and when to change course.
  • A high bar for quality. Fast matters, but what goes out has to be good, and past work shows it.
  • Writing that's a real strength: clear, simple and straight to the point. Plain copy over clever copy, fewer words over more.
  • Good taste and the skills to make things without waiting on a designer or an agency: a banner, slide, page or short video that looks right. No need to be a designer.
  • An AI forward way of working: using AI every day to research, write and make things faster, even building simple tools to make launch assets.
You may not enjoy this role if
  • You'd rather write the strategy than ship the launch
  • You need a big team, a designer or an agency to get things out the door
  • You want a predictable roadmap with launches planned months ahead
  • You don't enjoy chasing people for dates and detail
  • You can't get to London for quarterly strategy days and in person meetings

What we offer

We want Pinpoint to be the best place you've ever worked, somewhere you feel valued, supported and excited to grow. Here's what you get:
  • Comprehensive healthcare: excellent medical, dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Unlimited holidays: take the time you need to rest and recharge
  • Mental health support: unlimited, immediate access to professional counselling via Spill
  • Retirement contributions: 401k or pension contributions depending on your location
  • Remote first: work where you're most productive, with flexibility and trust as the default
  • Equity with real upside: share in the long term value you help create
  • Fully paid parental leave: up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents
  • Learning budget: annual funds for courses, books or anything that supports your growth
A detailed overview of our benefits is here.

What you're wondering

  • Who will I work with? Me, our product managers, our sales team, and the rest of marketing: customer marketing, content and growth.
  • What tools will I use? Fibery for the roadmap, Figma, Notion, Descript, Contrast for webinars, HubSpot, Webflow, Canva, Google Slides, and AI tools to move faster.
  • What does success look like in year one? Every significant launch has its positioning and plan in place before it goes live. The features you launch get adopted, AEs talk about them, and they show up in the numbers: more expansion and better retention from customers using what we've built. People across Pinpoint know what's in the product, leadership no longer gets pulled into positioning meetings, and product marketing is a function people trust.

jobs.description:
About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

Who We Are

Ema is building the next generation AI technology to empower every employee in the enterprise to be their most creative and productive. Our proprietary tech allows enterprises to delegate most repetitive tasks to Ema, the AI employee. We are founded by ex-Google, Coinbase, Okta executives and serial entrepreneurs. We’ve raised capital from notable investors such as Accel Partners, Naspers, Section32 and a host of prominent Silicon Valley Angels including Sheryl Sandberg (Facebook/Google), Divesh Makan (Iconiq Capital), Jerry Yang (Yahoo), Dustin Moskovitz (Facebook/Asana), David Baszucki (Roblox CEO) and Gokul Rajaram (Doordash, Square, Google).

Our team is a powerhouse of talent, comprising engineers from leading tech companies like Google, Microsoft Research, Facebook, Square/Block, and Coinbase. Most of our team members hail from top-tier educational institutions such as Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU and Indian Institute of Technology.

Ema is based in Silicon Valley and Bangalore, India.

Who You Are

Ema is hiring a Partner Manager to lead strategic GTM partnerships with SIs, VARs, Consulting firms, Cloud platforms, and AI ecosystem players. You will be instrumental in building and scaling a partner-led growth channel.

We’re looking for a seasoned professional with experience in developing strategic partnerships, enabling partners’ sales and technical teams, and activating GTM motion with large Tier-1 partners targeting Fortune 500 enterprises.You should have a track record of enabling large partner teams on Enterprise SaaS or AI-driven solutions and driving significant revenue through partnerships.

You will collaborate closely with the Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success team to drive Partner success, and act as the voice of the partner internally to advocate for partner needs and product feedback.

This role is ideal for you if you’re entrepreneurial, data-driven, and relationship-first. You understand that great partnerships don’t just drive revenue — they unlock new capabilities and customer value. You thrive at the intersection of strategy and execution and are energized by shaping a new category of enterprise software.

You Will

  • Identify, onboard, and grow key go-to-market (GTM) partners, including consultancies, resellers, cloud marketplaces, ISVs, and system integrators

  • Collaborate with partners to build joint value propositions and GTM plans tailored to priority industries and enterprise use cases

  • Lead partner enablement efforts, including training, certifications, and sales collateral

  • Serve as the partner’s advocate internally, sharing feedback to improve product and collaboration

  • Structure and negotiate partnership agreements, incentives, and success metrics

  • Drive pipeline through partner channels and work closely with sales teams on co-selling opportunities

  • Track joint deals, monitor partner-influenced pipeline, and measure revenue impact

  • Build and scale partner programs, including onboarding flows, partner portals, and reporting tools

  • Define partner success metrics and lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs)

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to support partner growth

  • Stay up to date on trends in enterprise AI and evolving GTM models

  • Represent the company at industry events, partner conferences, and ecosystem forums

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience in Partner managementrole at a SaaS, enterprise software, or AI company

  • Proven track record of sourcing, enabling, and scaling GTM partnerships that directly influenced sales outcomes.

  • Knowledge of partner program design, including incentives, MDF, and co-sell playbooks.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise sales motions, especially in AI and automation

  • Excellent negotiation, relationship management, and stakeholder communication skills.

  • Strategic thinker with an ability to move fast and execute in a startup environment.

Ideally, You'd Have

  • Familiarity with agentic AI, RPA, enterprise workflow automation, or LLM-based platforms.

  • Experience working with cloud hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) or consulting/SI ecosystems.

  • Prior exposure to RevOps tools like Hubspot, Salesforce or PRM systems

  • Good understanding of software development principles, data structures, and algorithms.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a strong capacity for logical thinking.

  • The ability to work collaboratively in an extremely fast-paced, startup environment.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

jobs.excerpt: About High ScaleWe’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media.
jobs.description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Sales VA who is hungry, organized, and ready to fuel our growth engine by filling the pipeline with high-quality leads.

Why This Role Matters

Pipeline, precision, and momentum are your playground. As a Sales VA, you are the first line of offense for our growth team. You aren't just an "assistant"; you are a lead generation machine. You enable our Account Executives to focus on one thing: closing deals.

By taking ownership of prospecting, CRM management, and initial outreach, you directly impact the agency's revenue. If you enjoy the thrill of the hunt, love organized data, and want to learn the inner workings of a high-performance sales organization, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Lead Generation & Prospecting

    • Research and build targeted lists of potential clients (DTC brands in fashion, beauty, and tech) using tools like Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Crunchbase.

    • Verify contact information (emails, phone numbers) to ensure low bounce rates and high deliverability.

    • Qualify leads based on specific criteria (revenue size, ad spend, industry) before adding them to the pipeline.

  2. CRM Management

    • Maintain impeccable data hygiene in our CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce). Ensure every lead, contact, and deal is updated with the correct status and notes.

    • Move prospects through the sales funnel stages based on triggers and interactions.

  3. Outreach & Appointment Setting

    • Assist with high-volume cold email and LinkedIn DM campaigns. Personalize templates to increase response rates.

    • Handle initial responses and scheduling, booking discovery calls directly onto the Sales Directors' calendars.

    • Conduct follow-ups with warm leads to ensure no opportunity falls through the cracks.

  4. Sales Admin Support

    • Prepare meeting briefs, research notes, and slide decks for upcoming sales calls.

    • Draft contracts and agreements using templates for review by the closing team.

Who You Are

  1. A Lead Gen Specialist

    • 1–3 years of experience in sales support, lead generation, or business development (BDR/SDR support).

    • Familiarity with prospecting tools (, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) is highly preferred.

  2. CRM Savvy

    • You know your way around a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive). You understand the importance of logging activity.

  3. Excellent Writer

    • Strong English proficiency (C1/C2) is required. You will be writing emails and messages on behalf of the agency. Your grammar and tone must be flawless.

  4. Organized & Relentless

    • You can handle repetitive tasks (data entry, scraping) without losing focus or accuracy.

    • You have a "hunter" mindset—you enjoy finding the right contact at a hard-to-reach company.

  5. Tech-Fluent

    • Comfortable using Google Workspace, Slack, and email automation tools (Instantly, Lemlist, etc.).

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Master the sales process and grow into a Junior Sales Rep or Business Development Representative (BDR).

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one qualified lead at a time.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT KLEDKled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.
jobs.description:
ABOUT KLED

Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.

We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.

We are a consumer application where people upload their real photos, videos, and documents and get paid continuously.

We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.

Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:

• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
• Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors

• Processed 5M uploads per day

• Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more

Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

This listing is for one paid task in the Kled app: "Log Your Fieldwork". There is no interview and no minimum hours: download the app, open the task, and you are paid per accepted submission.

What you will do

Photograph your own field notes and data logs page by page: tables of measurements, timestamps, item codes, quick sketches.

Steps

  1. Lay the page flat, well lit

  2. Photograph the whole page, uncropped and legible

  3. Upload page by page

What gets rejected

  • Do not upload typed or printed logs

  • Do not crop the page

  • Do not upload confidential work material

Pay

$0.20 per accepted page. At a typical pace of about 45 seconds per page, that is about $16 per hour. A 20-minute session of about 27 pages pays about $5.40. No fixed cap; each page is reviewed. You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).

Where and when

Open worldwide: the task runs in 100+ countries. Remote, on your own schedule. Independent contractor, piecework; this is not an employment position.

What you need

  • An iPhone running iOS 18.6 or later (the Kled app is iPhone-only right now)

  • 18 or older

  • Your phone camera, used inside the Kled app

How to start

  1. Download Kled from the App Store: (also at kled.ai/app).

  2. Create your account and open Tasks.

  3. Search "Log Your Fieldwork", read the brief and follow the on-screen steps.

  4. Submit. Accepted submissions are paid in the app.

Every submission is reviewed, and you opt in to a commercial training license on each upload; accepted submissions are licensed to AI labs. Questions: .

jobs.title: Director, Demand Generation
jobs.excerpt: KPA has spent over four decades earning a reputation as the company automotive businesses trust with compliance.
jobs.description:
KPA has spent over four decades earning a reputation as the company automotive businesses trust with compliance. More than 15,000 of them count on us to protect their people, their customers, and their operations across Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), Sales, Advertising, Privacy, and HR.

Underneath it is one conviction: that documented is not the same as safe. A binder of current paperwork has never prevented an injury, so we built the company to close that gap. Software that's always watching out, training that reaches the newest person on the floor, and 150 consultants who keep finding what actually goes wrong. We think that work is worth doing somewhere people want to be, and Built In Colorado has named KPA one of the state's Best Places to Work seven years running.

Why This Role Exists

Automotive retail is consolidating, and the groups leading it are choosing the partners they'll run on for the next decade. More of their research now starts inside AI answer engines, and KPA's growth is concentrated in those multi-rooftop groups and in clients who already trust us adding coverage. That calls for a deliberate growth model, not a busier campaign calendar.

This role sets that model. You'd own the vision and strategy for demand generation across the company: the go-to-market model Marketing, Sales, and Client Success run together, the playbook behind it, the plan and investment case for the pipeline number, and the multi-year build-out of the team, technology, and measurement that will carry it at scale. While the team help you run the engine, you decide what it's built to do, where it points, and how big it gets.

If you've built a demand function before and want to design the next one from the model up, with the mandate to make it the way the whole company grows, this is it.

The Role

The Director, Demand Generation owns KPA's demand strategy and marketing's contribution to lead pipeline and revenue. You report to the Chief Marketing Officer, sit on the marketing leadership team, and lead the demand team and its agency partners.

The mandate runs in order: make the funnel measurable, make the engine repeatable, then scale it. The team is lean, so you'll definitely be hands-on and in the trenches, and will stay close enough to the work to pressure-test it. But your leverage is the model, the people, and the decisions.

Success is measured in pipeline against the company plan, a funnel all commercial functions trust, and an engine that gets more efficient as it grows, with a clear answer to where the next dollar goes and where we should be consistently testing and learning.

What You'll Do

Set the Vision and the Go-to-Market Model

  • Define KPA's demand generation vision and multi-year strategy, and turn it into an annual plan the company aligns to: targets, budget, channel mix, and capacity.
  • Design the go-to-market model by segment: single-rooftop dealers, multi-rooftop groups, fleet and adjacent segments; new logo, account-based, and expansion. Decide which plays each gets and what each should return.
  • Own the demand playbook as a company standard: the plays, the stage definitions, and the handoffs and service levels between Marketing and Sales (and Client Success). Codify it so it outlasts the current team.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product so every launch has a pipeline plan, not just an announcement.

Own the Pipeline Number and the Investment Case

  • Own marketing's sourced and influenced pipeline and revenue targets and the forecast behind them. Report against them candidly - including when the number is short.
  • Own the demand budget and make the case for it: reverse-funnel models, scenarios, and a defensible return on every line across channels, agencies, events, and technology.
  • Represent marketing performance to the executive team and the board with numbers that hold up under questioning.

Set the Measurement Standard

  • Decide KPA's funnel definitions (lead, MQL, SAL, SQL, opportunity) and attribution approach with Revenue Operations and Sales, align the organization, and hold every team to them.
  • Move KPA from counting engagements to counting true net-new demand, and be candid with leadership about what changes when the denominator does.
  • Define the reporting the business runs on (pipeline, velocity, CAC, CPL, and payback by segment, motion, and program) and the roadmap to a proper BI layer.

Build the Engine to Scale

  • Write the multi-year build-out plan: team structure and hiring sequence, what we build in-house versus buy from agencies, and the order in which new capabilities are deployed.
  • Set the marketing technology roadmap with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations: what the stack must do at twice our size, what we consolidate, and what we retire.
  • Set the operating model for AI in demand gen, including where it helps compound output, where a person stays in the loop, and guardrails on accuracy, claims, brand voice, and data handling that a compliance company can defend.

Lead the Account-Based and Expansion Strategy

  • Set the strategy for the multi-rooftop groups consolidating the market: tiering, named-account coverage with Sales, and one coordinated marketing and SDR motion against each account.
  • Build the expansion strategy with Sales and Client Success. Growing coverage among the more than 15,000 clients who already trust KPA is the largest near-term growth lever we have.
  • With the Product, Product Marketing, Consulting, and Revenue Operations, turn KPA's field and incident data into proof the market can see: what our consultants found and the outcomes we helped prevent, stated in numbers.

Lead the Team and the Partnerships

  • Develop and retain a small team, starting with the Manager, Demand Generation and the Marketing Operations Manager. Set clear ownership, clear numbers, and a high bar for execution.
  • Direct the agency roster as the strategy owner with the CMO: set the brief and the targets, judge the work on outcomes, and decide what comes in-house.
  • Build the partnership with Sales leadership so the pipeline conversation is a working session rather than a negotiation.

What You Bring

Experience

  • 10–15 years of progressive B2B demand generation or growth marketing experience, ideally in SaaS or technology, with at least 3 years leading a team or function.
  • Demonstrated experience building a demand function and scaling it. You set the strategy, designed the model, implemented it, and hired the team, rather than inheriting one that already worked.
  • Ownership of a pipeline target and the budget behind it, defended in front of a CFO, an executive team, or a board.
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Deep Expertise: The Core of the Job

  • Go-to-market strategy. Segmentation, motion design, and channel mix, tied together by the economics: CAC, payback, pipeline coverage, and where the next dollar goes.
  • Revenue planning and measurement. Reverse-funnel planning, forecasting, funnel governance, and real command of attribution methodology, including its limits.
  • Building and leading teams. Org design, hiring, coaching managers, and directing agencies so a lean team performs like a much larger one.
  • AI and automation as an operating model. A track record of applying AI and other automation to real marketing workflows for measurable gains, with the judgment to set the strategy and guardrails for a whole team.

Strong Working Knowledge

  • Marketing technology. HubSpot (or Marketo, Pardot, or similar) and Salesforce, deep enough to set the roadmap, make changes, and audit how the stack is run.
  • Channels and programs. Paid search and social, SEO and visibility in AI answer engines, ABM and intent platforms, events, and lifecycle, deep enough to direct a manager and an agency rather than accept their report.

Nice to Have

  • Automotive retail, fleet, insurance, EHS, HR, or another regulated B2B category.
  • Demand generation for a multi-product portfolio sold into the same buyer.

The Intangibles

  • Vision with the math attached. Your strategy comes with a model, and you can make a dealer principal, a sales leader, and a board member each understand it.
  • Intellectually honest. You'd rather report a bad number accurately than a good number loosely. When the attribution is ambiguous, you’re candid and upfront about it.
  • Builds leaders. You measure yourself by how good your team gets, and you hire people who will outgrow the job you hired them for.
  • Comfortable with unfinished ground. Much of what this role needs doesn't exist quite yet. To you, that’s the reason to take it!
  • Opinionated, and warm about it. You have a point of view and you argue it without making anyone smaller.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This is a primarily sedentary role performed at a workstation, requiring extended periods of computer use and frequent verbal and written communication. Occasional travel is required as needed.

Compensation

  • Annual base salary between $150-180k commensurate with experience
  • Bonus potential up to 10% annually

Don’t meet every job requirement? At KPA, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. Studies have shown some people are less likely to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you’re excited about the role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply! You might just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

As a growing company KPAvalues its employees by supporting them with a full benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, PTO, Paid and Floating Holidays, 401k with Company match and immediate vesting, Company-funded Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Programs, and No-cost Mental Health Benefits.

Please note: we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

KPA is committed to providing equal opportunity in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, promotion, transfer, and compensation, to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, religious dress/grooming, color, ethnicity, sex (including sex stereotyping), sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, creed, uniform service member status, military or veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, breast-feeding and/or pregnancy-related conditions, age, protected medical condition, leave status, physical or mental disability, genetic characteristics, or any other legally-protected status in accordance with the requirements of all federal, state and local laws. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

Description

MWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. We offer opportunities to work on international products in a stable and professional environment.

Why does MWDN rock?

Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN:

  • Security: We carefully vet our clients to minimize risks and ensure reliability and timely payments - no fraud or unpleasant surprises.
  • Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals.
  • Legal assistance: We provide guidance on legal matters, including opening and managing your independent contractor or sole proprietorship status, taxes, and related processes.
  • Professional development: We offer English courses and professional growth opportunities, as well as team-building events.

Why choose us? MWDN is ranked among the top 5 IT employers in our region according to DOU. We take pride in our transparency and strong commitment to our team. Curious to learn more? See what our employees say about working with us on DOU.

What is your new project?

  • Domain: AdTech, Marketing
  • Location: Israel, USA
  • Company size: 11-50 employees
  • Founded in: 2013

What makes this project exciting?

Our client is an innovative AdTech startup based in Israel, launched in 2013 and quickly expanding with offices in Tel Aviv and New York. They specialize in video and audio advertising, helping brands connect with their most valuable customers through diverse and unique traffic sources. With partnerships across the globe, they offer user-friendly formats on multiple screens, including Connected TV, In-Stream, and In-App. Their cutting-edge video ad solutions enhance the viewing experience for millions, creating new opportunities in a dynamic video ad landscape.

If you’re ready to join the exciting world of AdTech and work with a fast-growing, international team, check out the open position below and apply!

What makes you a great fit

  • At least 2–4 years of directly relevant, hands-on experience in programmatic operations, yield/monetization, or technical Ad Operations, with a proven record of independently owning live activity.
  • Strong practical understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, SSP/DSP integrations, RTB mechanics, deal execution, and web/in-app video or display monetization.
  • Demonstrated experience setting up and troubleshooting programmatic connections, PMP/deal configurations, and bid/delivery discrepancies.
  • Advanced analytical proficiency: confident interpreting large performance datasets, isolating root causes, and translating CPM/RPM, fill, win-rate, and bidstream trends into measurable improvements.
  • Working knowledge of core ad-tech standards and traffic quality concepts, such as OpenRTB, VAST, ads.txt, sellers.json, and IVT.
  • Excellent organizational skills, ownership, and ability to prioritize and resolve multiple issues independently in a remote working environment.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, with experience communicating directly and professionally with international technical and commercial partners.

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Own daily programmatic operations across all inventory segments, ensuring stable delivery, performance, and partner execution.
  • Independently configure, launch, and optimize partner integrations, inventory setups, tags/endpoints, PMPs, and deal IDs as applicable.
  • Monitor and improve CPM/RPM, fill rate, bid and win rates, revenue, discrepancies, and other yield and delivery KPIs.
  • Troubleshoot - integration, delivery, discrepancy, and IVT/traffic-quality issues and coordinate resolution with technical teams and partners.
  • Manage operational communications with SSPs, DSPs, publishers, and demand partners, driving testing, optimization, and scalable growth.
  • Work closely with Ad Ops and Development to validate technical and operational processes, and push essential improvements.
  • Deliver structured performance reporting, root-cause analysis, recommendations, and clear follow-through on operational priorities.

Why work with us?

  • People-first management with minimal bureaucracy
  • A friendly company culture, proven by employees who choose to return
  • Flexible working hours
  • 32 days of PTO (21 working days per year plus all national holidays)
  • 10 paid recovery days
  • Full financial and legal support for independent contractors
  • Free English classes, with native speakers or Ukrainian teachers
  • Dedicated HR support

✅ Intro call with a Recruiter — ✅ Intro with the client — ✅ Tech interview — ✅ Final HR interview— ✅ Offer

jobs.description:
Job Description

职位描述

负责公司临床诊断相关产品在中国市场的业务增长与战略拓展，重点覆盖病理及临床流式细胞应用领域。通过市场战略制定、战略项目管理、重点客户管理、新产品商业化推进及渠道与合作生态建设，推动业务持续增长与增强公司行业影响力。

主要职责

Ø市场战略与业务增长
  • 基于市场趋势、客户需求、竞争格局及政策环境，制定病理及临床流式应用领域的全国业务增长策略
  • 识别关键业务机会，制定差异化市场拓展路径并推动落地
  • 优化业务模式与市场准入策略，提升整体商业转化效率
    •
Ø重点客户管理与业务拓展
  • 建立系统化目标客户地图及机会管理机制，推动重点项目持续转化
  • 深入理解客户临床需求及决策流程，将技术与产品能力转化为可执行的商业机会
  • 协同重点客户群体的管理及业务拓展，包括重点医院、病理中心、区域检验中心、第三方医学实验室等
    •
Ø战略项目与业务管线管理
  • 主导重点战略项目管理，包括机会评估、商业方案设计、资源协调、执行推进及结果复盘
  • 管理业务机会管线，持续跟踪项目进展、风险、资源需求及转化结果
    •
Ø解决方案、产品商业化及新产品导入
  • 推动病理及临床流式整体解决方案在临床场景中的应用与落地
  • 整合产品组合、应用方案与市场推广策略，提升解决方案价值及客户转化效率
  • 主导新产品导入及商业化推进全流程，包括策略制定、关键客户验证，临床/市场导入及推广执行，确保新产品在目标市场的成功落地与规模化应用
    •
Ø渠道与生态体系建设
  • 建立并优化渠道赋能体系，提升渠道覆盖能力、专业水平、合规执行及业务产出
  • 制定渠道发展策略并推动执行，优化渠道布局与合作模式
  • 构建临床学术及用户生态体系，推动KOL网络、示范中心及区域标杆项目建设
    •
Ø跨部门协同与支持
  • 协同总部及本地市场、销售、应用、服务、供应链及合规等相关团队，推动产品定位、市场准入及区域策略落地
  • 为销售团队提供市场策略、客户管理及解决方案支持，提升整体业务能力
  • 参与业务分析及市场行业动态洞察输出，为业务决策提供支持
    •

Qualifications

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历，医学、检验、生命科学、生物医学相关专业优先。
  • 5–8年以上临床诊断、IVD、生命科学或相关医疗健康行业经验，具有业务拓展、渠道管理、市场开发或区域/全国销售管理经验，能够基于市场趋势、政策变化及竞争环境识别并推动业务增长机会。
  • 具备商业机会挖掘与转化能力，熟悉病理及临床流式应用场景及客户决策机制，了解中国临床诊断及IVD行业生态。
    •

•具备新业务开发、重点项目推进及复杂客户管理经验，能够推动业务执行。

  • 具备新产品导入及商业化经验，理解策略制定、关键客户验证及市场导入流程，并具备KOL网络、学术合作、示范中心及区域标杆市场建设经验，同时具备渠道管理及生态合作经验。
  • 具备复杂项目管理及跨部门协作经验，熟悉销售漏斗、机会管线，客户分层、渠道绩效及业务预测管理方法，具备较强的协作及数据洞察能力。
  • 具备良好的合规意识与风险识别能力，熟悉并严格遵守临床诊断及医疗健康行业相关法规与行业规范，在各类商业与市场活动中坚持合法、透明、可追溯原则，并遵守公司合规要求。
    •

•具备良好的英文能力，可作为工作语言运用。

•具备良好的沟通、谈判及影响力，以结果为导向，主观能动性强。

  • 能够适应不定期出差。

jobs.title: Cold Caller
jobs.excerpt: We are hiring part-time cold callers to support the US relaunch of a B2B beauty-tech offer.
jobs.description:
We are hiring part-time cold callers to support the US relaunch of a B2B beauty-tech offer. Callers will phone spas, beauty salons, medical clinics, and pharmacies, present a smart mirror and mini lab offer quickly and clearly, and book meetings with interested prospects. The goal of each call is to book a meeting, not to close the sale.

This is a remote, part-time, hourly role of about 20 hours a week, Monday to Friday during US Eastern Time business hours, with no weekends. Callers work from a provided lead list, log all activity in the CRM, and are held to daily activity and results targets. The target start date is the first week of November 2026. Calling begins in Florida, with possible expansion to other US time zones later. The role can grow into self-prospecting and into full-time work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make 100 to 125 cold calls a day to spas, beauty salons, medical clinics, and pharmacies
  • Present the smart mirror and mini lab offer clearly and quickly on each call
  • Book meetings with interested prospects
  • Hand booked meetings over to the assigned team member
  • Log every call, outcome, and next step in the CRM the same day
  • Work from the provided lead lists (self-prospecting may be added later)
  • Make B2B calls only; no B2C calls
  • Work toward daily and weekly KPIs, with hours and productivity tracked through a time-tracking tool

Requirements

  • 2 years of experience in cold calling, sales, or appointment setting
  • Excellent spoken English and strong communication skills, without a heavy accent
  • Comfortable using a dialer and logging calls in a CRM
  • Confident pitching to business owners and managers
  • Available to start the first week of November 2026
  • Available to work US Eastern Time business hours, Monday to Friday
  • Performs well on a mock cold call in the 2nd interview
  • Experience with a CRM-based dialer (preferred)
  • Experience selling to spas, salons, clinics, or pharmacies, or in beauty, skincare, or wellness (preferred)

Benefits

  • Join Our Dynamic Team: Experience our fun, inclusive, innovative culture that values your unique contributions and supports your professional growth.
  • Embrace the Opportunities: Seize daily chances to learn, innovate, and excel. Make a real impact in your field.
  • Limitless Career Growth: Unlock a world of possibilities and resources to propel your career forward.
  • Fast-Paced Thrills: Thrive in a high-energy, engaging atmosphere. Embrace challenges and reap stimulating rewards.
  • Flexibility, Your Way: Embrace the freedom to work from home or any location of your choice. Create your ideal work environment.
  • Work-Life Balance at Its Best: Say goodbye to stressful commutes and hello to quality time with loved ones. Achieve a healthy work-life integration to perform at your best.

Job Title:Creative Account Executive - Contract

Department:Account Management

Location:Remote, U.S.

Experience: 2-3 Years

Type: Part-Time / contract

About History Factory

History Factory is the brand heritage and archives agency that supports the world’s best enterprises to enhance and transform strategy, brand positioning, marketing, and communications that drive measurable results. For more than 40 years, History Factory has assisted organizations to employ their most underused asset – their history and heritage – to pursue their missions and fuel growth.

Creative Account Executive

History Factory is seeking a passionate and results-oriented Creative Account Executive to join our dynamic team on a contract basis. This person will be contracted either on an hourly or fixed fee project basis, depending on agency needs.

In this fast-paced, detail oriented role, you will play a pivotal role in shepherding creative from concept to completion and supporting project leadership with both internal and client facing teams. In conjunction with a Senior Account Manager or Senior Account Executive, this person will coordinate all project management aspects such as schedules, process adherence and job costs in addition to supporting account servicing and development efforts. Candidates should come to History Factory with a working knowledge of various creative mediums - ranging from planning, video and website development to print production and experiential design.

While a PMP certification is not required for this position, candidates should have strong background and experience as a project manager in a creative agency setting.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the single source of information on complex, multi-workstream creative projects. Candidates should be knowledgeable of the ‘in the weeds’ details at any point, and support a senior account management staff member on their big picture vision and client relationship.
  • Work alongside senior account management staff to provide clear direction to assigned creative project teams and ensure all activities align with client expectations and deadlines.
  • Maintain meticulous attention to detail and ensure all projects meet internal & client standards, schedule and budget.
  • Oversee all project schedules and team member hours allocation to ensure accuracy on a daily basis.
  • Manage project budgets proactively, including cost tracking, reporting, revenue forecasting, and new project estimating.
  • Shepherd work through History Factory’s internal creative process in accordance with established deadlines and schedules.
  • Formulate status updates and reporting for clients and internal teams
  • Organizing and leading recurring project meetings.
  • In conjunction with senior account management staff, serve as the day-to-day point of contact and fostering trust and collaboration.
  • Anticipate potential challenges and propose solutions to navigate both internal and external obstacles.
  • Develop and/or review costs estimates and statements of work for new opportunities with current clients

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • 2-3 years of experience in an a marketing or communications agency setting. This is a must.
  • A knowledge of various creative disciplines including but not limited to: video production, web design, content creation, experiential marketing, exhibit production and print production.
  • Intimate knowledge of project management and scheduling software.
  • Proven track record of successfully supporting complex marketing and communications programs and growing client relationships and business.
  • Strong understanding of project management and budget control.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and relationship building skills.
  • Collaborative and team-oriented approach with a focus on building trust and respect.
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt to changing priorities.
  • Strong analytical skills and expertise in using MS Office Suite and Google Suite tools.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a positive and proactive attitude.
  • PMP or related certification strongly encouraged
  • Experience working with Fortune 500 companies a plus
  • Intermittent travel required as agreed upon


Estimated Weekly Commitment:

20 hrs/week - Available during normal business hours unless otherwise agreed upon. Workday will consist of client and internal meetings, project coordination, work review and project management tasks.

jobs.description:
About Accenture:
Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.


We Are:

Accenture is recognized as a global leader in AI and cloud transformation, helping businesses across industries reimagine the digital core for an AI-native operating model. Through partnerships with frontier AI labs such as Anthropic and OpenAI, and the leading cloud providers, Accenture delivers end-to-end services that drive innovation and business agility.

The Digital Core Reinvention practice builds the enterprise ontology — the semantic layer that turns raw data into contextualized enterprise knowledge, and the knowledge agents that maintain, evolve, and query it. Where our problem-scoped ontology work wields meaning against a single problem, this discipline builds the meaning the whole enterprise stands on.


You Are:

A senior knowledge engineer ready to own the discipline: scaled ontology creation, the semantic layer, and the public technical argument for why AI without engineered meaning is guesswork.

This is the senior technical track at Accenture: we hire people here who would rather own a methodology than carry a number.


The Work:

As an Associate Director in this family you are the technical owner of our enterprise knowledge engineering services. Concretely, that means three things at once:

You own the methodology.

  • Scaled ontology creation, semantic-layer design, knowledge-agent patterns — yours to defend, evolve, and sign off on, including the boundary with problem-scoped ontology work (build the ontology here; wield it there).

You own the asset portfolio.

  • Ontology templates, entity-resolution patterns, semantic serving reference architectures — every engagement consumes or produces one.

You own the technical point of view.

  • You can explain the value of the semantic layer to a CFO and defend an OWL modeling decision to an architect in the same meeting — and the market hears the argument from you.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's what you need:

  • Minimum of 10 years in knowledge engineering, semantic web, ontology design, or adjacent data disciplines, with at least 2 years specifically on AI/LLM-based work.
  • Minimum of 6 years with knowledge-graph technologies (RDF, SPARQL, SHACL, property graphs) and enterprise graph databases.
  • Minimum of 6 years of managerial or discipline-leadership experience, able to explain the value of the semantic layer to senior stakeholders (per the W16 scaffold for this family).
  • Minimum of 2 years of publishing or speaking publicly in the discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years owning a productized offering, platform, or methodology — not just consulting within one.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate's Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience).

Professional Skills Required:

  • Demonstrated ability to walk into a client executive's office and earn the room on technical depth alone.
  • A clear, defensible point of view on the current AI frontier — what's real, what's hype, what matters in 18 months — that you can articulate publicly.

Bonus Points if You Have:

  • Retrieval-augmented generation and agent context engineering at enterprise scale.
  • Experience running ontology governance — versioning meaning the way engineers version code.
  • Multi-tenant or federated semantic-layer architectures.
  • Comfort being outranked on pipeline conversations and outvoting on technical ones.
  • A track record of editing methodology the way engineers edit code.
  • Frontier-partner relationships (Anthropic, OpenAI, hyperscaler AI orgs, or equivalent).
