jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Join the mission to make the digital world safer.
jobs.description:
Join the mission to make the digital world safer.

About Team Cymru

Team Cymru’s mission is to save and improve human lives by helping public and private sector analysts track and take down cybercriminals. We provide visibility into global cyber threat activity and are a key intelligence source for leading cybersecurity and threat intelligence vendors.

Our Pure Signal™ platform gives enterprise security teams on-demand access to global internet traffic telemetry, providing clarity into what’s happening across the internet with a level of visibility comparable to their own internal networks. This allows organizations to close detection gaps, accelerate incident response, and get ahead of critical, recurring threats.

Team Cymru is a fast-paced, distribution-focused, private equity-backed company where your work directly supports a mission that protects millions worldwide.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design and build the Go services and pipelines that power our data lake. You’ll own how raw data lands, gets cleaned and conformed, and becomes trusted, business-ready datasets across our bronze, silver, and gold layers. You’ll operate with significant technical ownership, working closely with stakeholders to turn deep domain knowledge into reliable, production-grade systems. This role suits an engineer who can move fluidly between hands-on coding, system design, and mentoring, and who is energized by the mission-driven, high-signal nature of threat intelligence work.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Lake Design & Development

  • Design, build, and operate large-scale, high-throughput systems for collecting, processing, enriching, and ingesting threat intelligence data (network telemetry, indicators of compromise, or similar) into our data lake infrastructure
  • Own all layers of the data lake: bronze, silver, and gold
  • Choose and tune table formats, partitioning, compaction, and file layout to balance cost, latency, and query performance
  • Own significant components or services end-to-end, from technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration in production
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code in Go, and contribute to our engineering standards and practices
  • Participate in architectural decisions, design reviews, and technical planning; provide informed input on trade-offs around scale, latency, and data integrity

Collaboration & Domain Translation

  • Partner directly with threat intelligence analysts and researchers to translate investigative workflows and detection logic into scalable software
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, security, and data teams to prioritize work that has direct impact on customer and analyst outcomes

Reliability & Operations

  • Improve the reliability, performance, and observability of existing systems, including on-call participation for services you own

Mentorship & Engineering Quality

  • Mentor other engineers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance; help raise the bar for engineering quality across the team

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building and operating production Go systems at scale
  • Deep Go fluency: concurrency (goroutines, channels, context), profiling and performance tuning, memory management, and idiomatic testing
  • Hands-on experience building and running a data lake using the Medallion Architecture (bronze, silver, gold) in production
  • Strong working knowledge of an open table format such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi, and columnar formats like Parquet
  • Experience with object storage (S3, GCS, or ADLS) and with partitioning, compaction, and schema evolution at scale
  • Demonstrated experience designing distributed systems; you can reason clearly about trade-offs in scalability, reliability, latency, and cost
  • Experience working with large or high-velocity datasets; familiarity with streaming or batch data pipeline technologies is a strong plus
  • Experience building and maintaining ClickHouse and PostgreSQL databases

Additional Skills

  • Genuine interest in cybersecurity or threat intelligence; prior experience in the domain is a plus but not required for a strong engineer with the right curiosity and aptitude
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-engineering stakeholders
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach to technical disagreement, mentorship, and cross-team problem-solving
  • Experience with the specific data domains relevant to threat intelligence (network flow data, DNS, malware analysis, OSINT, or similar)
  • Experience with AWS and infrastructure-as-code tooling
  • Familiarity with security frameworks or standards relevant to the industry (MITRE ATT&CK, STIX/TAXII)
  • Prior experience in a startup or fast-scaling engineering organization, including comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities
  • Open-source contributions or a public track record of technical writing or speaking

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Travel

Occasional travel for team meetings or industry events may be required.

Why Join Team Cymru?

At Team Cymru, we provide unmatched global threat intelligence that empowers organizations to proactively disrupt adversaries. You'll be at the forefront of cybersecurity innovation, helping customers harness the full power of our threat intelligence to achieve critical business and security outcomes.

We offer a collaborative, mission-driven culture where your expertise and impact will directly contribute to improving global security.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply now and help shape the financial future of a company protecting millions worldwide.

This job description is not exhaustive. Responsibilities may evolve as needed. Team Cymru is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. This is a remote position.

  • Lead the technical design of frontend-heavy features, turn product and design concepts into high-quality interfaces, and shape the UX with designers and domain experts
  • Evaluate frontend and full stack architectural trade-offs, balancing experimentation speed, user experience, performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability as solutions mature
  • Own frontend performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across desktop, tablet, and mobile web, including views used live by staff on shared devices
  • Build and extend the APIs behind your features using Node.js/NestJS, with Firestore, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis as data layers
  • Handle real-time and async UI states, such as live updates, optimistic updates, background job status, and conflict handling
  • Work with core platform and app teams to reuse and improve shared components and design system patterns

  • Own the full development lifecycle for significant features and initiatives: technical design, building, testing, deploying, measuring, and maintaining.

  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and technical guidance, sharing learnings and helping raise engineering quality across the team

What We're Looking For

  • Deep expertise in Vue (Vue 3 preferred) or a comparable modern framework, plus TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS

  • Strong understanding of state management, component architecture, and frontend performance optimization
  • Solid backend skills to work end-to-end: API design, data modeling, and Node.js (NestJS a plus)
  • Experience with real-time data, async workflows, and keeping UI state consistent with backend state
  • A strong eye for UX, accessibility, and detail, with the ability to make good product decisions when specs are incomplete
  • Openness to using AI tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to speed up development and improve code quality
  • Curiosity about how different industries work, and comfort learning from non-technical domain experts

Bonus Points

  • Experience with metadata-driven or schema-driven UI, such as form builders, custom objects, or configurable layouts
  • Background in vertical SaaS or industry-specific products, such as restaurant POS, booking, healthcare, or real estate tools
  • Familiarity with GCP services like Cloud Functions and Pub/Sub
  • Experience with frontend testing (unit, component, and end-to-end, e.g. Playwright)

Why Join Us?

jobs.title: Junior Quantitative Researcher
jobs.excerpt: Junior Quantitative ResearcherAbout the roleDeeter Analytics is a privately held investment research and trading firm managing its own capital across public markets.
jobs.description:
Junior Quantitative Researcher

About the role

Deeter Analytics is a privately held investment research and trading firm managing its own capital across public markets. After years of discretionary success, we think we have some unique ways of seeing the market, and we pair sharp human judgment with modern AI to act on them.

A lot of what we trade starts as a hunch at the desk: a pattern that keeps showing up, a relationship that feels like it should hold, a setup someone wants to trust but doesn't yet. We're hiring a Junior Quantitative Researcher to turn those hunches into evidence, and evidence into signals the desk actually uses. You'll take questions from the traders, test them honestly against the data, and come back in plain language: what holds, what doesn't, how strong, since when, and where it breaks. This is not a systematic seat: your models won't trade on their own, and you won't be one factor in an anonymous alpha pool. Your work is done when a trader understands it, trusts it, and acts on it. It's an entry point into a serious seat: as your signals prove out, they get more weight in the book, and you get more scope. The role is full-time and fully remote, US-based, overlapping the desk on US market hours.

What you'll own

  • The question queue. Desk hunches in, answers out. You scope the question, run the study, and come back sometimes same-day with what the data says, at the depth the question deserves.
  • The signal shelf. A growing library of signals and screens the desk trades around (earnings and event setups, positioning and flow extremes, regime and factor context) each with a documented edge, known failure modes, and live tracking against expectation. You retire what decays.
  • The evidence standard. Event studies, conditioning analyses, base rates, and walk-forward checks that hold up: point-in-time data, no leakage, no survivorship, costs counted, multiple-testing restraint. A backtest here is a way to kill an idea, not to sell it.
  • The quant read. The recurring numbers layer under the desk's picture of the market (regime, factor moves, breadth, positioning) feeding the morning picture rather than duplicating it.
  • The research data. Clean, point-in-time datasets (prices, fundamentals, earnings calendars, options and positioning) organized so every number you've ever reported traces back to code and data.
  • AI leverage. Use modern AI tools to test more ideas, read more literature, and write cleaner code than one person otherwise could, and verify what they give you.

Who you are

We hire for demonstrated judgment and how you think, not for pedigree. This is a junior seat, so we don't expect a markets résumé — the best evidence usually comes from wherever you've already done rigorous quantitative work. We look for signs that you are:

  • Rigorous where it counts. You think in base rates, sample sizes, and conditioning; you know what autocorrelation, overlapping windows, and fat tails do to naive statistics, and you'd rather report a small honest edge than a large fragile one.
  • Hypothesis-driven. You start from a mechanism (why would this work, who's on the other side, why hasn't it been arbitraged away) and let the data disappoint you, not the other way around.
  • A translator. Your finished product is a chart and a paragraph a non-quant acts on. If the desk can't understand it, it isn't done.
  • Comfortable finding nothing. "There's nothing there" is a result you deliver without flinching: a clean negative saves the desk real money, and you never dress noise up as signal to give someone the answer they wanted.
  • Genuinely curious about markets. You want to know why prices move. You don't need professional markets experience, you need to care about the answer.
  • Low ego and coachable. You take feedback well, update quickly when the facts change, and care more about the answer than the credit.

How you work

  • At desk speed, without cutting corners. A rough answer today often beats a perfect answer next week; a deep study is worth a month when the stakes justify it. You know which question is which, and you label your answers accordingly.
  • Kill your own results first. Before anyone else sees a number, you've gone hunting for the leak, the regime dependence, and the artifact that would explain it away.
  • Reproducible by default. Versioned data and code; any signal or study can be re-run months later and give the same answer.
  • Signal over noise. You surface the few things that matter, track what you've shipped, and say so plainly when something stops working.
  • AI-native. Fluent with modern AI tools for research, coding, and literature triage, and disciplined about checking their output.
  • Self-directed. You thrive working remotely with low guardrails, managing your own time and flagging what needs attention without being asked.

Core skills

  • Statistics and probability. Regression and its failure modes, hypothesis testing, bootstrap and resampling, thinking clearly about uncertainty in small and messy samples.
  • Python data stack. pandas, NumPy, SQL, and plotting that makes a point; notebooks that read top to bottom, graduating to scripts when a study becomes a signal.
  • Backtest and event-study hygiene. Point-in-time discipline, survivorship and look-ahead awareness, transaction-cost sanity, walk-forward validation, restraint about how many things you tested.
  • Market data. Comfort with prices, returns, fundamentals, and earnings calendars; options or positioning data a plus.
  • ML as a tool, not an identity. Regularized regression and gradient boosting when they beat something simpler, interpretability first. This is a statistics-first seat, not a deep-learning one.
  • Crisp communication. Compressing a study into exactly what a trader needs to know, now.

What we offer

  • A seat inside a live trading operation, with a direct line to the traders who act on your evidence.
  • Fast feedback: when a signal proves out, you watch it get used — and you'll know precisely what your work changed.
  • A well-capitalized firm with a distinctive approach to markets.
  • A deliberate growth path: own the question queue first, then take on a bigger slice of the research agenda as you prove out.

• A small, low-ego, fully remote team.

• Compensation: $120k - $170k + bonus.

  • Establish measurable progress toward the position becoming self-sustaining through increased philanthropic revenue by the end of year two.

Mission Summary:

Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn’t just building first-of-its-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options.

The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, for verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and for defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, infrastructure, and operations to build the definitive safety case for the commercial launch of our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis in Las Vegas later this year.

We are seeking a Principal Engineer to own and elevate the autonomous vehicle performance executive reporting for our organization. As a critical leader within the team, you will be the definitive voice translating complex robotics data, autonomy insights, and system performance metrics into compelling, strategic narratives for Motional's highest-level stakeholders.

While you will take immediate ownership of our critical weekly Software Performance Review (SPR) presented to leadership (including the CEO), your mandate extends far more broadly. You will architect the broader executive reporting ecosystem, commercial readiness reviews, and long-term autonomy trend analyses. Furthermore, you will serve as a force multiplier, mentoring junior engineers to elevate the data visualization and storytelling culture across the entire team. This role requires a unique hybrid professional: someone who deeply understands robotics and the autonomous vehicle (AV) problem space, but can synthesize that complexity into high-level strategy.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Strategic Data Synthesis: Analyze complex autonomous vehicle data pipelines encompassing heuristic extraction, diagnostic evaluations, and ETL-driven AV performance data analysis and visualization to extract the core "story" the data is telling.
  • Executive Reporting Ownership: Establish the analytical "rhythm of business" by leading the weekly Software Performance Review (SPR) and owning all leadership AV performance reporting, continuously calibrating metrics to align with executive goals and directly answer the strategic questions needed to drive the business forward.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner seamlessly with internal team leads across Heuristic Extractors, Reasoning Engine & Infrastructure, Diagnosis & Reporting, and Data & Metrics Analysis to unify disparate data streams into a single, cohesive release narrative.
  • Mentorship & Team Elevation: Serve as the strategic anchor for the team, mentoring junior engineers. Establish best practices in data visualization, chart design, and executive communication.
  • Reporting Automation & AI Tooling: Architect and deploy automated, zero-touch reporting pipelines utilizing modern AI workflows (e.g., Cursor IDE) and integration frameworks like Model Context Protocol (MCP). Directly connect AV performance databases to programmatic presentation tools (e.g., Google Slides API) to auto-generate weekly reporting decks and eliminate manual reporting overhead.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience bridging business intelligence, data science, and strategic reporting within a highly complex technical field (Autonomous Vehicles, Robotics, Aerospace).
  • Master’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Intelligence, Robotics, or an MBA combined with a remarkably strong technical foundation in engineering problem spaces.
  • Executive Presence: You possess superb communication skills and can command a room. You are experienced in leading executive presentations and high-visibility reviews with polish and professionalism.
  • Analytical & Influential: You can use data to build a compelling Point of View (POV) that influences internal stakeholders and drives actionable engineering decisions.
  • Strategic & Operational Balance: You can synthesize the long-term system maturity vision while also diving deep into the details of specific software release anomalies.
  • Strong foundational understanding of robotics systems, data architectures, and the unique problem space of autonomous vehicle performance, perception, and prediction validation.
  • The Art of Data Visualization: Treat data visualization as a strategic art form. Exercise expert judgment in knowing exactly what type of chart, graph, or visual framework to use, where to place it, and how to design it to instantly translate dense engineering outputs into clear, executive-level insights.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Familiarity with modern AI agent workflows and IDEs (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and an understanding of how to leverage API protocols (such as MCP) to connect disparate SaaS tools and databases securely.

Bonus Points (not required)

  • Prior experience as a strategic management consultant specializing in deep-tech, AI, robotics, or automotive sectors.
  • Direct experience reporting on software readiness, simulation performance (e.g., Software/Hardware-in-the-Loop), and safety metrics for autonomous systems.
  • Proven track record of replacing entirely manual presentation-building processes with scalable, code-driven slide generation scripts.

Success Metrics

  • Successful overhaul and seamless weekly delivery of the Software Performance Review (SPR), resulting in immediate clarity and strategic alignment for the CEO.
  • Establishment of a unified data storytelling framework that elevates the entire System Performance Organization's reporting quality and visualization standards.
  • Demonstrated growth and elevated output from mentored junior BABI engineers.

Working Environment

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The team member is regularly exposed to mechanical and computer parts. The team member is occasionally exposed to fumes and/or airborne particles. The noise level in the environment is low to moderate.

We encourage a hybrid schedule with in-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.

We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

We are Kintiga (formerly MAP Patient Access, Axtalis, and SKC), a pan-European specialist consultancy that partners with ambitious health technology developers through the complex journey to achieve successful market access across Europe, with our tailored approach, global perspective and local expertise.

Technical excellence and deliverable quality

Business development contribution

  • Build professional network through project relationships and industry engagement

Essential Requirements

Education

Skills

  • Exceptional Excel and VBA programming capabilities
  • Strong proficiency in R; Python knowledge is advantageous
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent client communication and relationship management
  • Project management and team coordination capabilities
  • Growing expertise and team coordination capabilities

  • Deep understanding of HTA processes and submission requirements
  • Experience with multiple therapeutic areas (including pharmaceuticals, medical devices, vaccines and/or other treatments for rare diseases) and HTA agencies

Desirable Requirements

jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Claim

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$132,800.00 - $219,100.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

As an AVP, Business Torts Complex Claim Liability Specialist, you are responsible for investigating, evaluating, negotiating, and resolving the most complex and high exposure claims across multiple jurisdictions. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role serves as a subject matter expert on complex, litigated, and coverage-disputed claims. You will collaborate and partner closely with business partners, reinsurance, legal counsel, underwriting, and/or leadership to deliver optimal outcomes.

What Will You Do?

  • Directly handle the most severe and complex General Liability Coverage B, Technology Errors and Omissions and 1st and 3rd party Cyber claims from initiation to resolution, ensuring compliance with company policies and industry regulations.
  • Lead end-to-end investigation of high severity complex claims and conduct thorough coverage analysis, draft reservation of rights and coverage disclaimer letters, and/or assess recovery potential.
  • Establish accurate reserves and adjust as needed throughout the claim lifecycle to reflect current and anticipated exposure.
  • Evaluate complex liability, damage issues and/or recovery potential, including large data breach, ransomware, business interruption, errors and omissions, defamation/disparagement, anti-trust, unfair competition and privacy claims.
  • Manage assigned files from inception through resolution; Actively participate in selection of counsel and entire litigation team, where appropriate. Develop and execute claim resolution and litigation strategies.
  • Attend and participate in mediations, arbitrations, pre-trial conferences, and settlement conferences, and negotiate settlements within granted authority levels.
  • Identify and assess risk transfer and/or subrogation opportunities, as needed.
  • Partner closely with and present to underwriting, internal stakeholders, and leadership teams to provide claims intelligence on emerging risks, coverage gaps, and loss trends.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to claims professionals.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers’ requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Law degree preferred, but not required.
  • Ten years of handling complex General Liability, Cyber and Technology Errors and Omissions litigation and/or claims handling experience.
  • Active adjuster license where required by state law.
  • Experience with claims management systems, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to understand, synthesize, interpret, and convey complex information in a simplified manner to multiple stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to make independent decisions and handle complex claims, evaluate severe losses, and negotiate settlements strategically.
  • Exceptional customer service skills; demonstrated ability to manage relationships with key stakeholders while delivering a consistently positive experience.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills with the ability to manage a high-volume workload and prioritize effectively.
  • Expert-level negotiation and conflict resolution skills with the ability to apply strategic claim handling practices.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Expert level knowledge of insurance principles, policy language, exclusions, and ISO forms with thorough understanding of business line products.
  • Strong understanding of state and federal insurance regulations, fair claims practices legislation, and legal requirements; ability to apply this knowledge to complex claims.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Seven years of bodily injury liability, property damage liability, or comparable claim related experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

ABOUT OUR ORGANIZATION

STEM From Dance equips girls to become the innovators, engineers, and creators the world needs, building creativity, confidence, and skills through the transformative power of dance.

Founded in 2012, we reach girls in more than 30 cities. 76% of our participants report a sense of belonging, against a national average of 35% for girls their age, and 73% report confidence in STEM. We are building toward 20,000 girls by 2028.

Our revenue has grown from $349,000 to $2.7 million. Reaching 20,000 girls a year takes revenue that grows faster still, and a development function the organization owns and can grow with. Building that function is what this role is for.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, the Vice President of Development is responsible for the acquisition and growth of STEM From Dance's philanthropic revenue. You would personally build and close the relationships that fund our national growth.

The mandate. More than half of what we raise in a typical year comes from funders who were not supporting us twelve months earlier. Renewing and upgrading our existing base covers part of what we need. The rest has to come from funders who are not with us yet. Your charge is to bring in significant new commitments at six figures and above, and to build a pipeline deep enough that next year's number is achievable before the year begins.

Where your time goes. STEM From Dance has built an infrastructure powered by AI and technology that handles the production side of development: proposal drafting, prospect research, application assembly, and pipeline maintenance, with cross-functional support behind it. That keeps this role on the work that produces revenue. Funder conversations, donor relationships, representing the organization in the room, and the judgment calls about where to aim. We want someone who wants to be out front.

The Vice President of Development sits on the executive team, and the role is built to grow into Chief Development Officer as the development operation does. A dedicated development hire is budgeted for next fiscal year and would report to this role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • New funder acquisition and major gifts (40%)
  • Major individual giving (20%)
  • Strategy, positioning, and portfolio performance (20%)
  • Board engagement and external representation (15%)
  • Executive leadership (5%)

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Track record of personally closing philanthropic or commercial commitments of $100,000 or more.
  • Demonstrated net-new fundraising origination, with a substantial share of funds raised coming from funders personally identified and acquired.
  • Experience building fundraising revenue without relying on an established institution's name and donor base.
  • Direct fundraising experience across at least two of the following funder types: private foundations, corporate partners, and individual major donors.
  • Experience operating effectively in a rapidly growing organization where priorities sharpen and structures are built over time.
  • Sound judgment in deciding which fundraising opportunities to pursue or decline, with accountability for those decisions.
  • Working fluency with AI tools used in fundraising workflows, with the ability to identify incorrect output before it reaches a funder.
  • Experience representing an organization independently in executive-level funder conversations as the most senior person in the room.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience closing major philanthropic or commercial commitments with direct responsibility for making the ask.
  • Experience closing commitments above $250,000.
  • Experience building a major individual giving program from an early stage.
  • Experience at an organization in a comparable growth stage, scaling from a single city to a national footprint.
  • Prior participation on an executive team.
  • Familiarity with investment-level or unrestricted giving methodologies.

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

  • Remote work with 20% travel, including monthly in-person meetings in NYC.
  • Comprehensive benefits and perks, including:
    • Health insurance (medical, dental, vision)
    • 403(b) retirement savings account
    • Professional Development Stipend
    • 2-week org-wide shutdown at the end of the year
    • Generous PTO and flexible scheduling
    • Annual staff retreats
    • Goals-based bonus

STEM From Dance is committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We value and celebrate the unique perspectives, experiences, and contributions of people from all backgrounds, especially those who have been historically underrepresented in STEM and the arts. We strongly encourage applications from candidates of color, women, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and members of other marginalized groups. We believe that diverse voices make us stronger, and we are dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and empowering environment where everyone can thrive.

Good visuals are appealing to the eye, but great visuals tell stories that reignite your desire to discover, spark your creative imagination and even influence what we buy, eat, and do. We like to think of ourselves as modern-day explorers, who believe in taking action now and thrive in an open, challenging, and encouraging environment.
Our team is a quirky and diverse crew that has one thing in common: our love for great visuals. Picture this. You will contribute to amplifying unique travel experiences like scuba diving in Tahiti 🌊, exploring Napa’s wine country🥂, bungee jumping in Queenstown 🤩and much more while having access to some of our amazing travel perks that allow you to immerse yourselves in local communities and culture.

We understand that to feel empowered and to keep forging new paths professionally and personally, we need to pull out all the stops. That’s why we take a proactive approach and set not only professional but also personal goals for all CrowdRiffers. To make this possible, we offer opportunities related to training, tuition, conferences, workshops, or anything else that will help you achieve your goals under our ‘DevDollars’ program.
Every day, we work across departments, time zones, and even oceans to reach our goals and delight our customers - all while being remote. If you are looking to make travel an incredible experience today, and for future generations, and are passionate about visuals & tech, you’re just our type. 💯

About the role:

Crowdriff powers travel brands with the content and insights that inspire travelers to see the world differently and explore sustainably. We bring the workflows and infrastructure to source, manage, produce, organize, and plan content in one connected ecosystem, eliminating the complexity of disparate tools, scattered assets, manual tagging, and rights management. This gives travel marketers the foundation to focus less on managing content and more on inspiring discovery, engaging travelers, and driving bookings. We’re excited to be on this journey with a team that inspires us, and customers who partner with us to make travel an incredible experience today, and for future generations.

With a full suite of solutions, we need a connected lifecycle marketing approach that delivers the right message at the right moment to drive new logo, onboarding, adoption, cross-product engagement, expansion, and renewal.

You'll own the end-to-end journey for prospects and customers, building the always-on programs that determine who hears what, when, and through which channel. You'll map journeys, define customer cohorts, score accounts, and continuously test and improve performance. You're a builder at heart, using tools like Claude and our connected CRM and data warehouse to independently build and optimize programs, with support from our GTM Engineer and teammates when you need it.

You're a curious, growth-minded self-starter with excellent creative judgment. You know how to understand customers' needs at critical moments and connect them with the right CrowdRiff solution to turn opportunity into action.

What you’ll do:

  • Customer and prospect journeys: map the customer path from onboarding through adoption, expansion and renewal across all products, and the prospect path from first touch to SAO for prospects and win-back
  • Moments, cohorts and triggers: define the moments that matter in the customer journey from adoption to expansion/renewal. Define the cohorts the team works from, what each moment leads to next, and the triggers that start each touch, written as requirements for the GTM engineer.
  • Account scoring: score accounts on fit and intent. The scores feed target account strategy and sales target accounts.
  • Message strategy: decide what each cohort hears, through which channel and when: email, in-product, website, webinars, community or AM conversation. Audit our current formats and channels and expand them where we can reach and engage customers better. Adapt the story by market (across North America, Australia & New Zealand), tier and new versus former customer, including a story for Europe, where there is new expansion opportunity.
  • Onboarding and adoption programs: lead the programs that get new customers to value quickly, and set activation goals with Product and Support.
  • Expansion conversion programs: run the programs that move expansion pipeline to closed deals.
  • Cross-sell plays: build a play for each expansion path (Planner, Creators, UGC, and DAM), with pricing and peer examples.
  • Program reporting: report activation, expansion pipeline, retention and nurture conversion, and recommend changes.
  • AI workflows: use AI to automate the manual steps in lifecycle programs, with the GTM engineer. You spend less time on operational plumbing and more on strategy and creative decisions about formats, channels and communications.

Ideally you’ll have:

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with at least 3 in lifecycle, customer or growth marketing.
  • A track record of always-on lifecycle programs that moved activation, expansion or retention.
  • Experience building segmentation, cohort and account scoring models, and turning them into triggers and journeys.

  • Working knowledge of HubSpot (or a similar platform) and Intercom, and of how product usage data drives triggers and segmentation.

  • Experience in travel, tourism or destination marketing is a plus.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with BrightHire or other interview intelligence platforms.

Why you will love working at Human Interest

You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. jobs.title: Service Desk Lead (Senior)
jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Service Desk Lead to manage daily service-desk operations for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Service Desk Lead to manage daily service-desk operations for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This position oversees ticket queues, staffing schedules, escalations, VIP support, service quality, knowledge practices, problem trends, and operational communications.

The Service Desk Lead ensures that incidents and requests are properly received, prioritized, assigned, tracked, escalated, resolved, and documented across all support tiers. The Lead works closely with the Government Service Desk Branch Chief and prepares communications, status information, and recommendations for release through Government-approved channels.

This position also coordinates with Task 2 IT Service Management process owners to align service-desk activities with incident, request, problem, knowledge, access, change, configuration, service-level, and continual-improvement processes. The Service Desk Lead uses ServiceNow data to monitor performance, identify recurring issues, manage workload, and recommend improvements to service quality and customer experience.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Participation in after-hours escalation and operational-support coverage may be required.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Service Desk Lead will:

  • Lead day-to-day service-desk operations across the USMEPCOM enterprise.
  • Manage incident, service-request, access-request, and problem ticket queues across applicable support tiers.
  • Monitor ticket intake, prioritization, assignment, aging, escalation, resolution, and closure.
  • Develop and maintain staffing schedules, shift coverage, workload assignments, and escalation rosters.
  • Ensure adequate service-desk coverage for established support hours and 24/7/365 operational requirements.
  • Coordinate after-hours support and escalation coverage for mission-impacting incidents.
  • Assign work based on incident priority, technician qualifications, availability, workload, and service-level commitments.
  • Monitor queue volumes, backlogs, response times, resolution times, reassignment rates, reopen rates, and other service-quality measures.
  • Identify tickets at risk of missing service-level targets and coordinate corrective or escalation actions.
  • Lead daily queue reviews, shift handoffs, operational briefings, and workload-balancing activities.
  • Coordinate priority and VIP support and provide status through dashboards, email updates, or in-person briefings as required.
  • Ensure VIP incidents and requests receive timely attention, clear ownership, appropriate escalation, and professional communication.
  • Prepare service notifications, outage messages, planned-maintenance communications, and customer updates for review and release through the Government Service Desk Branch Chief.
  • Ensure contractor personnel follow Government-approved communication and escalation procedures.
  • Serve as the primary operational liaison between service-desk personnel, the Government Service Desk Branch Chief, Task 2 process owners, and technical support teams.
  • Coordinate with field support, engineering, cybersecurity, application, network, system-administration, and vendor teams to resolve escalated incidents.
  • Coordinate service-desk activities with incident, request, problem, knowledge, access, change, configuration, service-level, and continual-improvement processes.
  • Use ServiceNow to manage queues, assignments, escalations, dashboards, reports, knowledge articles, and operational records.
  • Ensure tickets contain accurate categorization, prioritization, assignment, troubleshooting notes, customer communications, resolution details, and closure codes.
  • Confirm that resolved incidents and requests are validated with customers and properly closed.
  • Review escalated and recurring incidents to identify patterns, known errors, emerging risks, and potential service problems.
  • Initiate or recommend problem records when incident frequency, impact, or complexity warrants formal analysis.
  • Support problem-management activities by gathering incident history, technical evidence, business impact, workarounds, and resolution data.
  • Coordinate with problem owners to document known errors, workarounds, and approved solutions in the Known Error Database or knowledge repository.
  • Oversee the development, review, approval, publication, and maintenance of service-desk knowledge articles.
  • Ensure technicians use approved knowledge content and provide feedback when articles are incomplete, inaccurate, or obsolete.
  • Conduct quality reviews of tickets, communications, knowledge articles, and customer interactions.
  • Develop coaching and corrective actions to address documentation, process, technical, or customer-service deficiencies.
  • Track customer satisfaction and recommend improvements to service delivery and user communications.
  • Analyze incident and request trends and provide recommendations for technical, procedural, staffing, training, or knowledge improvements.
  • Produce operational reports and dashboards covering ticket volume, backlog, service levels, VIP support, escalations, recurring incidents, and service quality.
  • Provide service-desk statistics, accomplishments, risks, issues, trends, and corrective actions for Monthly Status Reports and program reviews.
  • Support Daily System Status Reports with current incident, event, outage, and operational information.
  • Maintain service-desk procedures, escalation matrices, staffing plans, shift-handoff checklists, communication templates, and operating guides.
  • Support service-desk readiness for transitions, releases, maintenance activities, major events, and operational changes.
  • Mentor service-desk personnel and provide guidance on troubleshooting, ticket management, escalation, documentation, and customer communication.
  • Recommend automation, workflow, dashboard, knowledge, and reporting improvements within ServiceNow.
  • Perform other service-desk leadership duties necessary to maintain reliable enterprise IT support.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field.
  • Minimum of six years of relevant experience in enterprise IT support, service-desk operations, end-user support, or a related technical environment.
  • Experience coordinating service-desk operations.
  • Experience using ServiceNow.
  • Experience managing ticket queues, technician assignments, escalations, or operational-support schedules.
  • Experience supporting incident, request, problem, knowledge, or service-level management processes.
  • Ability to analyze operational data and identify ticket, service-quality, workload, and problem trends.
  • Ability to prepare clear operational reports, customer communications, dashboards, and leadership updates.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating during priority incidents.
  • Strong leadership, customer-service, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to support after-hours escalations or operational events when required.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • CompTIA A+ certification.
  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification.
  • Additional ITIL practice-management or service-management training.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense service-desk operations.
  • Experience leading a multi-tier enterprise service desk in a 24/7/365 environment.
  • Experience coordinating support for geographically dispersed users and remote locations.
  • Experience managing VIP or executive-level technical support.
  • Experience developing ServiceNow reports, dashboards, workflows, or queue-management views.
  • Experience with knowledge management and Known Error Database practices.
  • Experience conducting ticket-quality reviews and developing technician coaching plans.
  • Experience supporting major incidents, outage communications, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Familiarity with ITIL incident, request, problem, knowledge, access, change, configuration, service-level, and continual-improvement practices.

Skills and Competencies

  • Service-desk operations leadership.
  • Queue, schedule, workload, and escalation management.
  • ServiceNow ticketing, reporting, and dashboard capabilities.
  • Incident, request, problem, and knowledge management.
  • Service-level monitoring and performance analysis.
  • VIP and priority customer support.
  • Clear and audience-appropriate operational communication.
  • Customer-service quality and continuous improvement.
  • Technician mentoring, coaching, and performance feedback.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to remain organized during high-volume or mission-impacting events.
  • High attention to detail and consistent follow-through.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

jobs.description:
Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brandsinclude Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore,which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About the Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Sr Data Analyst – Store Analytics, to join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. The Sr Data Analyst – Store Analytics serves as a strategic analytics partner to Stores leadership and enterprise leaders, driving deeper understanding of store performance through diagnostic and exploratory analysis. This role goes beyond reporting to identify root causes of business performance, uncover opportunities, develop actionable recommendations, and influence decisions that improve sales, productivity, customer experience, and operational effectiveness.
The Sr Analyst independently leads complex analyses, develops scalable analytical frameworks, partners closely with business leaders and Data Engineering, and helps shape the evolution of the Store Insights capability.

  • Proactively identify emerging risks and opportunities across the store fleet by monitoring leading performance indicators and conducting exploratory analyses.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise Power BI dashboards and analytical solutions that enable leaders to self-serve insights while ensuring metric governance and reporting consistency.

  • Present findings and recommendations to senior leaders, influencing business strategy through clear storytelling and data-driven insights.
  • Support store growth analytics initiatives through data preparation, exploratory analysis, performance tracking, and post-investment measurement for new stores, remodels, and market activations.
  • Develop repeatable analytics workflows that reduce manual reporting effort and improve the speed, quality, and consistency of insight delivery.
  • Create executive-ready charts, tables, dashboards, and written summaries that communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Apply advanced analytics tools and techniques, including SQL, Power BI, Python, and external data sources, to solve complex business problems and continuously improve analytical capabilities.
  • Recommend new metrics, analytical approaches, and measurement frameworks that improve how Stores evaluate performance and make decisions.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Business, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in analytics, business intelligence, consulting, retail analytics, or related quantitative disciplines, with demonstrated success solving complex business problems through data.
  • Demonstrated experience performing diagnostic, root cause, and exploratory analyses that influenced business decisions.
  • Proven ability to work independently with minimal direction, prioritize competing initiatives, and manage multiple high-impact analytical projects.
  • Experience presenting analytical findings to senior leadership and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency with experience optimizing complex queries and working with large enterprise datasets.
  • Strong experience with Power BI, semantic models, DAX, and modern BI best practices.
  • Working knowledge of Python, statistical analysis, and modern analytics workflows.
  • Experience applying statistical methods, experimentation, forecasting, or predictive techniques is preferred.
  • Experience in retail, multi-unit operations, consumer analytics, or store performance analytics strongly preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated experience with data validation, KPI governance, and metric consistency.
  • Ability to synthesize findings into clear written and verbal recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Experience working with cross-functional partners to translate business questions into analytical solutions.
Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time
  • Ability to stoop, kneel, bend at the waist, and reach daily
  • Able to lift and move up to 25 pounds occasionally
  • Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment
  • Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location

Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go Tailoredbrands.com/working-here/people-culture.

Work-Life Balance

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:

Over time, and subject to performance, tenure, and evolving responsibilities, total compensation for this role may grow to as much as $222,394. Base pay information is based on market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable.

jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Experience Manager – Singapore to own the end-to-end customer experience for OPSWAT customers in the Singapore market.

This role will be responsible for managing the local customer support team while acting as a trusted customer-facing leader throughout the customer lifecycle—from onboarding and deployment to adoption, expansion, and ongoing technical engagement.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical and customer-facing skills with the ability to build relationships with customers, drive successful outcomes, manage escalations, and work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Global Customer Experience teams.

This is a customer-facing leadership role with responsibility for coordinating technical support and Professional Services for OPSWAT customers in Singapore. The role operates in a matrix organization: you will lead local customer engagement and outcomes while working through global Support, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to align priorities, mobilize the right expertise, and deliver a consistent customer experience. Success requires influence without relying solely on direct reporting lines, strong ownership, and the ability to stay hands-on with complex technical issues.

We are specifically looking for a hands-on, technically strong, customer-facing leader who can manage technical support and Professional Services in a matrix organization. The successful candidate will engage directly with customers on complex technical issues, guide and coach support engineers, coordinate Professional Services delivery, personally drive critical escalations, and work closely with Product and Engineering to resolve root causes. This is a player-coach role that combines practical technical depth, customer ownership, and the ability to influence and align global teams without relying solely on direct reporting lines.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience & Success

  • Own the overall customer experience and satisfaction for OPSWAT customers in Singapore.
  • Build strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and become a trusted technical advisor.
  • Ensure customers successfully onboard, deploy, configure, and adopt the OPSWAT Platform.
  • Proactively monitor customer adoption, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to improve platform utilization.
  • Understand customers’ security challenges and identify opportunities to leverage additional OPSWAT capabilities and use cases.
  • Conduct regular customer reviews and technical/business discussions with strategic customers.

Local Support Team Management

  • Lead and manage the local customer support team in Singapore.
  • Ensure effective case management, prioritization, SLA adherence, and customer communication.
  • Coach and mentor support engineers to continuously improve technical capability and customer engagement.
  • Monitor team performance, customer satisfaction, escalations, and operational KPIs.
  • Collaborate with global support teams to ensure consistent processes and 24×7 customer coverage where required.

Escalation Management

  • Own critical and high-priority customer escalations in Singapore.
  • Act as the primary point of coordination between customers, Support, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams.
  • Drive escalations to timely resolution while maintaining clear and proactive communication with customers.
  • Identify recurring issues and work with internal teams to eliminate root causes.

Product Adoption & Customer Advocacy

  • Identify new customer use cases and help customers maximize the value of the OPSWAT Platform.
  • Capture customer feedback, feature requests, and product gaps and communicate them effectively to Product Management and Engineering.
  • Represent the voice of the customer within OPSWAT.
  • Identify opportunities for customers to expand their use of OPSWAT products and capabilities.
  • Develop customer references, success stories, and advocacy opportunities where appropriate.

Hands-on Technical Leadership

  • Remain actively involved in troubleshooting complex customer issues and critical incidents, partnering with engineers as needed.
  • Lead technical triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution planning for high-impact cases; ensure follow-through on corrective and preventive actions.
  • Review case trends and technical escalations to identify product gaps, recurring defects, and opportunities to improve support effectiveness.
  • Provide technical coaching, knowledge sharing, and mentoring to strengthen the capability and independence of the local team.

Matrix Leadership Across Support & Professional Services

  • Coordinate customer-facing technical support and Professional Services activities, ensuring customers receive joined-up guidance from issue resolution through deployment, implementation, and ongoing optimization.
  • Operate effectively in a matrix organization by aligning priorities, resources, and commitments with global Support and Professional Services leaders, even where teams do not report directly to this role.
  • Act as the local customer-facing owner for communication, expectations, and outcomes while engaging the appropriate global technical specialists and service delivery teams.
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to align customer needs, service plans, escalations, and strategic account priorities.
  • Maintain clear ownership, action tracking, and communication across functions to avoid handoff gaps and deliver a consistent customer experience.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales and Account Management on customer strategy, renewals, expansion, and strategic opportunities.
  • Work with Professional Services to ensure successful deployments and project handoffs.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering on customer requirements, feature requests, and product improvements.
  • Work with the global Customer Experience organization to share best practices and continuously improve customer experience.

Key Success Metrics

  • Customer satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Customer retention and renewal success
  • Successful onboarding and deployment
  • Platform adoption and utilization
  • Support SLA and escalation performance
  • Reduction in recurring customer issues
  • Customer engagement and executive relationships
  • Number and quality of customer use cases identified
  • Customer feedback and product improvement contributions
  • Team performance, capability, and employee engagement

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Support, Professional Services, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience managing or leading a technical support/customer-facing team.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise IT and cybersecurity environments.
  • Experience working with enterprise customers and managing complex technical escalations.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across Sales, Support, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Customer-first mindset with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Strong business-level English communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong hands-on technical troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate complex enterprise and cybersecurity issues rather than relying solely on team escalation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead from the front during critical customer incidents, including technical triage, root-cause analysis, and coordination of resolution.
  • Ability to coach engineers through practical technical problem-solving while maintaining accountability for customer outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cybersecurity products, enterprise security platforms, or critical infrastructure protection.
  • Experience with SaaS/platform deployments and enterprise adoption programs.
  • Experience working with large enterprise customers in Singapore.
  • Familiarity with technologies such as malware protection, file security, email security, data security, network security, cloud security, or endpoint security.
  • Experience managing strategic accounts and executive-level customer relationships.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, the Customer Experience Manager will establish a strong local customer experience organization in Singapore, build trusted relationships with key customers, improve onboarding and platform adoption, create an effective escalation management process, and establish a strong feedback loop between local customers and OPSWAT’s global Product and Engineering teams.

The ultimate goal is simple: ensure every OPSWAT customer in Singapore realizes maximum value from the platform and views OPSWAT as a trusted security partner—not simply a technology vendor.

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if your pharmaceutical expertise could help artificial intelligence better understand regulatory requirements, scientific documentation, manufacturing processes, and quality standards?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced pharmaceutical and biotechnology professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking pharmaceutical regulatory, quality, manufacturing, compliance, and technical development professionals who can apply their industry expertise, scientific judgment, and regulatory knowledge to evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content.

This isn't a traditional pharmaceutical position. You won't be manufacturing products, preparing submissions, or managing quality systems. Instead, you'll assess complex scientific and regulatory content, identify technical inaccuracies, evaluate reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your pharmaceutical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Pharmaceutical Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator (US Industry), helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated pharmaceutical and biotechnology content.

You'll analyze scientific, regulatory, manufacturing, and compliance-related scenarios, identify errors or unsupported conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in industry standards, regulatory frameworks, and professional judgment.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex pharmaceutical and biotechnology challenges.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of the following areas:

1. CMC Regulatory Affairs
Professionals experienced in Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) regulatory activities, regulatory submissions, lifecycle management, and global regulatory requirements.

2. Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance
Experts in quality systems, GMP compliance, deviation management, CAPA processes, quality oversight, and pharmaceutical quality operations.

3. CMC Science / Technical Development
Professionals involved in product development, formulation science, process development, scale-up activities, technology transfer, and product lifecycle support.

4. Regulatory CMC Submission Writing
Specialists experienced in CTD/eCTD authoring, Module 3 documentation, regulatory submissions, and technical regulatory writing.

5. Quality Control / Analytical Development
Experts in analytical testing, method validation, laboratory operations, data review, and analytical regulatory compliance.

6. GMP Compliance / Validation

jobs.excerpt: Company Overviewatomic✳HR is a recruiting startup.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

atomic✳HR is a recruiting startup. We help talented people across Latin America land remote roles with fast-growing startups and marketing agencies in the US and Canada, and we help those companies hire people they'd never have found on their own. We're small, fully remote, and we treat hiring like a growth problem: we test the way we write to candidates and where we post roles, and we use AI tools to move faster. This role sits on our own internal team.

Your Role

This is lead generation pointed at people instead of customers. You'll work across many different roles and industries, and every search starts with two questions: who is this person, and what would actually make them reply? If you've done lead gen or marketing, it's the same muscle you already have. You research an audience and write messages that convert, except here a conversion is a great candidate writing back.

A lot of what you'll source for is marketing and creative work: creative strategists, paid media, performance, growth, and data roles. So if you come from a marketing or agency world, you already understand the people you're reaching and what they care about. You figure out where the right people are, write the outreach, post the role so the right people see it, and improve based on what actually gets responses. Some recruiters treat this as the boring first step of hiring. We think it's the most interesting part, and it's most of this job. No recruiting experience needed. You'll be mentored while you learn the talent side, and you'll have real tools, including a dedicated sourcing platform and AI, to do it at scale.

You'll:

  • Research each new role to understand who the ideal candidate is and where to find them
  • Write and personalize outreach, then test subject lines and openers to lift reply rates
  • Post and promote roles so the right people actually apply
  • Review incoming applicants and shortlist the ones worth talking to
  • Keep your pipeline organized and follow up so no good candidate goes cold
  • Use AI and sourcing tools to work through a large volume without losing the personal touch
  • Track what's working, and change your approach when the numbers say so

You Bring

  • Curiosity and a real drive to keep learning, since every role is a new puzzle
  • Strong written English, and the ability to write to a stranger like a human rather than a template
  • Resourcefulness: handed a new tool and no script, you'd rather figure it out than wait to be told
  • Organization and follow-through, so pipelines stay clean and nothing slips
  • A competitive streak and self-motivation, because a lot of this is chasing a number you want to hit
  • Comfort with basic metrics, and the instinct to test something and adjust
  • A concrete example of a time you used a tool, a tactic, or automation to work smarter or hit a goal

Bonus Points

  • A background in lead generation, marketing, growth, sales, business development, or customer success
  • Experience at a marketing or creative agency, since many of the people you'll reach are creative, paid media, performance, growth, and data professionals
  • Hands-on time with a CRM like HubSpot or Salesforce, or with outreach and prospecting tools
  • You already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) in your day-to-day work
  • A language beyond English and Spanish

What's Offered

  • Fully remote from anywhere in Latin America, part-time to start at roughly 20 to 30 hours a week with room to grow, on hours that overlap US time zones
  • Compensation based on experience, paid weekly in USD as a contractor. Share the range that fits your level and we'll go from there
  • A chance to move your lead-gen or marketing skills into a new field, with mentorship while you learn it
  • A modern stack (a dedicated sourcing platform and AI tools) so you can work at scale from day one
  • Recent graduates and career switchers are welcome, with no recruiting background required. We hire on how you think and how you write

Interview Process

1️⃣ Apply, including a short outreach exercise

2️⃣ Intro and screening call

3️⃣ A practical challenge close to the real work

4️⃣ Final conversation with the team
