jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

Life360 is the family safety and connection platform trusted by more than 100 million monthly active users around the world. Our growth over the next several years will come from expanding internationally and moving into new business adjacencies, with AI acceleration underpinning both. This role helps shape those decisions.

You'll join a deliberately lean Strategy & Corporate Development team, working directly with the VP of Corporate Development and alongside senior leaders across the company. You'll own important analysis behind where we grow next, and you'll introduce the AI agents that let a small team cover far more ground. For the right person, this is a role with room to grow and a scope that expands as you earn the trust of our senior leaders.

About the Job

The decisions behind Life360’s next stage of growth, which international markets to enter, which adjacencies to pursue, and which companies to buy or invest in, depend on analysis our executive team can rely on. We’re hiring a strategy and corporate development practitioner to lead that analysis and turn it into decisions and deals.

You’ll frame the question, build the models, and make the recommendation, then stay with the work as it moves into live acquisitions and investments. You’ll also build the AI agents that help a small team move faster, from tracking potential targets to running repeatable target analysis. Your work will go directly to the VP of Corporate Development and our executive team.

The US-based salary range for this position is $163,500 to $242,500. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

In Your First Year

  • Two strategic analyses that earn executive support. You'll lead two strategic analysis processes from framing through recommendation. Your recommendations will hold up to challenges from our executive team and earn their support.
  • Two acquisition candidates worth championing. You'll find and recommend one international and one adjacent acquisition candidate. The quality of your analysis, and the way you work across teams, will turn colleagues into vocal supporters.
  • Our first agents. You'll be the catalyst for building agents on the team. Your first agents will identify and track potential targets in our agreed priority areas and run repeatable target analysis in a structured way, saving your colleagues hours of repetitive work.
  • Strong analytical work on live deals. You'll own key analytical workstreams on acquisitions and strategic investments, including market sizing, operating and valuation models, and diligence analysis, partnering with finance, legal, and product. We move light and fast, and your work will help keep it that way.

What We’re Looking For

These are must-haves, and we'll look for clear evidence of each.

  • You drive the work. You take an ambiguous problem and run it to a recommendation. You define the output, set the timeline, bring in the right people, and follow through on your own initiative.
  • You build and deploy AI agents. You're AI-native, and you have designed and deployed agents into real workflows using tools such as Claude, Claude Code, MCP connectors, or comparable frameworks. You direct AI to raise the speed and quality of your thinking, and you check its work with the same rigor you apply to your own.
  • You bring intellectual rigor. You build financial models and valuations from first principles, pressure-test your own assumptions, and can defend every number.
  • You work well with senior leaders. You communicate clearly in writing and in the room, welcome hard questions, and build the credibility that turns stakeholders into supporters.
  • You have the foundation. Roughly 5 to 8 years in investment banking, management consulting, private equity, venture, corporate development, or strategy at a high-growth technology company.

Nice to Have

Experience with B2C subscription or consumer technology businesses, hands-on M&A diligence or integration work, and comfort with SQL or BI tools.

How We'll Get to Know You

Our process is built around real work. You'll walk us through an agent or AI workflow you've built and the results it produced. You'll also join a working session where we share an open-ended strategic question and explore how you'd approach it.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

Job Summary

We’re forward-thinking technology people with heart. We make our own rules, drive our own opportunities, and try to approach every challenge with fresh eyes. Of course, we can’t do it alone. We know when to ask for help, collaborate with others, and partner with smart people. We embrace diversity and openness because it’s in our DNA. We push limits and reward great ideas. What is your great idea?

"At NetApp, we fully embrace and advance a diverse, inclusive global workforce with a culture of belonging that leverages the backgrounds and perspectives of all employees, customers, partners, and communities to foster a higher performing organization." -George Kurian, CEO

The Platform team builds the core capabilities that enable customers to run enterprise storage, data management, and modern infrastructure across on-prem, edge, regulated, sovereign, and emerging AI environments.

NetApp is seeking a Senior Product Manager to drive strategy, prioritization, and execution for core ONTAP Platform capabilities, while also supporting critical initiatives across the Google Distributed Cloud (GDC).

This role combines strong product management expertise with a practical understanding of enterprise storage systems, customer requirements, technical use cases, and go-to-market execution. The successful candidate will work closely with engineering, product leadership, customers, partners, field teams, and PMs across NetApp to define roadmap priorities, negotiate tradeoffs, and translate customer and market requirements into scalable ONTAP platform capabilities.

A key part of the role will be partnering across the NetApp product portfolio to support GDC requirements, unlock new customer use cases, and identify platform dependencies and opportunities that extend beyond individual products. The PM will help connect strategic customer requirements to broader NetApp platform priorities and ensure that investments can benefit both GDC and the wider NetApp customer base.

The role will also help shape future infrastructure requirements driven by the rapid growth of AI workloads, including evolving needs around performance, scale, data access, automation, Kubernetes, distributed infrastructure, and cloud-like operating models. The PM will work across NetApp product teams to identify where ONTAP platform capabilities need to evolve to support next-generation AI and data-intensive workloads while continuing to meet enterprise requirements for resiliency, security, scale, and efficiency. The role is expected to unlock new use cases, expand NetApp’s footprint, and support customers that need modern infrastructure experiences in on-prem, edge, regulated, or sovereign environments.

Job Requirements

  • Drive strategy, roadmap, and prioritization for core ONTAP Platform capabilities based on customer requirements, technical use cases, market needs, and business priorities.
  • Lead hyperscaler execution for Google Distributed Cloud, working across ONTAP, Trident, StorageGRID, and related NetApp teams to align requirements and deliver integrated portfolio capabilities.
  • Partner closely with engineering and product leadership to define feature scope, negotiate tradeoffs, sequence investments, and deliver solutions that meet both GDC needs and broader NetApp customer requirements.
  • Translate customer, partner, and field input into clear problem statements, requirements, user stories, success metrics, and adoption plans.
  • Identify new use cases, adoption blockers, and footprint expansion opportunities for ONTAP and NetApp portfolio capabilities in enterprise, edge, regulated, and sovereign environments.
  • Use competitive, market, partner, and customer insights to influence roadmap decisions, investment priorities, and business outcomes.
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve research, synthesis, requirements, analysis, and communication while maintaining clear product judgment and ownership.
  • Represent NetApp in customer engagements, partner meetings, executive briefings, and internal roadmap discussions.

Qualifications and Education

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product management, product marketing, business consulting, or business operations related relevant experience.
  • Experience defining and executing product strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and lifecycle plans for enterprise infrastructure products.
  • Strong inbound and outbound product management experience, including customer discovery, technical requirements, competitive analysis, positioning, launch readiness, and adoption.
  • Comfort leading customer-facing engagements, including executive briefings, workshops, and partner reviews.
  • Proven ability to partner with engineering and product leadership to prioritize roadmap work, negotiate tradeoffs, and deliver customer-ready features.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve product research, requirements analysis, communication, or workflow efficiency is a plus.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to influence executives and external partners.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data, technical tools, customer evidence, and structured analysis to prioritize roadmap investments, evaluate tradeoffs, and measure adoption.
  • Experience with partner-led product execution, business case development, commercial strategy, or adoption planning for B2B technology offerings.
  • Ability to influence partner roadmaps, internal investment decisions, and cross-team priorities through clear analysis and product judgment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in the enterprise storage and data management industry; familiarity with NetApp and competitors.
  • Experience in networking, protocols, security, and edge-cloud infrastructure domains is a plus.
  • Understanding of AI data infrastructure, automation, and storage requirements of AI-driven workloads.

Education

A bachelor's degree is required. Master of Business Administration (MBA) preferred and/or relevant experience.

Leadership

Technical

Quality, Compliance, and Documentation

Cross-Functional

  • Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
  • Proficiency in building data products, e.g., data aggregation, extraction, transformation, and QC. Past working experience in dbt is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Working knowledge of genomics and bioinformatics workflows. Human genetics knowledge is a plus.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.

You will draw on your expertise in areas such as energy materials, semiconductors, nanomaterials, metals and alloys, biomaterials, polymers, ceramics, and glasses to evaluate model outputs, identify errors in structure-property reasoning or processing assumptions, and produce clear, rigorous analyses and explanations. jobs.excerpt: GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk.
jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

Overview

As part of the GPSU program, we are seeking a Cybersecurity Presales Intern to support GuidePoint Security's Heartland region. In this role, you will get hands-on experience in three core areas: certification and technical foundations, presales and client engagement, technical delivery and writing, and vendor knowledge. Experienced practitioners will mentor you directly on real work, not simulations. You don't need prior experience in this exact role, but you do need technical aptitude, a habit of learning on your own, and real curiosity about cybersecurity.

You must be pursuing or have recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field. We will also consider Associate's degree candidates who show self-study and lab work. Non-traditional backgrounds are welcome to apply, including career changers, military veterans, and self-taught candidates, as long as they show equivalent knowledge. You will work with the Heartland presales team, shadowing senior consultants on client engagements and attending internal presales and delivery meetings to learn the business. This internship is a pathway to full-time employment. Candidates who show competence and cultural fit may receive a full-time offer, with a growth path to Pre-Sales Cybersecurity Technical Advisor and a long-term path toward CISSP-level certifications and senior advisory roles.

Responsibilities

  • Certification & Technical Foundation
    • Build a certification foundation with company-sponsored exam vouchers, including Security+, Network+, CySA+, and cloud certifications
    • Complete hands-on lab work to strengthen skills in networking, operating systems, cloud, and security
    • Take part in CTF platforms such as HackTheBox and TryHackMe to build practical offensive and defensive skills
    • Gain exposure to SIEM, vulnerability scanning, and endpoint security tools in lab and real-world settings under mentorship
  • Presales & Client Engagement
    • Shadow senior consultants on real client engagements, gaining early exposure to professional security consulting
    • Attend internal presales and delivery meetings to learn how GuidePoint scopes, sells, and delivers solutions
    • Practice explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences in client-facing settings under mentorship
    • Support the preparation of presales materials, demos, and technical discussions alongside the Heartland team
  • Technical Writing & Vendor Knowledge
    • Practice technical writing, including executive summaries and findings reports
    • Build vendor-specific product knowledge aligned to GuidePoint's technology partnerships
    • Research and document how partner solutions map to common client security challenges
    • Document lab work, engagement observations, and lessons learned to support your own growth and the team's knowledge base

Qualifications

  • Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field. Associate's degree candidates with self-study and lab work, and non-traditional backgrounds with equivalent knowledge, will be considered
  • Foundational knowledge of networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/S, subnetting, VLANs, firewalls, and routing basics
  • Exemplifying leadership tendencies, such as leading student organizations or industry clubs
  • Comfort navigating both Windows and Linux, with command-line proficiency
  • Understanding of core security concepts, including the CIA triad, authentication vs. authorization, encryption basics, and common attack vectors (phishing, malware, ransomware, social engineering)
  • Basic understanding of at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and the shared responsibility model
  • A habit of self-directed learning, shown through home labs, CTFs, blogs, or personal projects
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Coachable and open to feedback. You don't need to be right, you need to get it right.
  • A self-starter who looks for work without being told, and has a collaborative, team-oriented mindset
  • Professional maturity: punctual, reliable, responsive, and presentable in client-facing settings

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active participation in cybersecurity communities (meetups, BSides, DEFCON, Discord/Slack groups)
  • Any existing certifications (CompTIA ITF+, A+, Network+, Security+)
  • Exposure to a SIEM, vulnerability scanner, or endpoint security tool, even in a lab environment
  • Basic scripting ability (Python, PowerShell, or Bash)
  • Previous customer-facing experience of any kind (retail, help desk, tutoring, etc.)

Internship Details and Expectations

This is a part-time, remote paid internship ($20/hr) that runs for 12 weeks from January 11 - April 2, 2027, with an optional in-person onboarding in Tampa FL during the first week. There is the potential for full-time employment at the end of the internship. During this internship, interns are expected to:

  • Be located near Tulsa, OK, or be willing to relocate there for follow-on full-time hire
  • Be physically located within the United States for the entire internship
  • Work 20-29 hrs/wk during standard business hours supporting the Central Time Zone
  • Have a personal computing device and high-speed internet access during working hours

This position is not available for candidates living in the following states: Alaska, California, Hawaii, New Mexico, New York, Oregon, Washington and Wyoming.

The below perks are for those that join GuidePoint Security for full-time employment only.

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

  • Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)
  • Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)
  • Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans

Job Overview

The Engineer is responsible for improving production efficiency through improvements in production processes. Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

Employing Lean manufacturing principles to all product fabrication activities in support of existing production and processes as well as new configuration of existing products.

Supporting and leading capital projects to improve safety, production efficiency, and quality.

Troubleshooting production problems and making recommendations based on thorough analysis.

Driving engineering-related manufacturing changes that improve quality, cost, lead time, etc.

Providing solutions to problems that adversely affect operator safety, quality, productivity, and cost.

Analyzing and evaluating manufacturing methods, equipment, and standards.

Creating 3D models and drawings using SolidWorks.

Reviewing drawings created by others for accuracy and consistency with company standards.

Reviewing customer specifications for comparison to company standards and capabilities.

Issuing Engineering Change Notices with supporting documentation in accordance with company standards.

Preparing final reports and conducting a quality check of all documents and reports, verifying accuracy of data, information, and calculations.

Taking a leadership role in process validation and pilot production activities for new and/or improved equipment and processes.

Investigating new technologies and options for equipment, design, and assembly.

Bachelor’s Degree in General Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (required)

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. jobs.title: Senior Engineer – AWS (FinOps)
jobs.excerpt: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business.  By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.
AHEAD is seeking a Senior Engineer – AWS to drive cloud cost efficiency, automation, and governance across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and GCP). This role is central to strengthening cost visibility, accountability, and optimization, while embedding automation and DevOps best practices across major public cloud platforms. The Senior Engineer will partner with cloud engineering and finance stakeholders to standardize tagging, build cost dashboards, develop automated workflows, and advance FinOps as a Service — integrating cloud cost management, CI/CD automation, and cost tracking to achieve operational excellence and financial transparency. As a Senior Engineer, you will bring deep, hands-on experience across open-source, enterprise, and cloud technologies, combined with a proven record of delivery. You are expected to lead engagements, demonstrate strong commercial awareness, and communicate maturely with stakeholders at all levels. You will design, develop, and deploy integration solutions with third-party tools, and will work directly with customer service owners, process owners, and delivery teams across engagements, demonstrations, and meetings. This role carries an expectation of occasional travel and after-hours/weekend support during major incidents, client change windows, or similar events.

Key Responsibilities

    Cost Visibility & Allocation

    • Maintain and enhance cost allocation and chargeback models, budgets, and cost alerts across cloud accounts.
    • Implement and enforce tagging and resource-hierarchy standards, ensuring greater than 90% coverage for cost-critical tags (app, environment, owner, cost center).
    • Develop and publish cost-visibility dashboards and reports using Power BI, native cloud tooling, or third-party FinOps platforms.
    • Support unified multi-cloud cost reporting to ensure transparency for engineering and finance teams.

      • Optimization & Engineering

      • Execute rightsizing and scheduling of cloud resources across AWS and Azure (EC2, RDS, S3, VMs, App Services, Storage, Networking).
      • Manage and optimize Reservations (RIs), Savings Plans, and Hybrid Benefits (AWS BYOL / Azure Hybrid Benefit).
      • Assist in implementing policy-as-code using AWS Config, Azure Policy, Terraform, or Bicep, under senior guidance.
      • Participate in anomaly detection, spend forecasting, and automated remediation workflows.
      • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline management, infrastructure automation, and GitOps practices using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps.

        • Operate & Partner

        • Provide actionable input during monthly cost and performance reviews with product and engineering stakeholders.
        • Partner with Finance and Procurement teams on budgeting, forecasting, and billing validation.
        • Collaborate with SRE and Platform teams to balance cost efficiency, reliability, and security.
        • Maintain operational hygiene through scripting, tagging audits, and compliance automation.

          • Core Technology Stack

          Cost & Governance

          • AWS: Cost Explorer, Budgets, Config, Organizations, Management Groups.
          • Azure: Cost Management + Billing, Advisor, Policy.
          • GCP: Billing Reports.
          • FinOps Platforms: Apptio Cloudability, CloudHealth, Kubecost, Harness CCM.

            • Observability & Data

            • AWS CloudWatch.
            • Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
            • Power BI.
            • Amazon QuickSight.

              • Infrastructure as Code & Automation

              • Terraform, Bicep, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible.
              • Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, GitLab.
              • AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, PowerShell, Python.

                • Cloud Services Exposure

                • AWS: EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, EKS (basics), CloudTrail, CloudWatch.
                • Azure: VMs, App Services, Storage, Azure SQL, AKS, Databricks (basics).
                • GCP: Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, GKE.

                  • Nice-to-Have Tools

                  • Apptio Cloudability, VMware Aria/CloudHealth, Kubecost, custom FinOps dashboards.

Qualifications

    ● Minimum 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role.
    ● Minimum 3+ years designing, securing, and deploying large-scale cloud applications and solutions.
    ● Experience in Cloud Engineering, Platform Operations, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), including 1–2 years of FinOps or cloud cost optimization (AWS preferred).
    ● Strong experience with AWS and Azure cost management, including tagging, cost allocation, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
    ● Knowledge of Reserved Instances (RIs), Savings Plans, rightsizing, utilization optimization, and cloud cost governance.
    ● Experience with Power BI, Kusto Query Language (KQL), Amazon CloudWatch, Python, and PowerShell.
    ● Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Azure Bicep).
    ● Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and infrastructure automation.
    ● Architect-level development skills in Python, PowerShell, Java, or similar programming languages.
    ● Subject Matter Expert (SME) in at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
    ● Strong networking knowledge, including VPCs/VNets, Subnets, Route Tables, Security Groups/NSGs, Load Balancers, VPNs, Network Connectivity, and Routing.
    ● Strong Terraform development and modular infrastructure design experience.
    ● Experience with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, EKS, and other AWS native services.
    ● Experience with multi-account AWS environments including AWS Organizations, Control Tower, Service Control Policies (SCPs), Landing Zones, Account Vending, Baseline Configurations, and Guardrails.
    ● Experience with DevOps platforms including Bitbucket (preferred), GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and GitLab CI/CD.
    ● Experience with security and governance tools including Cloud Custodian, Trivy, SAST/DAST tools, Pre-commit Hooks, and other DevSecOps tools.
    ● Experience with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and remediation workflows.
    ● Experience with secrets management solutions including AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, or equivalent.
    ● Experience with monitoring and observability tools including Amazon CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, or similar platforms.
    ● Experience with container security and image scanning for Amazon ECS and Amazon EKS.
    ● Experience working in regulated environments including HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST, or equivalent compliance frameworks.
    ● Understanding of cloud data governance, data classification, and data protection.
    ● Experience implementing cloud compliance, audit controls, and governance standards.
    ● Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
    ● Strong project management, organizational, and communication skills.
    ● Self-motivated, well-organized, able to manage multiple priorities, and willing to travel as required.

Performance Expectations

    Top Expectations for a Senior Engineer

    ● Execute tagging, cost optimization, and reporting activities under senior guidance.
    ● Maintain accurate dashboards and deliver actionable insights to stakeholders.
    ● Assist in implementing policy-as-code, automation scripts, and cost-saving recommendations.
    ● Increase cost awareness among engineering teams and help embed FinOps principles.
    ● Create and maintain standard operating procedures and playbooks for recurring tasks.
    ● Demonstrate proven skills across multiple billable technologies, validated through certification, training, or demonstrated ability.
    ● Serve as a recognized subject-matter expert within your professional discipline.
    ● Contribute to more complex and critical environments, often exceeding the expectations of your current job title.

    Lead vs. Contribute

    ● Participate in and help lead a team of technical delivery resources across skill sets to achieve customer business and technology goals.
    ● Participate in and lead written deliverable creation across areas of expertise.
    ● Provide measurable input into AHEAD's products, processes, standards, and plans.
    ● Provide time estimates for work based on available information.
    ● Coordinate and contribute to cross-practice deliverables using current templates.
    ● Act as a self-starter in identifying work during non-scheduled hours; prioritize and complete tasks independently, on time or ahead of schedule.
    ● Lead development and testing activities; contribute to refining methodology and best practices.
    ● Initiate and participate in authoring PCR requests when additional work is requested.

    Architect Skills

    ● Demonstrate depth and expertise across at least one core technology.
    ● Architect and lead the deployment of moderately complex cloud solutions.
    ● Understand the performance, scaling, and functional characteristics of software technologies.
    ● Understand open-source and cloud use cases and recommend standard design patterns and best practices.

    Certifications and Goals

    ● Maintain several relevant, higher-level certifications.
    ● Consistently meet goal objectives and exceed select goals.

    Communication (Verbal and Written)

    ● Communicate with external customers, including senior management, on matters requiring explanation, interpretation, or advisement.
    ● Consistently meet or exceed customer expectations for communication and commitments.
    ● Work effectively with outside vendors on internal or customer-related issues.
    ● Participate in pre-sales activities, including scoping, positioning, and technology adoption/maturation.
    ● Identify new client opportunities within the POD and communicate them to leadership, including the Team Lead.
    ● Help customer leadership set strategic direction beyond tactics and technology.
    ● Write and lead complex deliverables within the practice; translate customer requirements into technical requirements.

    Leadership and Influence

    ● Works to influence direct team members, broader internal team, and external customers, to agree and accept new concepts, best practices, and approaches.
    ● Advises and trains more junior staff via mentorship while helping to drive the entire AHEAD platform.
    ● A reliable resource for marketing on thought leadership pieces for their practice for AHEAD and our customers.
    ● Has started speaking at industry conferences and/or webinars.
    ● Contributes to more complex workshops and understands how their area of expertise fits into our stitching message.
    ● Accepts responsibility for own actions and sometimes those of others as part of a team.
    ● Works well with immediate, extend and external teams, a true team player.
    ● Consistently meets expectations in terms of customer facing, writing, presentation and problem-solving skills and requires little to no supervision in this area.
    ● Consistently exhibits a positive attitude towards AHEAD and its customers.
    ● Willing to go the extra mile when asked to do so (i.e., time outside of normal working hours to support a customer initiative, production roll-out, could also be > 40 hours for short intervals).
    ● Consistently pursues self-development and drives the AHEAD business model for self and sometimes others on the team.
    ● Highly respected by peers and sales team.

    Culture

    ● Support initiatives beyond your immediate area of responsibility.

    ● Encourage cross-team interaction.

    ● Motivate others to think creatively.

    ● Achieve success through others.

Why AHEAD:

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

India Employment Benefits include:

Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents
Paid time off and company holidays, along with additional leave benefits as per policy
Flexible work arrangements, supporting work-life balance
Learning and development opportunities to support continuous growth and upskilling
Employee wellness initiatives and programs focused on physical and mental well-being
Retirement and statutory benefits in line with India regulations
Inclusive and people-first culture, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

jobs.description:
Job ID: 18432

Alternate Locations:

Newell Brands is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® - and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Our culture is built on values in action: Integrity, Teamwork, Passion for Winning, Ownership, and Leadership. We work together to win, grow, and make a real impact—supported by a high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative environment where you can be your best, every day.

Job Overview

Newell Brands is seeking a strategic, highly collaborative, and execution-focused Director, Global AI Security & CISO Initiatives, to serve within the Office of the Chief Information Security Officer. This individual will be a trusted advisor and operational partner to the CISO, helping to translate Newell Brands’ information security strategy into coordinated action across the enterprise.

The Director will lead the overall operating rhythm of the Information Security organization, drive strategic planning/project management, and ensure that the CISO’s priorities are effectively communicated and executed. The role will connect strategy, governance, financial management, talent, communications, and program delivery while fostering strong partnerships across Information Technology, (IT) Legal, Internal Audit, Privacy, Human Resources, Finance, Newell Brands operating segments, Information Security, and leadership.

The successful candidate will combine business acumen, cybersecurity knowledge, executive presence, sound judgment, and disciplined execution. This position requires someone who can move comfortably between long-term strategy and day-to-day operations, bring clarity to complex issues, and influence outcomes without relying solely on formal authority.

The role focuses primarily on Strategy & Execution (40%), Office of the CISO Operations (30%), and Cybersecurity Capabilities Measurement (30%).

Strategy & Execution

  • Partner with the CISO and Information Security leadership team to execute the CISO’s strategy, roadmap, priorities, and annual objectives.

  • Translate strategic priorities into measurable initiatives, milestones, accountabilities, and outcomes.

  • Identify dependencies, risks, resource constraints, and execution gaps across the security portfolio, escalating issues and facilitatingtimely decisions.

  • Lead high-priority initiatives and special projects on behalf of the CISO, particularly those that cross organizational or functional boundaries.

  • Ensure Information Security priorities remain aligned with Newell Brands’ business objectives, transformation agenda, risk appetite, and Information Technology strategy.

Office of the CISO Operations

  • Establish and manage the operating rhythm for the Office of the CISO, including leadership meetings, strategy sessions, business reviews, planning cycles, and executive updates.

  • Develop agendas, decision materials, action logs, and follow-up mechanisms that improve leadership-team effectiveness and accountability.

  • Prepare the CISO briefings for executive meetings, Board and committee engagements, regulatory discussions, business reviews, and other critical interactions.

  • Coordinate the flow of information into and out of the CISO’s office, ensuring that decisions, commitments, and priorities are clearly communicated.

  • Provide visibility into security spending, resource allocation, vendor commitments, and expected business outcomes.

  • Partners with InfoSec service tower owners on their budgets and manages the overall InfoSec budget: monthly financial performance, forecasting, etc.

  • Support portfolio management across security programs, projects, services, and technology investments.

  • Help evaluate investment proposals and ensure resources are directed toward the organization’s highest priority risks and strategic objectives.

  • Partner with security leaders to define and monitor key performance indicators, key risk indicators, strategic outcomes, and program health measures.

  • Develop concise, decision-oriented presentations and communications that translate complex cybersecurity matters into business and risk terms.

  • Monitor progress against the Information Security roadmap and facilitate corrective action when initiatives are at risk.

  • Promote consistent methods for prioritization, decision-making, and accountability across the information security organization.

Cybersecurity Capabilities Measurement (30%)

  • Coordinate Information Security’s support for Newell Brands’ Quantum Leap AI program and other enterprise transformation initiatives.

  • Working with the Cyber Risk Partners, help ensure cybersecurity considerations are incorporated into AI initiatives from the outset.

  • Track security commitments and dependencies associated with AI adoption and emerging technologies.

  • Through deep analysis of Newell’s current information security capabilities, as well as viable market options, identify opportunities to use artificial intelligence and automation to enhance security detection, prevention, analysis, and operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information technology, business administration, risk management, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Eight or more years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, technology, security strategy and execution, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting senior executives and leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in a large enterprise environment (globally).

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity strategy, governance, and common security operating models.

  • Proven ability to translate complex technical and risk information into clear business implications and executive-level communications.

  • Experience with strategic planning, performance management, financial planning, portfolio management, or organizational operations.

  • Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Strong analytical judgment, organizational discipline, and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate ambiguity, and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.

  • Professional certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional, (CISSP) Certified Information Security Manager, (CISM) or equivalent.

  • Proven experience using AI tools, including major large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Claude.

  • Demonstrated discretion and experience handling highly confidential information.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in business administration, cybersecurity, information systems, or a related field.

  • Experience working in a global consumer products, manufacturing, retail, or similarly complex multinational organization.

  • Experience developing materials for Boards of Directors, executive committees, auditors, or regulators.

  • Previous experience in cybersecurity strategy, transformation, or security leadership role.

The remote base pay range for this position is from $150,400 to $188,000. Salary will be based on prior experience related to the skills required for this position.

Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments. Newell Brands and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and comply with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

jobs.excerpt: Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem.
jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Black Lotus Labs has an opening for a Senior Lead Threat Analyst that will leverage Lumen’s unique visibility to hunt, investigate, and scale discovery of evolving malicious threats, provide mission-relevant intelligence, and support mitigations on large networks. Our global visibility into one of the world’s largest and most interconnected IP backbones, combined with our computing cluster and analytic platforms, presents exciting opportunities to integrate machine learning, graph analytics, automation, and approved AI-enabled tools as we find new ways to hunt for threats across the internet. Black Lotus Labs has detected and disrupted key evolving threats at an internet scale for years.

This position will work alongside Black Lotus Labs advanced security researchers, data engineers, malware reverse engineers, data scientists, and our customers to tackle evolving threats accelerated by technologies like our Hadoop ecosystem (HBase, HDFS, Spark, Kafka, AirFlow), Elasticsearch and Redis clusters, Docker using Docker Swarm, malware environment, a network of honeypots, and modern AI-assisted research and development capabilities.
This is a close-knit, experienced, amazingly smart team that you can be a part of and help build out.

This position requires an active TS/SCI security clearance w/ CI Poly.

Location

This is a remote position with office visits in Herndon, VA approximately 2 times per month.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Research latest threat attacker tools, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) with a goal of automating detection.
  • Work with cyber operators, when requested, to conduct in-depth investigations on cyber threat activity and provide mitigation guidance.
  • Automate investigations through Python scripting and data analysis using visualization in Jupyter Notebooks and Grafana
  • Build and maintain trust relationships with other intelligence teams, law enforcement, and other outside groups.
  • Support customer RFIs on incidents and emerging threats.
  • Use approved AI-enabled tools to accelerate research, coding, data exploration, documentation, and knowledge discovery while validating outputs through independent analytical judgment.
  • Develop repeatable workflows that combine analyst expertise, automation, and AI-assisted capabilities to improve investigative efficiency and analytical quality.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Candidates must effectively communicate complex domain-specific concepts, ensuring clarity for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with adversary capabilities, infrastructure, and techniques that can be applied in collaboration with supporting teams and partners to discover, track, and defend against the adversaries aggression towards customer networks.
  • Experience using OSINT methods for investigation, including discovering novel threats in malware repositories.
  • Scripting experience with Python and familiarity with distributed computing.
  • Extensive experience hunting threat actors and developing algorithms and techniques to identify new threats from large data sets.
  • Deep knowledge of network-based threats and identifying behaviors without attack payloads.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to quickly pick up new methods, tools and programming languages.
  • User-level experience in a Unix-based environment.
  • Familiarity with extracting data through SQL.
  • Strong writing skills to assist in sharing our knowledge with the public.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of several of the following areas: cybersecurity concepts, network protocols, firewalls, IDS/IPS systems, cyber threat hunting, malware analysis tools and techniques, cyber threat intelligence, common threat actor TTPs, application security concepts, cloud security fundamentals.
  • Ability to rapidly develop proficiency in unfamiliar technical domains through foundational analytical skills, self-directed learning, and effective use of AI-assisted research and problem-solving tools.
  • Ability to use AI-enabled tools responsibly to augment technical research, analysis, coding, documentation, and report development while maintaining professional skepticism and analytical rigor.
  • Ability to evaluate, challenge, and validate AI-generated outputs before using them in customer-facing analysis, findings, or recommendations.

Well experienced candidates may also have the following skills:

  • Previous work experience with Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community, or other government agencies (e.g., DHS, DOE, VA, etc.)
  • Experience with Spark and distributed computing
  • Experience developing automation and analysis in Python-based environments.
  • Ability to work with others in providing direction and assisting in learning new topics.
  • Experience using generative AI, AI-assisted coding, retrieval-augmented analysis, or agent-based workflows in cyber research, threat hunting, or intelligence production.

    Preferred:
  • Proficient in analyzing NetFlow data to identify unusual patterns and potential security threats.
  • Interest in conducting trend analysis to uncover patterns and emerging threats, enabling proactive defense strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to responsibly leverage AI-enabled tools within a regulated or mission-focused environment while maintaining data protection requirements, analytical integrity, and human accountability for findings and recommendations

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

jobs.description:
The Discipline Undecided path is for candidates early in their careers who have not yet committed to a specific technology discipline. You are not expected to arrive with a declared specialty — this path is designed for you to discover it here. TEECOM is growing — multiple teams across the US, UK, and India are actively hiring to grow their teams.

When you apply here, you will go through an adapted assessment designed for earlier-career candidates. Your assessment evaluates your foundational aptitude, learning orientation, and technical baseline — not discipline-specific depth.

Entry into this path is at the Designer I level. If you already have meaningful professional experience in a specific discipline — ICT/Telecom, Security, AV, Wireless, or another — apply to that discipline directly. This path is for candidates without deep experience in any single discipline who are ready to learn.

Discipline Undecided at TEECOM

    TEECOM pairs new hires with experienced mentors across multiple practice areas, giving them direct exposure to real project work in ICT/Telecom, Security, AV, Wireless, BIM/Production, and other disciplines before they choose a primary specialty. Your discipline emerges from what you discover at TEECOM — not from a decision you have to make before your first day.

    Work at the Designer I level focuses on learning through doing: applying discipline fundamentals, supporting engineering and production teams, and building your technical foundation through hands-on project experience and structured mentorship. You will work closely with your mentor — an experienced engineer or discipline lead who will guide your development, assign your work, and help you grow.

    Those who demonstrate strong capability and choose a discipline typically advance to Designer II with a clear specialization.

What We're Looking For

    We are looking for early-career candidates who are curious, coachable, and treat “I don’t know yet” as a starting point — not a stopping point.

    • Recent graduate or early-career professional with exposure to technology systems, AEC, or a related technical field
    • Foundational technical aptitude — you can read drawings, learn tools quickly, and ask good questions
    • Genuine curiosity about how technology systems work in buildings and facilities
    • Degree in any four-year engineering discipline, computer science, technology management, or a related technical field — or equivalent hands-on experience
    • Engineer-In-Training (EIT) or equivalent preferred
    • No declared discipline specialty required
    • Eagerness to learn from mentors and grow through real project work

TEECOM is a fully remote consulting firm. We hire across all US states, the UK, and India. Our projects span the globe — some roles involve international travel, so share your comfort level with your recruiter.

jobs.description:
Ketch is redefining responsible data use for the AI era. Thousands of brands rely on our software to responsibly collect, control, and activate compliant, clean data across their enterprise ecosystem. The Ketch Data Permissioning Platform simplifies privacy and consent operations, increases revenue from advertising, data, and AI initiatives, and builds trust with customers and partners. Unlike legacy tools that stop at cookie banners, Ketch governs how data is actually used across a company’s entire stack, with no-code setup that gets customers live in weeks, not quarters.

As privacy regulations expand across the globe and AI transforms how companies use data, the demand for what Ketch has built has never been greater. Data privacy sits at the intersection of law, technology, and consumer trust, making it one of the most exciting and fastest-moving fields in software today.

Why Join Us?

At Ketch, we’re serious about our values of passion, growth, grit, collaboration, and integrity. We’re a 65-person, Series B company backed by top-tier investors, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers while shaping how the world handles data responsibly. We’re a rapidly growing, fast-paced, mission-based organization filled with a passionate, close-knit team all operating at the top of their game.

Benefits and Perks

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of premiums paid for US-based full-time employees

  • Unlimited PTO, with employees encouraged to take at least 15 days a year

  • 10 paid company holidays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Remote-friendly with flexible scheduling built around core collaboration hours

  • Commuter benefits for office-based employees

About The Role

You’ll work hand-in-hand with GTM leadership and the sales team and will partner regularly with Finance, Legal, and Marketing to help optimize the deal cycle. You’ll own Sales Operations end-to-end: the deal desk, pricing strategy and approvals, pipeline and forecast infrastructure, and the reporting and analysis that helps Sales leadership run the business. You will report directly to the VP of Revenue Operations/SMB Sales, and you two will partner closely on the broader revenue operations agenda.

At Ketch, operations sits at the intersection of systems, process, and data: you’ll design systems that minimize manual processes wherever reasonable – building for scale rather than an automation that gets torn out in six months. Those systems capture the data needed to analyze GTM processes, and those analyses drive the next round of process and systems improvements.

AI is changing what a lean operations team can accomplish. Rather than building out separate ops leads, system admins, and pods of analysts, we are looking for one exceptional operator who works with AI to cover that ground: streamlining systems improvements and building AI-powered tools that put data and analysis directly in the hands of Sales leaders.

This is a remote role within the United States.

Responsibilities

Deal Desk & Pricing:

  • Own the deal desk. Structure, review, and shepherd non-standard deals from quote through approval, and be the person Sales calls when a deal does not fit the standard shape. Keep the approval path fast and predictable, and make the standard shape the easy one to sell.

  • Own pricing strategy and operations: packaging, price books, discount guardrails, approval thresholds, and the quote-to-close mechanics that enforce them. Analyze realized discounting, win rates by price point, and deal shape to recommend pricing changes, and build the case for them with data.

  • Partner with Finance and Legal on contract terms, order forms, and revenue recognition inputs so the deal desk speeds deals up rather than slowing them down.

Pipeline, Forecast & Reporting:

  • Own pipeline hygiene, stage definitions, and the forecast cadence. Give Sales leadership a forecast they trust and can defend, and the reporting to see where it is drifting before quarter end.

  • Build the reporting and self-serve dashboards Sales leaders, managers, and reps use daily: pipeline coverage, conversion by stage and segment, velocity, quota attainment, activity-to-outcome linkage, and territory performance.

  • Run the analyses that change how Sales operates, not just report the numbers. Segment profitability, ROI on sales investments, ramp and productivity by cohort, win/loss patterns. Construct the business case, and tell the story.

Systems:

  • Design durable systems, not quick fixes. Do the math: quantify and prioritize business value before investing in automation. Ensure every system captures the data needed to analyze the process it runs. Make responsible, effective use of company assets.

  • Own the Sales side of the CRM and the surrounding stack (CPQ or quoting, forecasting, sales engagement, and conversation intelligence), including the workflow, data model, and integration work that keeps it clean.

  • Work with AI tools to accelerate systems design, administration, and integration work that historically required dedicated admins. Build AI-driven analytical tools and self-serve reporting that let Sales leaders answer their own questions. Continuously evaluate where AI can replace manual processes, and where it shouldn't.

Planning:

  • Support territory and quota planning, capacity modeling, comp plan mechanics, and headcount analysis alongside Sales and Finance leadership.

Experience

  • 7+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, or a comparable analytical GTM role at SaaS companies

  • 3+ years directly supporting a Sales organization, including hands-on deal desk or pricing ownership

  • Demonstrated track record of designing and implementing sales systems built to scale

  • Example systems include: Salesforce, HubSpot, CPQ and quoting tools, forecasting platforms, sales engagement and conversation intelligence tooling

  • Demonstrated experience running analyses that informed pricing, process, or systems changes

  • Fluency with the numbers that run a sales org: pipeline coverage, conversion, velocity, ASP, discount realization, quota attainment

Qualifications and Characteristics

  • Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI to multiply your output in systems work, analytics, or tool-building; be prepared to show us what you've built

  • Comfort operating as a senior individual contributor: you are the Sales Ops team, augmented by AI, and you like it that way

  • Sound judgment under deal pressure: you can hold a pricing line and still be the person reps want in the room

  • Demonstrated ability to translate operational and systems work into measurable business value

  • History of success working as part of a virtual global team environment

  • Exceptional time management and people alignment skills

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent

  • Able to legally work in the United States

  • English language fluency (spoken and written)

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Cogent Biosciences is a publicly traded biotechnology company focused on developing novel precision therapies to treat a broad range of patients with unmet medical needs. Cogent’s lead program, bezuclastinib, is designed to selectively and potently inhibit exon 17 mutations found within the KIT receptor tyrosine kinase, including KIT D816V. KIT D816V is responsible for driving a rare and serious condition called Systemic Mastocytosis, and exon 17 mutations are also found in patients with gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GIST), a type of cancer with strong dependence on oncogenic KIT signaling. Bezuclastinib has exhibited promising initial data across all three trials: APEX in AdvSM, SUMMIT in NonAdvSM and PEAK in GIST, including an encouraging safety profile across 600+ patients in single agent and combination dosing.

The Role:

The Associate Director, Analytical Development, is responsible for leading analytical activities across Cogent’s development portfolio and commercial product. This role within CMC will partner closely with Regulatory CMC, Quality, and external CDMOs to ensure analytical data, reports, methods, specifications, and regulatory-supporting documentation are accurate, phase-appropriate, and aligned with program objectives. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership in the review, interpretation, and communication of analytical results while ensuring high-quality documentation supports development, commercialization, and global regulatory submissions.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the preparation, review, and approval of analytical reports, data summaries, protocols, specifications, methods, and other CMC technical documentation.
  • Review analytical data packages supporting release testing, stability studies, drug substance, intermediates, and drug product manufacturing activities.
  • Partner closely with Regulatory CMC, Quality, and external CDMOs to ensure timely delivery of analytical documentation and reports.
  • Support analytical method development, validation, qualification, transfer, and lifecycle management activities across development and commercial programs.
  • Author, review, and manage technical documents including analytical methods, validation protocols and reports, specifications, trend reports, and regulatory submission documentation.
  • Coordinate analytical reporting activities for drug substance and drug product stability programs and ensure data are accurately documented and communicated.
  • Support the preparation and review of CMC sections for regulatory submissions, responses to health authorities, and other regulatory filings.
  • Participate in analytical investigations related to deviations, OOS, OOT, and laboratory events, ensuring documentation meets quality and regulatory expectations.
  • Collaborate with external laboratories and CDMOs to ensure analytical deliverables are scientifically sound, compliant, and aligned with program timelines.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on analytical reporting processes, data integrity, document quality, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications:

    • PhD in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline with 8+ years of relevant industry experience, OR Master's degree with 10+ years of experience, OR Bachelor's degree with 12+ years of experience.
    • Experience in analytical development, analytical reporting, CMC technical writing, or related pharmaceutical development functions.
