jobs.description:
Joignez-vous à nesto — fièrement nommée Canadian Rocketship 2025. Une entreprise Deloitte Fast 50 qui bouleverse une industrie hypothécaire de 2,1 milliards de dollars — en bâtissant l'écosystème hypothécaire de l'avenir.

Pourquoi nous joindre

  • Hypercroissance : Deloitte Fast 50 — 3 années consécutives
  • Crédibilité au sein de la communauté tech : TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025
  • Leadership dans l'industrie : CLA Lending Company of the Year — 4 années consécutives
  • Aimant à talents : CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025
  • Technologie de confiance : au service des grandes institutions financières partout au Canada
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale fondée sur la confiance, la rapidité, une ambition assumée, la force du collectif, et une obsession sans relâche pour nos clients.

À propos de nesto

Leader canadien en technologie hypothécaire. nesto gère plus de 73 G$ CA en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux, avec plus de 1 000 membres d'équipe répartis dans 12 bureaux à travers le pays. Nous combinons technologie, données et une approche axée sur l'humain pour réinventer la façon dont les Canadiens et Canadiennes vivent l'une des décisions financières les plus importantes de leur vie.

Lieu de travail

Ce poste est ouvert aux candidats du Québec et de l’Ontario. Il est principalement en télétravail, avec la possibilité de travailler à partir de l’un de nos bureaux dans les deux provinces. Le français est un atout important, puisque nous avons des partenaires partout au Canada.

Pourquoi nous recrutons
Nous permettons à nos partenaires d’améliorer et de simplifier leurs activités de prêt hypothécaire grâce au Nesto Mortgage Cloud. Notre solution SaaS est la technologie hypothécaire infonuagique la plus avancée au Canada. Elle offre une expérience omnicanale de calibre mondial qui accroît systématiquement les volumes, augmente la productivité et réduit les coûts technologiques.

Maestro, notre plateforme de souscription propulsée par l’IA, fonctionne déjà chez nesto. Des agents d’IA y prennent des décisions en temps réel, fondées sur les politiques de crédit. Nous la déployons maintenant auprès de nos clients institutions financières grâce à Nesto Cloud. Pour mener à bien nos prochains projets, nous recherchons un(e) Gestionnaire de livraison, IA pour Maestro, qui se concentrera sur la maîtrise fonctionnelle et la livraison SaaS.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Implémentation à travers les familles de conditions. Vous soutenez chaque agent du chantier du début à la fin : cadrage, cartographie des processus, files d’étiquetage du jeu de référence (golden set), journaux de configuration, ajustement (tuning) et files de divergences en mode fantôme (cas où le résultat de l’agent diffère de la décision du souscripteur).
  • L’équipe de souscripteurs du client. Vous dirigez l’équipe de souscripteurs du client comme un prolongement de votre propre équipe. Vous commencez par un exercice de calibration : les deux équipes étiquettent les mêmes 50 documents, vous mesurez les désaccords et rédigez les règles d’arbitrage. L’étiquetage en production débute ensuite, et vous en gérez le débit.
  • Arbitrage. Vous tranchez toute question ambiguë d’étiquetage ou de politique dans le respect des SLA. Vous faites un triage rigoureux pour que seules les véritables décisions de politique soient transmises à l’expert en souscription.
  • Cartographie des processus et bases de référence de valeur. Vous êtes coresponsable des plans de processus signés et des bases de référence de valeur (interventions, temps de cycle, reprises). Tous les résultats sont mesurés par rapport à celles-ci.
  • Le guide de référence (playbook). Vous documentez les modèles issus du premier chantier et élaborez un guide reproductible pour les implémentations futures.
  • Livrables de programme et dépendances. Vous êtes coresponsable, avec le chargé de projet, des registres RAID (risques, hypothèses, enjeux, dépendances) et des décisions. Vous animez la rencontre bimensuelle de synchronisation des dépendances plateforme-programme (données clients réelles, environnements, calendriers de livraison) et faites remonter les risques rapidement.

Ce que vous apportez

  • Expérience pertinente : de 3 à 5 ans comme gestionnaire d’implémentation, consultant(e) fonctionnel(le), analyste orienté(e) solutions ou dans un rôle similaire axé sur l’implémentation technologique ou la transformation opérationnelle.
  • Maîtrise des systèmes : vous apprenez rapidement des plateformes logicielles complexes et transformez ces connaissances en solutions concrètes pour les opérations du client.
  • Expérience client : vous animez avec assurance des ateliers clients et gérez des équipes clientes.
  • Aisance technique : vous n’avez pas besoin de coder. Vous parlez le langage des gestionnaires de produit techniques et pouvez mener des discussions approfondies sur la logique des systèmes.
  • Autonomie et responsabilité : vous avez dirigé des implémentations clients à titre de principal(e) responsable du résultat fonctionnel et géré des livraisons de bout en bout.
  • Influence : vous orientez les décisions de la haute direction chez le client et faites remonter des améliorations de produit à notre équipe.

Atouts

  • Connaissance du cycle de vie du prêt ou de l’industrie hypothécaire.
  • Expérience du déploiement de projets d’IA ou d’automatisation en contexte opérationnel (étiquetage, échantillonnage d’assurance qualité, gestion des exceptions).
  • Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais.

Vous ne devriez pas postuler si

  • Vous ne souhaitez pas occuper un rôle comportant un contact fréquent avec la clientèle ou de nombreux échanges avec de multiples parties prenantes internes et externes.
  • Vous préférez travailler avec des systèmes existants ou simples.
  • Vous n’avez aucune passion pour la technofinance ou la technologie hypothécaire et n’êtes pas prêt(e) à développer une expertise du domaine.

La récompense

  • L'équipe A : Travaillez aux côtés de talents hautement performants en produit, en technologie et dans l'industrie hypothécaire.
  • Croissance accélérée : la pente de votre courbe d'apprentissage ici sera verticale. Vous toucherez à plus de décisions stratégiques en un an que vous ne le feriez en cinq ans ailleurs.
  • Couverture de premier ordre : régime d'avantages sociaux haut de gamme entièrement payé par nesto, incluant une assurance complète et un accès illimité à la télémédecine et aux services de santé mentale pour vous et votre famille.
  • Repos et ressourcement : 4 semaines de vacances pour vous permettre de rester au sommet de votre performance.
  • Des outils de premier plan : tout ce dont vous avez besoin pour exécuter sans friction, y compris les outils d'IA qui vous rendent plus rapide.
  • Cadre de travail : l'environnement qui vous rend productif et favorise un véritable travail d'équipe.

Diversité et inclusion

Chez nesto, nous croyons que la créativité et la collaboration sont le fruit d'une équipe diversifiée. Nous nous engageons à favoriser une culture de diversité, d'équité, d'inclusion et d'appartenance, et nous encourageons fortement les femmes, les personnes de couleur, les personnes LGBTQIA+ et les personnes en situation de handicap à postuler. Nous nous engageons à créer un milieu de travail inclusif et accueillant pour tous.

jobs.description:
Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Analyst

Location: EMEA/UK Remote

Summary of Role

Nasuni is looking for a Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Analyst to help operate and strengthen the programs that support our security, compliance, and risk posture.
You will take hands-on ownership of defined GRC workflows including third-party risk assessments, customer security requests, security awareness activities, and user access reviews. You will also support audits, enterprise risk management, policy governance, and continuous improvement across our GRC program.
This opportunity is suited to an early-career GRC or security professional who has moved beyond observation and is ready to independently execute recurring processes, coordinate with stakeholders, analyze evidence, maintain accurate records, and know when a risk or exception requires escalation.

You will independently execute defined GRC processes using established controls, criteria, and escalation paths. You will work across Security, Legal, Procurement, Sales, Customer Success, IT, and other business teams while partnering closely with senior GRC colleagues on higher-complexity risk and compliance matters.
Success means delivering reliable GRC operations, maintaining audit-ready information, identifying issues early, and continuously finding practical ways to make recurring work more efficient.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conduct third-party security and compliance assessments, reviewing SOC reports, ISO certifications, questionnaires, and other evidence; document findings and track remediation or approved risk treatment.
  • Coordinate vendor assessments from intake and due diligence through reassessment using established risk criteria.
  • Respond to customer security questionnaires, RFPs, and due-diligence requests, maintaining accurate reusable security and control content.
  • Coordinate approved security and compliance artifacts for customers and support internal teams with security-related contractual requests.
  • Administer security awareness activities, including training campaigns, phishing simulations, completion tracking, communications, and program metrics.
  • Plan and execute periodic user access reviews, coordinate with system owners, identify inappropriate or orphaned access, and track remediation and exceptions.
  • Support SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and other assessments by gathering and validating evidence, maintaining documentation, and tracking corrective actions.
  • Maintain accurate risk, policy, exception, finding, and remediation records and support reporting for GRC stakeholders and leadership.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify or automate recurring GRC activities while maintaining appropriate controls and human review.
  • Use approved AI-enabled tools where appropriate to accelerate research, analysis, drafting, summarization, and workflow improvement while validating outputs and protecting confidential information.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in GRC, information security, IT audit, risk, compliance, or a closely related discipline.

About the Hiring Group

RTI Health Solutions (RTI-HS), a wholly owned subsidiary of RTI International, is an independent and internationally recognized research organization. With offices in the US, UK, Spain, France, and Sweden, we provide healthcare consulting and research expertise to optimize decision making for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device products across the development and marketing lifecycle. Clients rely on our expertise, quality standards, and integrity to guide their product development and regulatory and market access strategies. Our various practice areas include Value, Access, and HEOR; Patient-Centered and Outcomes Research; Epidemiology and Biostatistics; Medical Communications; Global Business Operations; and Strategic Consulting and Growth.

We are seeking a Director to join our Expert Insights team within Medical Communications. As Director, Expert Insights and Delphi Methodology, you will join an experienced, collaborative team that helps clients obtain, interpret, and communicate insights from clinicians, payers, HTA experts, patients, and other stakeholders. You will provide senior methodological and project leadership across Delphi and other consensus-development studies, advisory boards, steering committees, expert panels, and qualitative research. You will translate complex stakeholder input into clear findings, implications, recommendations, and scientifically rigorous deliverables that support medical affairs, clinical development, evidence communication, market access, and related business decisions. This role is suited to an experienced leader who can quickly take ownership of active Delphi work and provide expert leadership across ongoing projects

This role’s location is flexible, UK, Spain, France or Sweden and remote working options are available

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Independently design and lead modified and classic Delphi studies and other expert elicitation of consensus exercises from protocol development through expert recruitment, questionnaire development, iterative rounds, analysis, consensus interpretation, and final reporting
  • Define and apply appropriate consensus criteria, stopping rules, analytical approaches, and methods for integrating quantitative results with qualitative rationale
  • Design and lead virtual and in-person advisory boards, steering committees, expert panels, and other structured expert-engagement activities
  • Facilitate or moderate discussions with clinicians, payers, patients, caregivers, health technology assessment stakeholders, and other experts
  • Conduct and analyze qualitative interviews using rigorous, fit-for-purpose methods
  • Advise clients and internal teams on the most appropriate methodology for insight-generation and consensus-development that is tailored to intended audiences
  • Develop study protocols, analysis plans, interview and discussion guides, questionnaires, moderator materials, and other data-collection tools
  • Translate stakeholder input and study findings into clear conclusions, implications, recommendations, and strategic narratives
  • Develop and review scientifically accurate, audience-appropriate reports, executive summaries, manuscripts, abstracts, posters, congress materials, and client presentations
  • Identify implications of expert insights for medical strategy, evidence communication, publication planning, stakeholder engagement, and market access
  • Apply appropriate standards for scientific rigor, publication ethics, authorship, transparency, data integrity, and project documentation
  • Manage complex, multidisciplinary projects to agreed scope, quality, timelines, and budgets, including development of workplans, cost estimates, and risk-mitigation approaches
  • Serve as a senior client contact, build trusted relationships, anticipate needs, and provide clear methodological and strategic guidance
  • Scope opportunities and develop proposals that align the research question, methodology, deliverables, schedule, and budget
  • Contribute to business development through capabilities presentations, solution development, thought leadership, and expansion of client relationships
  • Collaborate effectively with medical writers, scientific strategists, editors, project managers, analysts, and other cross-functional partners
  • Build the team’s scientific profile through publication and presentation of work

What You'll Need

  • Advanced degree and at least 5 years of experience in medical communications, clinical research, epidemiology, public health, outcomes research, health services research, health policy, qualitative research, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related scientific discipline
  • Extensive, recent, hands-on experience independently designing and leading modified or classic Delphi studies, including protocol development, expert selection and recruitment, round development, analysis, consensus interpretation, and reporting all in adherence to current methodological guidelines
  • Demonstrated ability to assume leadership of active Delphi projects with limited methodological oversight or onboarding
  • Experience leading virtual and in-person advisory boards, steering committees, expert panels, or comparable structured expert-engagement programs
  • Experience designing, conducting, and analyzing qualitative research, including development of protocols, analysis plans, interview guides, questionnaires, and reports
  • Strong scientific writing, synthesis, and data-interpretation skills, with the ability to convert complex evidence and stakeholder input into concise, actionable communications
  • Experience developing publication-quality reports, manuscripts, abstracts, posters, or presentations and familiarity with relevant ethical and reporting standards
  • Experience working directly with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare clients and providing senior-level methodological and strategic counsel
  • Demonstrated success managing complex projects, budgets, timelines, risks, and cross-functional teams
  • Experience scoping opportunities, writing proposals, and presenting capabilities or recommended approaches to clients
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, multitasking environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, collaborate across disciplines, and coach or mentor colleagues
  • A record of peer-reviewed publication, conference presentation, or other relevant scientific thought leadership

Desirable, but not essential:

  • Experience engaging a range of stakeholder types, including clinicians, payers, patients, caregivers, and health technology assessment representatives
  • Knowledge of US or international healthcare, health technology assessment, pricing, reimbursement, or market access environments
  • Experience connecting expert insights to Medical Affairs strategy, integrated evidence communication, publication planning, or stakeholder-engagement planning
  • Experience using virtual engagement platforms, digital collaboration tools, and emerging technologies to support expert panels, qualitative research, insight analysis, and scientific communication
  • Experience supporting health technology assessment, reimbursement, regulatory, or evidence-submission activities
  • Experience with additional research approaches, such as literature reviews, observational or retrospective analyses, patient-reported outcomes, utility assessment, or quality-of-life research

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a remote Business Intelligence Analyst & Data Engineer for our client in Ireland, who can operate across the full data lifecycle — from building and maintaining reliable data pipelines to designing dashboards and reports that drive business decisions.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a remote Business Intelligence Analyst & Data Engineer for our client in Ireland, who can operate across the full data lifecycle — from building and maintaining reliable data pipelines to designing dashboards and reports that drive business decisions. This role sits at the intersection of data infrastructure and analytics: you'll own how data flows into our systems and how it's ultimately consumed by stakeholders across the organization.

This is a great fit for someone who enjoys both the technical rigor of data engineering and the storytelling/analytical side of BI work, and who wants ownership over an end-to-end data product rather than sitting in just one lane. AI-driven analytics is a growing part of our roadmap, so we're especially interested in candidates who are curious about applying AI/LLM tools to make data more accessible and self-service across the business.

Key Responsibilities

Data Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that integrate data from multiple source systems (CRM, ERP, project management tools, spreadsheets, APIs) into centralized data warehouses or data marts
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity across pipelines through validation, testing, and monitoring
  • Optimize data models (star/snowflake schemas) for reporting performance
  • Automate manual data processes and reduce reliance on ad hoc spreadsheet work
  • Manage data source connections, credentials, and refresh schedules
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline failures, latency issues, and discrepancies

Business Intelligence & Analytics

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports (e.g., in Tableau, Power BI, or similar) that translate raw data into clear, actionable insights
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and translate them into technical specifications
  • Define and maintain a single source of truth for key business metrics (a data dictionary / metrics glossary)
  • Conduct ad hoc analysis to answer business questions and support strategic decision-making
  • Monitor dashboard usage and proactively improve reports based on stakeholder feedback
  • Document data lineage, business logic, and calculation methodology for transparency and auditability

AI-Enabled Analytics

  • Design and maintain data structures (clean schemas, semantic layers, metric definitions) that are well-suited for consumption by AI agents and natural-language query tools, not just human-facing dashboards
  • Build or support AI-powered reporting assistants/chatbots that let stakeholders ask business questions in plain language and get accurate, governed answers
  • Evaluate and integrate LLM-based tools into the analytics stack (e.g., automated insight generation, anomaly detection, natural-language-to-SQL interfaces)
  • Establish guardrails for AI-generated analysis — certified data sources, citation of underlying data, and validation processes to ensure trustworthy outputs
  • Stay current on AI/BI tooling trends and proactively recommend where automation or AI can reduce manual reporting work

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with department leaders (Sales, Finance, Operations, Professional Services, etc.) to understand data needs and pain points
  • Act as a technical liaison between business teams and IT/engineering on data-related initiatives
  • Support the rollout of new tools, data sources, or automation initiatives (e.g., AI-powered reporting agents, workflow automation platforms)

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 6+ years of experience in a data engineering, BI analyst, or analytics engineering role
  • Strong SQL skills, including experience writing complex queries, optimizing performance, and working with large datasets
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines (custom scripts, or tools like Fivetran, dbt, Airflow, Workato, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with a BI/visualization tool (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts (dimensional modeling, normalization, star schemas)
  • Experience working with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar)
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured data analysis
  • Excellent communication skills — able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python or another scripting language for data manipulation and automation
  • Familiarity with CRM/ERP systems (Salesforce, NetSuite) and how operational data flows from them
  • Experience with API integrations and workflow automation platforms (Workato, Zapier, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) into data workflows — such as natural-language querying, automated report generation, or AI-driven data agents
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or agent-based architectures as applied to analytics
  • Experience establishing data governance practices (certified data sources, metric definitions, documentation standards) suitable for both human and AI consumers
  • Prior experience in a Professional Services, Finance, or Operations analytics function

jobs.title: Junior Digital Marketing Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Junior Digital Marketing StrategistWe're looking for someone who sees the bigger picture.
jobs.description:
Junior Digital Marketing Strategist

We're looking for someone who sees the bigger picture.

You understand digital marketing, but you also know that getting someone to click an ad is only one piece of growing a business. What happens when they land on the website? Why aren't they converting? Are we acquiring the right customers? Are they coming back? And most importantly, is any of this actually making the business more profitable?

These are the questions we want you to be asking.

At Shero Commerce, we help ecommerce brands grow by bringing together paid media, conversion optimization, email marketing, SEO, organic social, and the overall customer experience.

We're hiring a Junior Digital Marketing Strategist who understands how digital marketing channels work together and wants to develop into a well-rounded strategist. Someone who can connect the dots, think critically, use data to make recommendations, and understand how different channels contribute to business growth.

You'll work closely with senior strategists, account managers, and channel specialists to help turn client business goals into measurable marketing strategies and make sure those strategies translate into results.

What you'll do

Marketing Strategy & Business Growth

  • Help develop cross-channel marketing strategies that connect client business goals to measurable KPIs, channel priorities, and actionable initiatives.
  • Build and maintain 90-day marketing roadmaps across PPC, CRO, Email/SMS, SEO, and Organic Social, working with channel specialists to align priorities.
  • Analyze the customer journey, from acquisition and conversion to retention and repeat purchases, to identify opportunities for growth.
  • Research client businesses, competitors, audiences, and market trends to understand what influences performance.
  • Identify where marketing efforts are falling short and recommend what needs to change, whether that's the campaign, creative, offer, website, or retention strategy.
  • Help prioritize initiatives based on business impact rather than individual channel performance.

Cross-Channel Marketing & Paid Media

  • Apply a working understanding of paid media platforms like Meta Ads and Google Ads to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and contribute to broader marketing strategies.
  • Collaborate with paid media specialists on campaign planning, audience strategy, budget recommendations, creative testing, and performance improvements.
  • Understand how channels like PPC, SEO, CRO, Email/SMS, and Organic Social contribute to acquisition, conversion, retention, and overall business growth.
  • Evaluate marketing performance using metrics like ROAS, CAC, MER, CVR, AOV, and LTV, with an understanding of how these relate to business profitability.
  • Identify opportunities across landing pages, product pages, conversion funnels, customer journeys, and lifecycle marketing.
  • Work with channel specialists to ensure individual tactics support the client's overall strategy and business goals.

Analytics, AI & Strategic Execution

  • Analyze performance across marketing platforms, GA4, Shopify, and reporting dashboards to identify trends, challenges, and growth opportunities.
  • Turn data into clear insights and recommendations that clients and internal teams can act on.
  • Use AI tools regularly to support research, data analysis, competitive insights, strategy development, reporting, and workflow efficiency.
  • Demonstrate good judgment when using AI, including validating outputs, questioning recommendations, and applying business context rather than relying on generated answers.
  • Stay curious about emerging AI capabilities and how they can improve marketing strategies, internal processes, and client results.
  • Support monthly performance reviews, quarterly business reviews, and client strategy presentations.
  • Work with project managers and channel teams to translate recommendations into clear priorities and deliverables.
  • Track strategic initiatives, flag delays, and help evaluate whether the work is producing the intended results.
  • Help determine what we should keep doing, what we should change, and what we should stop doing altogether.

What we're looking for

  • 2–3 years of digital marketing experience, ideally with exposure to multiple marketing channels and ecommerce businesses.
  • A strong understanding of cross-channel marketing strategy and how PPC, SEO, CRO, Email/SMS, and Organic Social work together to drive business growth.
  • Practical familiarity with Meta Ads and Google Ads, including campaign structure, targeting, budgets, optimization, and performance analysis. Hands-on campaign management experience is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with GA4, Shopify, reporting dashboards, and marketing performance data.
  • An understanding of ecommerce metrics like CAC, MER, ROAS, AOV, conversion rate, LTV, and retention.
  • Experience using AI tools in your daily work, with examples of how you've applied them to research, analysis, marketing strategy, reporting, or improving efficiency.
  • The ability to look beyond individual channel metrics and understand how marketing decisions affect overall business performance.
  • Experience contributing to marketing strategies, including setting KPIs, identifying opportunities, recommending channel priorities, and supporting actionable roadmaps.
  • Strong communication, research, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • A proactive approach to client work. You spot problems and opportunities, bring recommendations to the table, ask thoughtful questions, and follow up when something needs attention.
  • The ability to collaborate with channel specialists and project managers to keep marketing initiatives aligned with client goals.
  • Good judgment when prioritizing work based on potential business impact.
  • Comfort discussing performance insights and recommendations with internal teams and clients in clear, confident language.
  • Strong follow-through and accountability for assigned initiatives.

Bonus points: Experience with Shopify, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Looker Studio, StackAdapt, Google Tag Manager, ecommerce conversion optimization, or emerging advertising channels like TikTok, LinkedIn, programmatic, and AI-powered advertising.

You'll thrive here if...

You're naturally curious about how businesses grow. You understand what happens inside advertising platforms, but you don't automatically assume the solution to every marketing problem lives there. If acquisition costs are rising, you want to understand why. If traffic is increasing but sales aren't, you'll look at the website, the offer, and the customer journey. If customers aren't coming back, you'll want to know what we're doing to retain them. You're comfortable with data, enjoy solving problems, and can connect the dots between what the numbers are telling you and what the business actually needs.

You're proactive by nature. When you notice something in the data, you bring it forward with a recommendation instead of waiting for the next meeting. When a client hasn't responded, you follow up. When a project stalls, you find out why and help get it moving again. You already use AI to make your work more effective. You know how to ask better questions, research faster, analyze information, and improve your workflows without losing the critical thinking that makes a good strategist. You don't need to know everything. But you should be eager to learn, comfortable taking ownership, and willing to bring ideas to the table.

Why Shero?

At Shero Commerce, we don't believe in marketing for the sake of marketing. We care about understanding our clients' businesses, finding opportunities that will make a measurable difference, and bringing the right people and channels together to make it happen. You'll work alongside experienced strategists and specialists across paid media, CRO, email, SEO, creative, and ecommerce technology, gaining exposure to different industries, business models, and growth challenges. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to real client strategies, sharpen your analytical skills, explore emerging technologies, and develop into a strategist who can eventually own and lead client accounts. If you want to move beyond individual marketing channels and learn how to grow businesses, we'd love to meet you.

Benefits

Shero offers a competitive benefits package, including private medical insurance, pension, annual leave plus bank holidays, and opportunities for learning and development, within a supportive, inclusive, remote-first team culture. Full details will be provided separately during the hiring process.

Working requirements

Reasonable adjustments will be made in accordance with the Equality Act 2010, both during the recruitment process and in the role. If you need any adjustments to apply or interview, please let us know.

  • Communicate clearly by email, video call, and messaging tools.
  • Review website layouts, functionality, and design, and provide feedback.
  • Operate a computer and standard office equipment efficiently for extended periods.
  • Occasionally travel to internal events or industry conferences
  • Collaborate with diverse personalities, cultures, and work styles.
  • Follow documented processes and procedures with accuracy.

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), remote, UK-based position. We offer flexible working, with core hours of 9:00 am to 3:00 pm Eastern Time (New York), Monday to Friday. During core hours, you will be expected to be working and available for meetings, calls, and messages. This is 2:00 pm to 8:00 pm UK time for most of the year, or 1:00 pm to 7:00 pm UK time for a few weeks each spring and autumn when the U.S. and UK change their clocks on different dates. Your remaining hours can be scheduled flexibly outside the core window, in agreement with your manager.

Diversity and equal opportunity statement

Shero is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud of our diverse and global team and committed to fostering an environment of inclusion and belonging. Diversity is not just a metric; it is a practice we embed in our daily work, decision-making, and leadership. We are committed to fair hiring and employment practices, free from discrimination or harassment of any kind. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a growing team in an ever-evolving digital landscape. Shero is fueled by empathy, grit, curiosity, and collaboration. If you are passionate about your work and want to grow with a team that values you as a whole person, we would love for you to join us.

How to apply

Send us your resume and tell us about two things:

  1. A time you identified a marketing opportunity or solved a performance problem. What did you notice, how did you approach it, and what did you learn?
  2. An example of how you've used AI in your marketing work. Tell us which tools you used, what you used them for, and how they helped you work more effectively or make a better decision.

We're interested in how you think, how you approach problems, and how you use the tools available to you, not just which platforms you've worked in.

Salary: Competitive benefits package

They operate across an omnichannel footprint—spanning direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, top national retail partners, and commercial accounts. About the Role

On behalf of our client, we are seeking a strategic, proactive, and analyticalSenior FP&A Analyst / FP&A Lead.

In this role, you will serve as a key financial co-pilot to executive leadership. You will take complete ownership of liquidity management, cash flow forecasting (including complex borrowing base and debt calculations), annual budgeting, and 3-statement financial modeling. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love turning complex operational data into actionable strategic insights, and want to help steer a category-defining brand, this role is for you.

  • 13-Week Rolling Cash Flow:Build, update, and maintain detailed short-term rolling cash forecasts and long-term capital projections.

  • Borrowing Base & Lender Reporting:Prepare, monitor, and certify periodic borrowing base calculations for lender compliance and debt facility management.

  • Executive Decision Support:Support C-suite leadership and board presentations with ad hoc business case evaluations and strategic insights.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience:4+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, or related strategic analytical roles.

  • Cash & Debt Expertise:Proven track record in 13-week cash forecasting, working capital optimization, and credit facility / borrowing base metrics.

  • Advanced Technical Skills:Mastery of Excel / Google Sheets (complex nested formulas, dynamic models, sensitivity tables). High proficiency navigating corporate ERPs (e.g., NetSuite, QuickBooks) and modern BI/reporting tools.

  • Language Proficiency:C1/C2 professional fluency in English (both written and verbal) for daily communication, executive reporting, and cross-team meetings.

  • Location & Setup:Must be based in Latin America with a dedicated home office setup and a verified high-speed, stable internet connection.

  • Mindset:High business acumen, meticulous attention to detail, and a proactive, ownership-driven approach to problem-solving.

jobs.title: Operations Associate (Hiring or Client Delivery)
jobs.excerpt: Grow our AI image service. The roleWe are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency.
jobs.description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

    1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
    2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
    3. Strong written English.
    4. Based in Brazil.
    5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1300 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

The firm partners closely with an extensive panel of major and non-major lenders to support clients across residential home loans, refinancing, and specialized debt structures. Driven by rigorous compliance standards, operational efficiency, and high-touch service, the company delivers a seamless, transparent borrowing experience from initial discovery through to settlement and ongoing portfolio management.

OVERVIEW:

The company is seeking an exceptional, highly analytical Credit Analyst to take operational ownership of the credit assessment and deal structuring lifecycle. Partnering directly with the Principal Broker and collaborating alongside our in-house Loan Processor, you will step in immediately following the client interview via a warm handover to drive applications from initial analysis through to formal approval and settlement.

This role requires deep expertise across complex residential lending scenarios (PAYG, self-employed, trust, and SMSF), rigorous hands-on proficiency in Connective Mercury and Quickli, and a robust compliance mindset to safeguard quality assurance across every file.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Deal Ownership & Warm Handover: Assume primary control of client files immediately following the Principal Broker’s discovery interview; serve as the central operational point of contact for customer inquiries and supplementary document collection.
  • Credit Assessment & Servicing Analysis: Complete end-to-end borrowing capacity calculations using Quickli and individual lender servicing calculators; analyze complex income structures (including self-employed financials, corporate trusts, and SMSFs) and benchmark against policy across major and non-major lenders.
  • Loan Structuring & Scenario Presentation: Formulate and present the top 3 tailored lending solutions for broker sign-off, order upfront property valuations, and execute competitive pricing requests across panels.
  • Broker Notes & Application Packaging: Draft comprehensive, end-to-end Broker Notes and credit compliance narratives; ensure all qualitative and quantitative risk factors are addressed before lodge.
  • Lender & Pipeline Management: Liaise directly with lender credit assessors, credit coaches, and BDMs to overturn conditions, clarify policy nuances, and accelerate MIRs (More Information Required) through to formal unconditional approval.
  • Collaborative Pipeline Support: Oversee and quality-check the Loan Processor’s input into ApplyOnline (AOL) and Mercury CRM; guide the file through unconditional approval, loan document signing, and settlement milestones.
  • Quality Assurance & Compliance Oversight: Conduct thorough pre-submission audits against BID (Best Interests Duty) and responsible lending standards; collaborate with leadership to refine, document, and enforce internal compliance protocols and file checklists.
  • Portfolio Operations & Repricing: Proactively review backbook portfolios during operational lulls to execute repricing requests, identify refinance opportunities, and protect client retention.

Requirements

  • Direct Industry Experience:Minimum 2–3+ years of proven experience as a Credit Analyst or Senior Loan Writer supporting an Australian residential mortgage broking operation.
  • Software Proficiency (Non-Negotiable): Advanced, hands-on working knowledge of Connective Mercury CRM and Quickli servicing software.
  • Credit Policy Mastery: Deep, up-to-date working knowledge of Australian credit policies, NCCP regulations, and servicing methodologies across major banks, regional lenders, and non-bank specialists.
  • Complex File Execution: Proven track record analyzing diverse and complex lending scenarios, including company and discretionary trusts, multi-entity self-employed structures, and SMSF lending.
  • Communication & Professionalism: Flawless verbal and written business English, with the confidence to communicate directly with clients, credit assessors, and key stakeholders.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce, or equivalent industry certifications (e.g., Cert IV or Diploma in Finance and Mortgage Broking).

Preferred

  • Prior background in compliance management, file auditing, or credit coaching within an Australian brokerage or aggregator network.
  • Experience formalizing SOPs, process workflows, and QA checklists for scaling mortgage operations.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring, peer-reviewing, or delegating administrative workflows to junior processors and support staff.

What You’ll Bring

  • A High-Precision Credit Lens: An analytical, investigative approach to bank statements, tax returns, and financials that catches discrepancies before an assessor does.
  • End-to-End Ownership: A proactive operational posture that independently drives deals forward rather than waiting on direction.
  • Collaborative Leadership: The poise and team-first attitude required to partner seamlessly with the Principal Broker and Loan Processor to elevate total client experience.
  • Process-Driven Discipline: Strong organizational bandwidth capable of juggling multi-stage pipelines, tight SLA targets, and backbook retention campaigns without compromising accuracy.

jobs.description:
About Welo Global

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com

About the Role

We're hiring a technically strong Senior Data Analyst to help modernize how our FP&A organization uses data, analytics, and automation. This is an embedded Finance role: you'll report directly to the FP&A Director and work side by side with her day to day while partnering closely with our central Data Analytics and Data Engineering teams on infrastructure, standards, and complex technical problems. It's a hands-on execution role for someone who builds.

Financial and operational data at Welocalize lives across multiple systems - Workday Financials, Adaptive Planning, Salesforce, a Redshift data warehouse, Power BI, and years of Excel workbooks carrying critical processes. Much of it doesn't connect cleanly, and a lot of institutional knowledge lives in undocumented spreadsheets, manual processes, and Power Queries rather than any system of record.

You might start with a complex, years-old Excel workbook and a simple prompt: “This is how we do this today.” Your job isn't to automate the workbook as-is - it's to understand its purpose, trace its logic to source, figure out what users actually need, and design something better: a rebuilt pipeline, a SQL/Python replacement, a driver-based view, an exception-monitoring workflow, or an AI-assisted tool.

We're just starting to build out an FP&A AI repository - documentation, business logic, and workflows meant to let AI reliably execute FP&A processes, not just answer one-off questions - and you'll partner with us to determine its direction.

This role is a deliberate combination of three things:

1. Fluency with data itself - the ability to query, shape, and manipulate data directly.

2. An engineering mindset - building automated, repeatable systems (workflows and dashboards that run and refresh on their own, integrations across tools) rather than one-off analysis, and knowing how to scope and coordinate real pipeline or data mart work with Data Engineering.

3. An investigative instinct - the ability to look at data and figure out what it's telling us, not just execute a report exactly as specified.

What You'll Do

    Partner directly with FP&A leadership to understand existing reporting, analytical, and planning processes and identify where they should fundamentally change, not just get faster.

    • Reverse-engineer complex Excel workbooks and manual processes to understand their data sources, business logic, calculations, and the questions their users are actually trying to answer.

    • Design and build automated solutions using SQL, Python, ETL/data transformation, APIs, and modern AI tools.

    • Work through large, imperfect, multi-system datasets - resolving data quality, mapping, reconciliation, and grain issues along the way.

    • Perform exploratory analysis to identify trends, anomalies, relationships, and underlying business drivers, rather than simply reporting what happened.

    • Design dashboards and reporting experiences around the decisions people actually need to make, not a recreation of an existing spreadsheet in a new tool.

    • Build AI-assisted, interactive HTML reporting tools - developed with the help of AI coding tools and engineered to refresh efficiently on their own, without repeated AI calls.

    • Develop driver-based analysis, exception reporting, and monitoring approaches that surface important changes proactively.

    • Explore and build AI-assisted and agentic workflows - including ways for LLMs to interact with data, tools, APIs, and reporting processes.

    • Partner with the central Data Analytics and Data Engineering teams on shared data infrastructure and standards - including scoping and coordinating data pipeline and data mart requests.

    • Contribute in a leadership capacity within the analytics function even without formal management responsibility - shaping how problems get approached, mentoring by example, and helping set the bar for analytical rigor.

    • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insight for Finance leaders and other business stakeholders.

    • Partner in building out our FP&A AI repository - the documentation, conventions, and workflows meant to let an AI assistant execute FP&A processes reliably - and help shape its direction as we go.

How You Think

    Technical skills matter, but how you approach problems matters just as much. We're looking for someone who:

    • Is genuinely curious and naturally asks “why?” when something doesn't reconcile or doesn't make sense.

    • Enjoys digging into messy or unfamiliar data and figuring out how things connect.

    • Doesn't assume an existing process or report is right simply because that's how it's always been done.

    • Can take an ambiguous problem and independently structure an approach to solving it, while knowing when to pull others in rather than spinning wheels alone.

    • Looks beyond the initial request to identify opportunities, risks, and better approaches the requester may not have thought to ask for.

    • Enjoys collaborative problem-solving - bouncing ideas around, testing hypotheses, and challenging assumptions to get to a stronger answer.

    • Takes ownership of the areas they work in - the business purpose, the data, the known issues, and the opportunities for improvement - rather than treating each request as a one-off ticket.

    • Likes building things, experimenting, and continuously improving how work gets done.

Required Skills and Experience

    5-10 years of relevant experience required. You should be genuinely, hands-on strong across:

    • SQL - comfortable joining tables, tracing grain, finding duplicates, and validating results in unfamiliar schemas.

    • Python - practical proficiency for data transformation, analysis, and automation.

    • ETL/ELT fluency - strong enough understanding of pipeline design to define data requirements, validate output, and partner effectively with Data Engineering on pipeline and data mart requests. Hands-on pipeline-building experience is a plus.

    • Report and dashboard building - able to design and build a reporting/analytical experience end-to-end, whether on a modern BI platform (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar) or as a standalone interactive HTML/web-based report. Standalone HTML/web-based reports are increasingly our primary format.

    • Automation - demonstrated experience automating manual, recurring data or reporting workflows.

    • Comfort learning and adopting new AI-assisted tools and workflows - you should be genuinely curious about this space and ready to build fluency quickly on the job.

    • Advanced Excel, including the ability to deconstruct sophisticated, undocumented legacy workbooks.

    • Demonstrated ability to explore data and figure out why something happened - forming and testing your own hypotheses, not just reporting what happened.

    • Fluent English, spoken and written. This is a fully remote role and you'll communicate directly, in English, with business stakeholders and executive leadership as well as data analysts and engineers across our global organization, where English is the shared working language.

Preferred Experience

    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related quantitative/technical field strongly preferred; equivalent experience acceptable. Master's degree is a plus.

    • Experience supporting Finance, FP&A, Strategy, Operations, or another analytically intensive business function.

    • Familiarity with financial concepts such as revenue, margin, profitability, forecasting, and variance analysis.

    • Experience modernizing legacy Excel-based reporting or analytical processes.

    • Experience working in an environment where data is distributed across multiple systems and isn't always perfectly documented.

    • Experience working effectively in a fully remote, distributed team environment.

    • Exposure to AI/agentic tooling, or experience helping design how AI gets applied to a business process (e.g., LLM workflows, tool/function calling, RAG, MCP, building AI-assisted reporting or automation).

    • Machine learning, statistical modeling, or formal data science experience is welcome but not required.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.excerpt: At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do.
jobs.description:
At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve.

Colibri Group is a leader in online professional education, serving more than one million learners each year across a family of trusted education brands. Within our Teacher Education Ecosystem, including Moreland University, we connect with aspiring and current educators, alumni, and school leaders to support their professional journeys. Social media helps us build authentic relationships with these audiences and connect them with valuable resources and opportunities.

Come Build What’s Next

We’re looking for a Social Media Manager to lead and grow the organic social media presence of Colibri Group’s Teacher Education Ecosystem. This person will shape how our brands show up across social channels, bring educator-focused stories and campaigns to life, build engaged communities, and use performance insights to support awareness, qualified traffic, leads, and applications.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with meaningful ownership of social strategy, day-to-day content production, community engagement, social measurement, and the management of our existing influencer program. As a general guide, approximately 50% of the role is content creation, 25% is social strategy, and 25% spans analytics, reporting, and influencer-program work. The balance will shift with campaigns and business priorities.

We’re looking for someone who has managed social media on behalf of a company, organization, or agency client and understands what it means to collaborate with a marketing team and be accountable for KPIs. You should be equally comfortable developing a channel plan, filming and editing a short-form video, speaking on camera, tailoring content for different audiences, engaging with followers, and explaining what the performance data says to do next.

Important distinction: This is a professional social media management position, not an influencer, brand ambassador, or personal-content-creator opportunity. You will manage Moreland University's owned social channels and work with external influencers as partners; you will not be hired to promote our brands primarily through your own personal accounts.

What You’ll Do

  • Own organic social strategy and editorial planning: Build audience-specific strategies and content calendars across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging channels. Prioritize Instagram and TikTok for educator audiences, tailor LinkedIn content for school leaders and alumni, and explore authentic, non-promotional participation in relevant Reddit communities. Translate wider Marketing initiatives into platform-native campaigns
  • Create content hands-on, with a strong emphasis on short-form video: Personally concept, script, film, edit, caption, and publish videos; appear confidently in talking-head content and social live events. Independently produce graphics, carousels, stories, and copy using tools such as Canva, collaborate with the Graphic Designer on brand consistency, and develop social assets to promote guides, events, and podcasts (without hosting the podcast)
  • Build and serve engaged communities: Manage organic social accounts day to day, including comments, DMs, tags, audience conversations, and admissions-related questions that need routing to the appropriate team. Proactively identify educator and school-leader stories and opportunities for meaningful engagement, not merely one-way posting
  • Measure performance and continually improve results: Monitor audience growth, reach, engagement, video performance, website traffic, leads, guide downloads, and applications attributable to organic social. Use reporting, experiments, and audience insights to refine creative decisions and channel priorities; demonstrate how social contributes to integrated marketing goals
  • Manage influencer partnerships and collaborate across Marketing: Oversee existing external creators, including briefs, content review, approvals, deliverables, renewals, payment coordination, budgets, and ROI. Recommend when to expand, adjust, or pause partnerships. Partner closely with content, design, and paid media colleagues; direct management of paid advertising is not part of this position. Occasionally support events and content opportunities requiring travel

What You’ll Bring

  • Professional organizational social media experience: Approximately 2–4 years managing organic social accounts for an employer, organization, or agency client, with personal ownership of deliverables and accountability for KPIs. Managing only your own personal influencer accounts does not meet this requirement; additional relevant professional experience is welcome
  • Proven creation and on-camera skills: Direct experience independently planning, filming, editing, and publishing compelling short-form video for a brand, plus the ability to appear on camera and support live social content. Strong social copywriting and hands-on Canva, Capcut, or comparable design skills are also expected
  • Demonstrated growth and analytical judgment: Evidence that you have grown audiences, not solely maintained existing accounts; ability to explain the KPIs you owned, results you achieved, and changes you made based on data. Familiarity with engagement, website traffic, lead or application attribution, and testing is valuable
  • Audience-focused collaboration and execution: Experience adapting tone, formats, and channels for distinct audiences; engaging communities through comments and DMs; and working within a marketing team to manage a busy editorial calendar, multiple priorities, and cross-functional projects
  • Required professional portfolio: Include an accessible portfolio link or relevant work samples showing organizational/client accounts, short-form videos you personally produced, and ideally measurable outcomes. Redacted or anonymized case studies are welcome for confidential work. Education/edtech experience, previous influencer-program coordination, Reddit knowledge, a related bachelor's degree, and familiarity with tools such as Sprout Social or ClickUp are helpful but not required. Occasional travel may be necessary

Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use

Experience with every tool below is not required. We care more about your ability to create strong work, manage the process, and make decisions from results than about checking specific software boxes.

  • Social channels: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and Reddit or other educator communities
  • Video creation: CapCut or comparable filming and editing workflows. The team is open to effective tools you already know and use
  • Design and production: Canva, Capcut, and brand templates or design review with an in-house Graphic Designer
  • Scheduling, analytics, and collaboration: Sprout Social or comparable social management and native analytics tools; ClickUp or similar project-management platforms
  • Measurement and improvement: Reporting dashboards, campaign tracking, tests, performance reviews, and thoughtful use of AI for ideation, research, repurposing, or productivity while maintaining originality and brand standards

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Own the organic social presence of a mission-driven education ecosystem and shape how our brands show up online
  • Create original, video-first content and tell relevant stories for teachers, future educators, alumni, and school leaders
  • Grow priority channels such as Instagram and TikTok while testing thoughtful community opportunities, including Reddit
  • Collaborate with content, design, and marketing colleagues while retaining autonomy over day-to-day creative execution
  • Connect creative work to measurable engagement, leads, and applications while helping evolve an established influencer-partnership program

We Encourage You to Apply

You may not check every preferred box, and that is okay! We welcome applicants with relevant experience in education, edtech, consumer brands, nonprofit or mission-driven organizations, agencies, and other environments where they have managed professional social channels, served distinct audiences, and delivered measurable results.

However, this position does require professional responsibility for an organization’s or client’s social presence, hands-on short-form video creation, comfort contributing on camera, and the ability to assess performance against KPIs. If your experience has primarily been creating content for your own personal influencer accounts, without managing an organization’s or client’s channels and results, this role is unlikely to be the right match.

A professional social media portfolio or relevant work samples must be included with your application to be considered. Please share a working link to campaigns, social accounts, video examples, or case studies that demonstrate your direct work and impact. If your work is confidential, you may submit redacted or anonymized case studies and examples that respect client or employer requirements.

If you enjoy creating content yourself, collaborating within a marketing team, using data to make it better, and helping real communities connect with an education brand, we would love to hear from you.

What You Can Expect From Our Hiring Process

We want our interview process to give you a clear picture of the role, the team, and what it’s like to work at Colibri while giving us the opportunity to understand your experience, how you approach your work, and what you’re looking for next. We do not use AI to review applications; your application is reviewed by a human on the Talent Acquisition team. While the exact process may vary slightly by role, you can generally expect:

1. Recruiter Conversation: An introductory conversation with Talent Acquisition about your professional social media background, interests, expectations, and fit for this position

2. Hiring Manager Conversation: A deeper conversation with the Senior Director of Marketing, including review of your work, approach to short-form video, audience segmentation, strategy, and results

3. Team / Cross-Functional Conversation: A conversation with team members, focused on collaboration and the capabilities relevant to day-to-day success in this role

4. Final Conversation and Decision: A final conversation with the team. For finalists, there may be an optional opportunity to connect with additional content teammates. Talent Acquisition will share details and preparation expectations throughout the process.

Application deadline: Tuesday, October 20th, 2026.

Our goal is to make the experience thoughtful, respectful, and transparent. We encourage you to ask questions throughout the process—we’re evaluating the opportunity together.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Colibri Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds, experiences, and career paths to apply.

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Analyst with deep expertise in hospital claims adjudication, stop loss reporting, high-cost/catastrophic claims, and DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) reimbursement methodology.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Analyst with deep expertise in hospital claims adjudication, stop loss reporting, high-cost/catastrophic claims, and DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) reimbursement methodology. This individual will analyze itemized hospital bills and claims data to identify billing errors, coding discrepancies, DRG misassignments, and other overpayment opportunities, then work directly with claims administrators on behalf of our ASO clients to secure claim adjustments, recoveries, and repricing.

This is a highly analytical, client-facing role requiring both technical claims expertise and strong negotiation/communication skills.

This is a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Claims Analysis & Review

  • Perform detailed audits of hospital and facility claims, including itemized bills, UB-04 claim forms, medical records, and remittance advices, to validate billing accuracy.

  • Analyze DRG assignments and coding to identify DRG upcoding, unbundling, duplicate billing, and other irregularities that affect reimbursement.

  • Review high-cost and catastrophic claims (typically $100K+) to identify overpayments, contract misapplication, and opportunities for negotiated adjustments.

  • Evaluate claims against plan documents, provider contracts, reference-based pricing methodologies, and CMS guidelines to determine appropriate reimbursement.

Stop Loss & High-Cost Claims Expertise

  • Understand and apply stop loss (specific and aggregate) provisions, laser terms, and reporting requirements as they relate to claim adjustments and client financial exposure.

  • Coordinate with stop loss carriers and reinsurers as needed to ensure adjustments and recoveries are properly reflected in stop loss reimbursement calculations.

  • Identify claims nearing or exceeding specific deductible thresholds and prioritize review accordingly.

Client Advocacy & Claims Administrator Negotiation

  • Serve as the subject matter expert and advocate on behalf of ASO clients in disputes with claims administrators (TPAs) and carriers regarding claim payment accuracy.

  • Prepare clear, well-documented findings packages (clinical, contractual, and coding rationale) to support requested claim adjustments and appeals.

  • Lead or support negotiations with claims administrators to reach adjusted payment resolutions.

  • Track disputes through resolution, escalating unresolved cases appropriately and maintaining strong working relationships with TPA claims and provider relations teams.

Data & Reporting

  • Analyze large claims data sets to identify trends, outlier claims, and systemic overpayment patterns across client populations.

  • Build and maintain claim tracking logs, savings reports, and client-facing summaries of identified and recovered savings.

  • Partner with internal data/analytics teams to refine claim-flagging logic and improve identification of high-value review opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • Hospital/Surgical/ICU Nursing background (RN) and clinical coding background for clinical validation of DRG and medical necessity issues.

  • 5+ years of experience in hospital claims analysis, medical bill review, claims auditing, or payment integrity, with direct exposure to self-funded/ASO plans.

  • Strong working knowledge of DRG methodology (MS-DRG/APR-DRG), UB-04 billing, ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT/HCPCS coding, and hospital chargemaster structures.

  • Demonstrated understanding of stop loss insurance, including specific/aggregate deductibles, laser provisions, and how claim adjustments impact stop loss reimbursement.

  • Experience analyzing high-cost/catastrophic claims and identifying overpayment or billing error patterns.

  • Prior experience interacting with or negotiating against TPAs, insurance carriers, or claims administrators on disputed claims.

  • Proficiency with claims data analysis tools (Excel required; SQL, Access, or claims analytics platforms a plus)

  • Knowledge of policy terms, coverage guidelines, statutory/regulatory compliance requirements and litigation/dispute workflows.

  • Ability to interpret and translate in common terms legal contracts, summary plan descriptions (SPDs), and statutory guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build persuasive, well-supported adjustment requests and appeals.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage a high volume of complex claims simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Medical Bill Review Specialist, or similar credential.

  • Prior experience at a TPA, insurance carrier, hospital billing/coding department, or payment integrity/cost containment vendor.

  • Familiarity with reference-based pricing (RBP), Medicare fee schedules, and out-of-network claims repricing.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent identification of material overpayments and billing errors on high-cost hospital claims.

  • Strong track record of securing favorable claim adjustments through negotiation with claims administrators.

  • Clear, professional communication that strengthens client trust and TPA relationships.

  • Measurable contribution to client savings and stop loss cost containment.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Every closed-won deal starts as a signal. Your job is to make sure none of them get lost.

As Senior Manager, Demand Generation Operations, you'll be the strategic business partner to Abnormal's Revenue Marketing and Digital Marketing leaders, and the person who connects marketing activity to revenue outcomes. Reporting to Ted Noble, VP of GTM Operations, you'll translate ARR and pipeline targets into operational demand generation strategies and execution roadmaps, then ensure we are exceeding our plan for full funnel from MQL to Closed Won. When conversion stalls, a handoff breaks, or a stage gets stuck, you'll find out why and fix it. This is a role for someone who is energized by funnel math, cross-functional alignment, and turning messy data into clear decisions, and who wants to help make Abnormal the #1 AI-native company.

The targets are ambitious because the momentum is real. Abnormal closed FY26 at roughly $380M in ARR, growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. As we expand from email security into the Abnormal Behavioral AI platform, the funnel gets more complex: more products, more buying committees, and more paths from first touch to closed-won. Hitting our growth goals depends on a demand engine that is measured clearly, managed tightly, and improved every quarter. You'll build and run that engine.

What You Will Do

  • Turn targets into plans. Translate ARR and pipeline targets into operational demand generation strategies, funnel models, and execution roadmaps, working back from revenue goals to the volume, conversion, and velocity needed at every stage.
  • Be the strategic partner to marketing leadership. Serve as the operational business partner to the leaders of Revenue Marketing and Digital Marketing, helping them plan, prioritize, and invest where the funnel says it will matter most.
  • Own the lead lifecycle model. Establish and refine the end-to-end lead lifecycle model (MQL, GP, SAL, QP, POV, Closed Won), conversion benchmarks, and Sales-Marketing Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Run the funnel reviews. Lead regular pipeline velocity and campaign performance reviews with Sales, Business Development (BDR/SDR), and Marketing executives to identify funnel bottlenecks and optimize conversion paths.
  • Solve bottlenecks from MQL to Closed Won. Diagnose where and why pipeline stalls, whether in lead quality, speed-to-lead, handoffs, stage progression, or win rates, and drive the fixes with the teams that own them.
  • Hold the line on SLAs. Monitor SLA adherence and stage latency across Marketing, SDR, and Sales teams, and make performance visible so accountability is shared and gaps get closed quickly.
  • Connect programs to pipeline. Partner with Marketing Operations and Revenue Analytics to measure campaign and channel performance against pipeline and revenue, so investment decisions are grounded in real outcomes.
  • Plan for a multi-product funnel. Help evolve the funnel model, targeting, and account-based planning as we sell more products into more buying committees across the platform.
  • Use AI to see problems sooner. Bring an AI-first mindset to funnel monitoring, using automation and AI-driven insights to surface early warning signs and recommended actions before they become missed quarters.
  • Partner across GTM. Work closely with Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Systems & Analytics, Sales, and SDR leadership so systems, definitions, and reporting stay aligned across the funnel.

Must Haves

  • 7+ years of experience in demand generation operations, marketing operations, revenue operations, or a related analytical GTM role at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.
  • Proven track record translating revenue and pipeline targets into demand generation plans and funnel models.
  • Deep experience designing and managing lead lifecycle models, stage definitions, conversion benchmarks, and Sales-Marketing SLAs.
  • Experience leading pipeline and campaign performance reviews with senior Sales and Marketing leaders, and driving action from the findings.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with funnel, attribution, and pipeline data across Salesforce, marketing automation, and BI tools.
  • Working knowledge of lead scoring, routing, and marketing attribution, and how they affect funnel performance.
  • Exceptional cross-functional communication skills, with the credibility to align Marketing, SDR, and Sales leaders around shared definitions and goals.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with tools in our ecosystem, such as Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, Snowflake, and Sigma.
  • Experience supporting account-based marketing and multi-product or platform GTM motions.
  • Background in cybersecurity or another technical, enterprise-focused category.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

$153,000—$220,000 USD
