Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a People Operations Associate to join our team.

Position Description

Oklo is seeking a People Operations Associate to help support and scale the foundation of our People function. This role is ideal for someone who has developed an early HR career foundation and is ready to expand their impact by contributing to a broader range of people related functions.

The ideal candidate is Workday HRIS fluent and understands how to leverage the tool to drive company growth, can pick up new skills quickly, and lean into the multi-faceted aspects of this role.

This role can be remote but, we are seeking someone who is located in the Eastern Standard Timezone.

Specific responsibilities may include:

HR Systems, Workday Administration & Process Excellence

  • Support day-to-day Workday administration, including employee transactions, organizational changes, data updates, and routine system maintenance
  • Maintain accurate employee and organizational data in Workday through regular audits, data validation, and issue resolution
  • Support Workday configuration, business process improvements, enhancements, integrations, and semiannual releases, including testing changes, documenting results, and identifying issues
  • Create and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, and analytics used by People Operations and leaders across the company
  • Troubleshoot routine Workday questions and transaction issues, escalating more complex configuration or technical issues as appropriate
  • Maintain Workday process documentation, job aids, and internal guidance to support consistent system use
  • Identify opportunities to streamline and automate People processes through Workday while improving system adoption, data quality, and reporting capabilities

HR & Talent Operations

  • Maintain accurate employee records and ensure data integrity across HR systems
  • Provide administrative support to the talent team by maintaining headcount tracking and scheduling
  • Serve as a point of contact for employee questions regarding HR programs, policies, and processes
  • Support organizational changes, transfers, and employee data updates
  • Assist with policy administration and employee communications

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Support compliance with federal, multi-state, and local employment laws and regulations
  • Co-manage I-9 administration, employee documentation, and audit readiness activities
  • Assist with leave administration, accommodations processes, and other compliance-related workflows
  • Monitor regulatory changes and help update policies and procedures accordingly
  • Partner with People leadership on compliance initiatives and process improvements

Reporting & Workforce Analytics

  • Develop and maintain recurring People metrics and dashboards
  • Analyze workforce trends related to headcount, turnover, recruiting, compensation, and employee engagement
  • Create ad hoc reports and presentations for leadership
  • Leverage Excel and reporting tools to provide actionable workforce insights
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency and data accuracy

Benefits & People Programs

  • Support benefits administration and employee enrollment processes
  • Assist with annual open enrollment and employee education efforts
  • Help coordinate employee programs, engagement initiatives, and People team projects
  • Support performance management and talent development processes as needed

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
  • 2+ years of HR, People Operations, HR Coordinator, HR Associate, or related experience
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience using Workday as a primary HRIS.
  • Experience creating reports, auditing employee data, and supporting HR transactions within Workday.
  • Strong understanding of HR data management, reporting, and system governance.
  • Ability to navigate Workday independently with minimal training.
  • Located in Eastern timezone

Bonus Qualifications:

  • SHRM-CP or PHR certification (can be in progress)
  • Experience supporting multi-state employee populations
  • Experience in a technology, engineering, manufacturing, or high-growth startup environment
  • Greenhouse or similar ATS experience
  • Experience supporting benefits administration and employee relations processes
  • Experience creating dashboards and workforce analytics reports

Competencies

We are looking for a People Operations Associate that is:

  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Knowledgeable about Workday HRIS
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $85,000-$105,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

Toast is looking for a Senior Director, Customer Care Operational Excellence to own how our customer support organization operates, end to end. This is a build-and-run role: you will design (and continuously redesign) the people, process, systems, and data that determine whether every customer, from our smallest SMB accounts to our largest Enterprise relationships, gets a fast, effortless, high-quality resolution.

This role sits at the center of our AI transformation of Support operations, evaluating, implementing, and scaling AI across chat, voice, and agent-assist workflows, while also owning the fundamentals: workforce planning and capacity, quality and performance measurement, and a closed-loop voice-of-customer program that feeds directly into our product and engineering roadmaps. You will lead a team, and this is a hands-on role: you're expected to get into the details, run point on hard problems personally, and build things yourself when needed.

Support Operating Model: People, Process & Systems

    • Own the end-to-end design of how Support operates: org structure, staffing model, tiering/routing, escalation paths, and channel model (chat, email, phone, self-service, community), and continuously refine it as the business scales.
    • Build and run the operating cadence for the function: performance reviews, root-cause/escalation reviews, leadership readouts, and continuous-improvement rhythms.
    • Segment design so that SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise customers each get a service model appropriate to their needs, complexity, and value.
  • AI & Support Technology Transformation
    • Own the roadmap for AI-enabled support, including virtual agents/chatbots, voice AI, agent-assist, and automation, from business case through implementation, measured adoption, and iteration.
    • Partner with Product and Engineering as a co-owner of the tools and systems Support runs on: helpdesk/CRM, contact center (CCaaS), knowledge base, and AI/automation platforms, representing Support's requirements and stress-testing what's shipped.
    • Evaluate, select, and manage the vendor and technology stack (including AI vendors and BPO/outsourcing partners), balancing cost, quality, and customer experience.

Data, Insights & Performance Measurement

    • Define the metrics that matter for Toast’s support operations, including but not limited to TTR/resolution time, CSAT, customer effort (CES), quality/QA scores, cost-to-serve, and AI containment/deflection rate. Partner with Analytics to build the reporting and analytics and associated insights to drive operations across lines of business, segments, channels, and geographies.
    • Build a rigorous quality assurance program (QA scoring, calibration, coaching feedback loops) to ensure consistency as the org scales and as AI takes on more of the work.
    • Use data to diagnose root causes of poor experience and prioritize the highest-leverage fixes across people, process, and systems.
  • Voice of the Customer & Product Feedback
    • Own Product Feedback program in partnership with VOC and other related efforts: capturing, synthesizing, and prioritizing feedback and issues surfaced through Support.
    • Build the formal, closed-loop mechanism that routes customer and product feedback to R&D/Product leadership, ensuring it gets actioned and tracked through to impact on support volume and CSAT.
  • Workforce Planning & Capacity Management
  • Own workforce planning, forecasting, and capacity management (staffing, scheduling, shrinkage, real-time management) across in-house and outsourced/BPO teams.
  • Model the impact of AI automation on headcount and capacity plans, and adjust staffing levels as containment rates change.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Partnership

    • Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership as a genuine design partner on tools, features, and AI capabilities that affect the customer experience or support workload.
    • Represent Support in cross-functional planning (Sales, Success, Finance, Legal/Compliance, Trust & Safety) and ensure Support's operational needs and constraints are reflected in company-wide decisions.
    • Communicate performance, risk, and plans to executive leadership through regular business reviews.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

    • Build, lead, and develop a team of operations and operational excellence managers/leads; build the bench and succession plan for the function.
    • Instill a hands-on, builder culture on the team: this function should be as comfortable running an analysis or drafting a process itself as it is directing others to do so.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 12+ years of experience in Customer Support/Service, Customer Experience, or Support Operations, including significant leadership experience at the Director level or above.
  • Track record building and scaling support organizations inside large, high-growth technology companies, ideally B2B/B2B2C, that went through significant scale (multiple X revenue/customer growth) rather than steady-state maintenance.
  • Direct, hands-on experience implementing AI in a support organization (virtual agent/chatbot, voice AI, agent-assist, automation), able to speak to what was built, how it was measured, and what it actually did to cost and experience.
  • Experience supporting multiple customer segments (SMB through Enterprise) with differentiated service models, SLAs, and channels.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills; fluent working with support/CX data and BI tools, and comfortable building models (capacity, cost-to-serve, ROI) independently.
  • Experience with workforce management/capacity planning disciplines and tools.
  • Proven cross-functional partnership with Product and Engineering, including influencing roadmaps without direct authority.
  • A genuine doer, willing and able to roll up their sleeves, get into the weeds of a process or a dataset, and personally drive a problem to resolution rather than only directing others to.
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent a plus but not required.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

About the Role

Abnormal was built to spot what everyone else misses. The same instinct should power how we run our business.

As Director, Revenue Systems & Analytics, you'll own the technology and the truth behind Abnormal's go-to-market engine. Reporting to Ted Noble, VP of GTM Operations, you'll lead the strategy, roadmap, and team behind our marketing, sales, and customer success tech stacks, and you'll build the executive-level analytics that show how the whole revenue machine actually performs, from first touch to renewal and expansion. This is a role for a restless builder: someone who sees a disconnected stack or a siloed dashboard as an invitation to redesign it, and who wants to help make Abnormal the #1 AI-native company, starting with how we go to market.

The scale is real and growing fast. Abnormal closed FY26 at roughly $380M in ARR, growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. As we expand from email security into a broader behavioral AI platform, the motions get more complex: more products, more buying journeys, more handoffs between Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success. Your systems and your numbers will be what keeps all of it connected, and what lets leadership see clearly where growth is coming from next.

What You Will Do

  • Own the GTM tech stack end to end. Lead strategy, architecture, and roadmap across the marketing, sales, and customer success technology ecosystems, treating them as one connected revenue platform rather than three separate toolsets.
  • Build a roadmap that drives growth. Align every system investment to company strategy and revenue goals, prioritizing ruthlessly based on impact to pipeline, conversion, retention, and expansion.
  • Lead with an AI-first approach. Define how AI and agentic workflows show up across the GTM stack, from automating manual work to surfacing insights reps and leaders can act on. Set the standard that AI accelerates decisions without sacrificing accuracy, auditability, or trust in the data.
  • Make revenue analytics the single source of truth. Lead the Revenue Analytics function and build and maintain executive-level dashboards that show true end-to-end performance across the full customer lifecycle, so leaders from the CEO down are working from the same numbers.
  • Break down silos. Design metrics, definitions, and reporting that cut across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, uniting every team around the shared goal of growth instead of functional scorecards.
  • Govern data like it matters. Partner closely with Data and Finance on data quality, governance, and metric definitions so GTM reporting reconciles cleanly and holds up in board and executive settings.
  • Manage the stack as a business. Own GTM software strategy, vendor relationships, budget, and renewals, consolidating where it makes sense and investing where it moves the needle.
  • Build and lead the team. Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team of systems, data, and analytics professionals, including people leaders, and grow the next generation of leaders within GTM Operations.
  • Be a strategic partner to GTM leadership. Work hand in hand with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, IT, and Security leaders to translate business priorities into systems and insights, and bring a clear point of view on what the data says about where to go next.

Must Haves

  • 10+ years of experience in GTM systems, revenue operations, or revenue analytics at a high-growth B2B SaaS company, with at least 5 years leading teams.
  • Proven track record owning a multi-function GTM tech stack (marketing, sales, and customer success) and delivering a strategic roadmap tied to revenue outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in Salesforce as the core system of record, plus hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse and BI platform for executive reporting.
  • Experience building executive and board-level dashboards that connect the full funnel, from pipeline generation through bookings, retention, and expansion.
  • Strong command of GTM metrics and definitions (pipeline, conversion, ARR, net and gross retention, forecast) and the credibility to defend them in front of senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated experience bringing AI and automation into GTM systems and workflows, with sound judgment about where it helps and where it adds risk.
  • Experience managing software budgets, vendor negotiations, and stack rationalization.
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership: the ability to align Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and IT around shared priorities and shared numbers.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with tools in our ecosystem, such as Marketo, Gainsight, Gong, Snowflake, Sigma, Workato, and Highspot.
  • Background in cybersecurity or another technical, enterprise-focused category.
  • Experience scaling GTM systems and analytics through a multi-product or platform expansion.

jobs.description:
Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.
A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.
Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.

We are seeking a Senior EPMS Design Engineer who thinks in terms of scalable, mission-critical systems and high-reliability operational architectures. As a senior member of the Controls Design Engineering (CDE) team, you will own the technical development, design standardization, and system integration of Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) across our global fleet.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between electrical design concepts, controls engineering, and operational reality. You will serve as the primary owner for global EPMS specifications, network architectures, and control logic—ensuring that our critical power infrastructure (including switchgear, generators, UPS lineups, and distribution units) delivers robust telemetry, fault visibility, and automated power monitoring for hyperscale environments.

Key Accountabilities

    • Design & Architecture Governance: Author and maintain detailed EPMS design deliverables, including network architecture diagrams, Sequences of Operation (SOO), Basis of Design (BOD) documents, input/output (I/O) points lists, and project scopes of work (SOW).

    • Standards & Specifications: Own and maintain company-wide Division 25 (Integrated Automation) and Division 26 (Electrical) EPMS specifications, standardized drawing templates, and telemetry schemas.

    • Engineering Document & Drawing Reviews: Review detailed MEP design drawing packages—with a deep focus on electrical single-line diagrams, three-line diagrams, and control schematics—to ensure complete EPMS coverage, redundancy, and metering alignment.

    • Submittal & Long Lead Equipment (LLE) Audits: Review electrical equipment manufacturer submittals (switchgear, UPS systems, PDU/RPP units, generators, ATS) to ensure factory-installed meters, protection relays, and gateways comply with communication and telemetry standards.

    • Vendor & Bid Coordination: Create detailed EPMS vendor scopes of work, review technical proposals during contractor bidding, evaluate control system integrators, and manage technical Requests for Information (RFIs) to drive down scope gaps and change orders.

    • Hardware & Communications Architecture: Specify control panel requirements, PLC hardware lineups, and communication protocols (Modbus RTU/TCP, BACnet/IP, and TCP/IP), ensuring optimal bus capacity and network segmentation.

    • Cross-Functional Integration: Define integration strategies linking EPMS to industrial PLCs, Building Management Systems (BMS), Branch Circuit Monitoring Systems (BCMS), and cloud telemetry brokers (e.g., MQTT / Sparkplug B architectures).

    • Testing & Quality Assurance: Participate in Factory Witness Tests (FWTs) and Equipment Qualification Tests (EQTs) to validate point mapping and EPMS device functionality on first-of-kind electrical assemblies.

    • Commissioning & Construction Support: Conduct QA/QC audits on active builds, supporting commissioning agents through L1–L5 testing phases, point-to-point checkout validation, and final "As-Built" package reviews prior to Ready For Service (RFS) handoff.

    • Operational Root-Cause Support: Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) to diagnose complex system anomalies, including Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), or power metering discrepancies.

Required Skills

    • Experience: 5+ years of direct experience in Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) design, engineering, or systems integration within data centers or mission-critical facilities.

    • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, or commensurate industry/military experience in lieu of degree.

    • Engineering Documentation: Demonstrated expertise in generating and interpreting electrical single-line diagrams, control network schematics, sequences of operation, control panel layouts, and Bills of Materials (BOM).

    • Protocols & Industrial Networks: Strong working knowledge of industrial communication protocols including Modbus (RTU and TCP), BACnet (MS/TP and IP), and Ethernet TCP/IP networking.

    • System Knowledge: Hands-on design fluency with PLC-based EPMS architectures, Branch Circuit Monitoring Systems (BCMS), and power metering hardware.

    • Specifications: Demonstrable experience authoring or interpreting CSI Division 25 and Division 26 specifications.

Preferred Skills

    • 7+ years of progressive engineering experience within hyperscale or colocation data center infrastructure.

    • Deep understanding of critical data center electrical infrastructure, including medium/low voltage switchgear lineups, static transfer switches (STS), UPS lineups, transformers, power distribution units (PDUs), and utility/generator paralleling logic.

    • Familiarity with cloud data aggregation models and modern telemetry brokers (e.g., MQTT, Sparkplug B, Inductive Automation Ignition).

    • Experience participating in L1–L5 commissioning cycles, Integrated System Testing (IST), and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT).

Work Location & Travel Expectations

    • Location: Flexible; preferences include primary operational hubs (Georgia, Texas, or Arkansas).

    • Travel: Up to 25% travel to global data center construction sites, equipment manufacturing facilities for Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and corporate functions.

jobs.excerpt: At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health.
jobs.description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Senior Training Specialist to join our Operations, Client Support team. This role would be responsible for developing and delivering impactful training programs that drive employee performance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across Client and Provider Support. We are looking for someone who is collaborative, adaptable, and passionate about learning and development, and is passionate about making a meaningful impact and bringing their talents into a “for purpose” space. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

  • Instructional Design and Training
    • Design, develop, and maintain training programs for Client Support and Provider Support, including new-hire onboarding, role-specific training, certifications, process and system training, and ongoing upskilling.
    • Create engaging learning experiences across a variety of formats, including self-paced eLearning, instructor-led materials, job aids, tutorials, demonstrations, assessments, and interactive activities.
    • Apply adult learning principles and instructional design best practices to ensure training is engaging, accessible, and aligned with defined learning and business outcomes.
    • Continuously review and refresh curriculum based on learner feedback, performance data, process changes, and evolving business needs.
    • Facilitate live and virtual training sessions, new-hire nesting, demonstrations, guided practice, and other learning experiences for Client Support and Provider Support.
  • Training Administration and Learning Systems
    • Manage training assignments, enrollments, completion tracking, attendance, and learner progress through the LMS and other internal systems.
    • Coordinate training schedules and communicate training requirements and expectations to learners, Supervisors, and other stakeholders.
    • Maintain accurate training documentation and provide completion and learner performance information to relevant stakeholders.
  • Data Analysis & Performance Optimization
    • Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, learner feedback, operational data, and other performance indicators.
    • Use data to identify knowledge and skill gaps, recommend learning interventions, and continuously improve training programs.
    • Maintain department skill assessments and skill matrices to support curriculum development, employee growth, and future training needs.
    • Track and communicate training initiatives, outcomes, and opportunities for improvement to leadership and relevant stakeholders.
  • Collaboration & Strategic Partnership
    • Partner with Client Support and Provider Support leadership to identify learning opportunities and develop strategies that address knowledge and performance needs.
    • Collaborate with SMEs and cross-functional partners to translate complex processes, workflows, systems, and business requirements into clear and effective learning experiences.
    • Serve as a trusted training resource during organizational, process, and system changes, helping teams successfully adopt new expectations and workflows.
    • Contribute to training standards, best practices, and broader learning initiatives across the organization.
    • Perform other related duties as assigned.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Education, Communications, Learning & Development, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in instructional design, training, learning and development, or a related field.
  • Experience designing and delivering training for adult learners, including self-paced eLearning and instructor-led training.
  • Experience with eLearning authoring tools such as Articulate Rise, Storyline, Captivate, or similar platforms, as well as Learning Management Systems.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, project management, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to translate complex processes and information into clear, engaging learning experiences.
  • Data-driven approach to evaluating training effectiveness and identifying opportunities for improvement.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, customer support, contact center, or operations environments preferred.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
  • PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $70,000 - $80,000/yr. Within the range, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.excerpt: Why Join GEICO? At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.
jobs.description:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Overview:

The Business Intelligence Analyst III / IV is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise business intelligence and visual analytics solutions that enable data-driven decision-making. This role transforms complex data into meaningful reports, dashboards, semantic models, and analytical solutions that support operational and strategic business outcomes.

The associate partners with business stakeholders, technology teams, and data engineering partners to deliver scalable visual reporting solutions, establish semantic modeling standards, and translate advanced analyses into clear recommendations. Microsoft Power BI is the primary business intelligence platform for this role; however, the associate is expected to remain agile and use Apache Superset or other visualization tools when they are better suited to the business need.

As a member of an agile team, the incumbent contributes to solution design, development, testing, deployment, optimization, production support, report certification, and modernization of enterprise reporting assets. The role focuses on business intelligence and visual analytics rather than primary ownership of source-data engineering or Power BI tenant administration.


Level Expectations :


Business Intelligence Analyst III: Designs end-to-end BI solutions, including semantic and metric layers, data models, reports, and dashboards. Applies advanced analytical and statistical techniques to move reporting from descriptive insight toward diagnostic analysis of performance drivers and customer behavior, while introducing predictive approaches where appropriate. Works independently with minimal guidance, leads solution components, partners with stakeholders to frame analytical questions, and provides technical guidance to peers.

Business Intelligence Analyst IV: Leads the design of complex, reusable BI solutions and serves as a technical lead for reporting and analytics initiatives. Balances regular delivery responsibilities with leadership of cross-functional projects, establishes semantic modeling and reporting standards, reviews technical designs, influences BI architecture and tooling decisions, and mentors analysts and developers across levels.


Responsibilities:


  • Design end-to-end business intelligence solutions, including semantic and metric layers, dimensional data models, reports, dashboards, scorecards, and visual analytics products.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize Power BI semantic models, reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions using DAX, Power Query, and enterprise reporting standards.
  • Apply advanced analytical and statistical techniques to identify trends, performance drivers, customer behaviors, and opportunities for operational improvement.
  • Translate descriptive reporting into diagnostic insight and introduce predictive approaches where appropriate to the business question and available data.
  • Partner with stakeholders to frame analytical questions, evaluate findings, and translate complex analyses into clear, compelling recommendations.
  • Establish, document, and promote semantic modeling standards, reusable design patterns, visualization standards, and reporting best practices.
  • Support report certification by validating solution quality, consistency, usability, maintainability, performance, documentation, and adherence to established standards.
  • Publish and support Power BI solutions through Power BI Service, including Workspaces, Apps, Deployment Pipelines, and semantic model refresh processes.
  • Optimize report and semantic model performance, refresh reliability, storage-mode selection, and overall user experience across BI platforms.
  • Assess the downstream impact of design choices involving Import, DirectQuery, composite models, Row-Level Security, refresh strategies, and available Power BI capacity.
  • Evaluate visualization technologies and select Power BI, Apache Superset, or other appropriate tools based on business need, scalability, maintainability, and user experience.
  • Use Snowflake and other approved enterprise data sources to deliver reliable, scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Coordinate with data engineering and technology partners to ensure source data is available, reliable, understandable, and usable for reporting.
  • Document report definitions, calculations, assumptions, semantic models, technical designs, and support procedures.
  • Lead improvements to reporting processes, including automation of recurring outputs and reduction of manual effort.
  • Support report migration and modernization initiatives, including conversion of legacy reporting solutions to modern BI platforms and reusable semantic model architectures.
  • Perform testing, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, performance tuning, and post-implementation support.
  • Participate in agile planning, backlog refinement, estimation, status reporting, and cross-functional delivery coordination.
  • Provide technical guidance to team members through design, DAX, query, and solution reviews.
  • Business Intelligence Analyst IV: Serve as technical lead for complex reporting and analytics initiatives, lead cross-team projects, review technical designs, and mentor analysts and developers across levels.

Qualifications:

  • Advanced experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting business intelligence solutions using Microsoft Power BI or comparable enterprise visualization platforms.
  • Strong proficiency with DAX, semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, Power Query, data visualization, and enterprise BI architecture.
  • Experience publishing and supporting Power BI solutions through Workspaces, Apps, Deployment Pipelines, and semantic model refresh processes.
  • Advanced SQL knowledge, including the ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimize complex queries used in reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical and analytical concepts for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving, organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an agile delivery environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver reliable solutions with minimal guidance.
  • Must have the following experience:
  • Business Intelligence Analyst III: 4-7 years of relevant business intelligence, analytics, reporting, semantic modeling, or data visualization experience.
  • Business Intelligence Analyst IV: 7-10 years of relevant business intelligence, analytics, reporting, semantic modeling, or data visualization experience.
  • Experience developing enterprise dashboards, reports, semantic models, and visual analytics solutions.
  • Experience partnering with stakeholders to define business questions, gather requirements, assess findings, and deliver actionable reporting solutions.
  • Experience working with enterprise data platforms and large-scale datasets.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300).
  • Microsoft Power BI administration certification or equivalent demonstrated knowledge of Power BI administration concepts.
  • Strongly preferred experience with Microsoft Fabric features such as Lakehouses, Warehouses, Dataflows Gen2, Data Pipelines, Notebooks, Real-Time Intelligence, and related capabilities.
  • Strongly preferred experience using Snowflake as a primary enterprise data source for reporting and analytics.
  • Experience with Apache Superset or other business intelligence and visualization platforms, with the ability to select the appropriate visual tool for the business use case.
  • Experience developing or supporting Apache Airflow workflows.
  • Experience with Power BI Project (PBIP) formats and collaborative development of Power BI assets.

About VALIS

We’re a fast-moving, rapidly growing B2B SaaS company focused on bringing modern technology to the metal recycling industry — an essential but underserved market segment. Our technology helps recyclers close more deals, operate more efficiently, and finally ditch the pen-and-paper workflows.

We’re an early-stage company, backed by leading climate-tech VCs, looking to bring on new team members that can help us build VALIS and transform the industry. We lead with authenticity, boldness, passion, and empathy focused on creating a more sustainable future. A career at VALIS is one where you’ll be empowered to expand your technical and leadership abilities while having a positive impact on the world.

The role

As a Software Engineer at VALIS, you'll build and scale our newest product line, taking it from a blank page to the plant floor. You'll spend time with operators and plant managers, design the schema and application, and deliver a product that scrap processors rely on to run their plant. Working directly with our CTO, product team, and end users, you'll make the architecture and design decisions, prioritize what gets built when, and see your work used every shift, every day. We're hiring across mid-senior levels, from a few years experience to senior engineers.

What you'll do

  • Own the product end-to-end: data model, API, UI, UX, deployment, and iteration.
  • Design a multi-tenant domain model (materials, loads, runs, equipment, quality) that holds up as each customer's process differs.
  • Build fast, robust, validated data-entry workflows for the plant floor.
  • Deliver insights dashboards managers act on each shift.
  • Meet with operators and facility managers weekly, get on-site, and turn what you see into product decisions.
  • Integrate new data sources with existing VALIS data and customer systems such as ERP exports, scales, and plant controls.
  • Build and deploy agentic features to surface trends from production and quality data, flag anomalies, and notify the right people.

How we work

  • Remote, US-based. Work from anywhere in the US, overlapping with East Coast business hours (roughly 9am to 5pm ET).
  • Small team, low overhead. You'll work directly with our CTO, along with a product and business team with deep industry experience.
  • Our stack: React and TypeScript on the frontend; C# and ASP.NET Core with PostgreSQL on the backend; AWS, Docker, and Pulumi for infrastructure.
  • We use Claude Code heavily and expect you to be highly effective with it. You should own and understand the code you ship; AI speeds up the work but does not replace the thinking.
  • Travel a few times a year for customer site visits and company get-togethers (on-site at our HQ in Worcester, MA or off-site elsewhere).

Requirements

Who you are

We hire for fundamentals & mindset. You:

  • Have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience (for senior candidates, 5+ and have led technical projects).
  • Think data model first: you can turn a messy real-world process into a clean, normalized schema... and defend the tradeoff decisions.
  • Use types, clear boundaries, and domain language to make wrong states hard to represent.
  • Are comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, finding solutions without waiting for instruction.
  • Are solid across databases, backend APIs, and frontend fundamentals.
  • Are mathematically minded, with strong quantitative and statistical fundamentals, so the numbers we show customers are ones they can trust.
  • Move fast, cut scope wisely, and don't shy away from talking to customers.
  • Write and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical team members (we're a remote team).

It won't be a good fit if you want a big team to lean on, a slow/low-risk release process, or narrow-scoped work.

If this role really excites you, but you don't check all the boxes, apply anyway!

Bonus points

  • Familiarity with our stack (React, TypeScript, C#/.NET, PostgreSQL, AWS).
  • You've worked in metals or materials recycling (or another heavy industry) and understand the people who run those operations.
  • You've built ERP, MES, inventory, logistics, or other operations software where data-entry correctness matters.
  • You've built multi-tenant B2B SaaS where each customer's workflow is a little different.
  • Experience with plant or device data: scales, PLCs, SCADA, MQTT, or ERP integrations.

Benefits

  • Base salary: $125,000 to $155,000, depending on experience level
  • Meaningful equity through our employee stock option plan
  • 401(k) with employer matc
  • Medical, dental, and vision insuranc
  • Unlimited vacation, plus: sick time, guaranteed personal time, and public holiday

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an Account Manager, Client Development & Renewals, you will be tasked with owning a book of existing customer accounts and driving both renewal retention and expansion revenue within them. This is not a transactional renewals seat; it is a growth-first role where renewal is the floor, not the goal, and you will protect the base by keeping renewals healthy and on time and grow it by uncovering and closing whitespace, running consultative upsell and cross-sell conversations, and turning satisfied customers into expanding ones. You will sit within the Client Development / Renewals organization and partner closely with Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and Sales Engineering, in a role built for a rep who is driven to outgrow a base they know well, own their numbers, and earn a path to strategic accounts or AE-track roles through expansion results.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own a portfolio of existing accounts, carrying a dual quota of renewal retention and expansion bookings (upsell/cross-sell); identify whitespace across the SentinelOne product portfolio and run consultative expansion conversations, leading with customer use cases and outcomes, not just quotes; spot expansion triggers early, including new use cases, org growth, underutilized licenses ready to convert, and competitive displacement openings; build repeatable account plans with your CSM and SE partners that map multi-year growth, not just the next renewal.
  • Manage renewals end to end, from early quoting and multi-threading through negotiation and on-time close; keep renewal timelines definitive and forecasts predictable across your book, so the primary focus remains on whitespace and expansion with your accounts; handle commercial negotiation on your accounts, including multi-year commitments, with support on the most complex deals.
  • Identify churn and downgrade risk early by watching deployment health, usage, support signals, and sentiment across your accounts; run save motions on at-risk accounts, pulling in CSM, Support, and leadership when needed; flag overdeployment/downgrade exposure and get ahead of it before it hits the renewal.
  • Own an accurate, transparent forecast across both renewal and expansion pipeline for your book; keep Salesforce and CPQ/quoting tools current, with accurate stages and a renewal/expansion pipeline you can defend; structure and close deals cleanly, using approved pricing and quote automation.
  • Partner with CSMs on account coverage so there is no gap or overlap, and with AEs and SEs on expansion opportunities; partner with our Channel/MSSP partners on renewal continuity and baseline growth for partner-managed accounts; bring the customer's voice back to Product and the broader team, including what is working, what is stuck, and where the next opportunity is.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 3 to 5 years in renewals, account management, or a customer-facing sales role, with upsell/cross-sell closing experience on your record, ideally in SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • A track record of hitting or beating quota, including driving net revenue retention above 100 percent on your own book (expansion outpacing churn), not just renewal completion.
  • Proven experience running consultative upsell/cross-sell motions and identifying and closing whitespace within an existing customer base.
  • Comfort managing multi-stakeholder conversations and negotiations, with direct experience negotiating with senior/economic buyers.
  • A risk-aware instinct: you notice the early signals of churn or downgrade and act before renewal time.
  • Strong forecasting discipline and CRM hygiene; hands-on with Salesforce and CPQ/quote tools.
  • Strong communication and organization, curiosity about customer use-cases and the product, and a habit of opening expansion conversations without being prompted.
  • Exposure to Channel/MSSP or 2-tier GTM models is a plus, not a requirement.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off

Work Perks & Flexibility

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach

  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.

About the Role:

Roon is seeking a hands-on technical leader to drive engineering execution, architectural decisions, and technology strategy. In partnership with leadership and engineering management, this role ensures that technical direction aligns with business and product goals while balancing scalability, efficiency, and innovation. You will be the linchpin of our application development teams, steering us towards greatness. Your role is not just about writing code – it's about leading the charge in critical architectural decisions that define the foundation of our B2C products. Unleash your creativity and technical prowess to build and uphold exceptional standards that become benchmarks in our industry. Embrace the challenge of creating cutting-edge technologies that position us as leaders and be instrumental in charting the course to a future defined by innovation and excellence.

This role is focused on hands-on technical contribution and decision-making, technical oversight, and the enablement of engineering success rather than direct team management. You will evaluate trade-offs between legacy and new technologies, drive high-impact solutions, and ensure technical execution supports Roon’s growth and product vision. Additionally, you will play a key role in resolving cross-product technical challenges where clear ownership is not established, ensuring alignment and collaboration across development teams.

Your Team:

Dedicated to perfecting the suite of Roon products, you and the technology teams share a commitment to delivering an unmatched, immersive music experience. By blending state-of-the-art technology, creative design, and user-friendly features, the teams strive to enrich the lives of audiophiles and music lovers worldwide. Their commitment to fostering a collaborative and innovative culture ensures that each team is equipped to contribute their expertise. While this role shares development and execution with the teams, it also owns the shaping of technical direction, guiding strategic decisions, and ensuring alignment with business priorities.

You will collaborate closely with leadership and R&D team management to ensure that technical execution supports Roon’s long-term product, platform, and market goals. Additionally, you will drive alignment across both Product and Engineering.

What You Will Do

  • Lead Development Across Platforms:
    • Guide Roon’s overall technical direction in collaboration with leadership and engineering management.
    • Lead high-impact architectural decisions, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with product strategy.

  • Guide and Mentor:
    • Act as a technical advisor to leadership, supporting decision-making with clear, well-reasoned technical insights.
    • Mentor and collaborate with engineering teams, fostering a culture of high-impact decision-making and best practices
  • Collaborate and Communicate:
    • Partner with leadership to ensure technology decisions align with business needs.
    • Advise and collaborate with engineering management, supporting technical direction without directly managing teams.
    • Work cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Analytics to ensure engineering efforts enhance the user experience.
    • Identify and resolve execution bottlenecks, ensuring timely delivery of key initiatives.
  • Deliver Excellence:
    Anticipate risks and challenges across domains, crafting solutions that align with organizational goals while delivering engaging, user-focused experiences. Balance immediate deliverables with long-term vision to inspire confidence and excitement among stakeholders.

What You Need:

  • Proven Expertise:
    20+ years of software development experience, with a strong record of delivering high-quality solutions in areas such as:
    • Cross-platform desktop and mobile application development.
    • User Interface engineering.
    • Databases and backend programming.
    • Networking and real-time communication.
    • Audio technologies and streaming systems.
    • Graphics, including real-time rendering or image processing.
    • Performance profiling, debugging, and optimization for scalable software solutions.
    • Experience evaluating and balancing legacy vs. new technology investments based on ROI and business impact.
  • Technical Mastery:
    • Recognized as an internal technical expert with broad knowledge across domains and technologies.
    • Deep expertise in consumer-facing (B2C) software development, particularly using C#.
    • Ability to anticipate and adapt to industry trends, driving the adoption of new technologies and practices.
  • Leadership and Strategy:
    • Proven ability to lead complex engineering projects and technical teams.
    • Experience in defining and implementing core engineering principles, processes, and standards across teams.
    • Strong decision-making skills, balancing immediate needs with long-term strategic goals.
    • Ability to balance immediate technical needs with long-term strategy.
  • Communication and Influence:
    • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
    • Strong ability to build relationships with stakeholders and influence business direction and product priorities through technical insight and innovation.
  • Passion for Innovation:
    • A track record of creativity and innovation in solving complex problems and delivering new products or services.
    • Deep interest in audio networking, streaming technologies, and crafting exceptional user experiences.

What is Nice to Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field.
  • Experience with C/C++ programming.
  • Experience in GPU programming, specifically real-time rendering and image processing.

JOB TITLE

Senior IT Systems Analyst

LEVEL/BAND

MM22

DEPARTMENT

Technology

DIRECT REPORT (JOB TITLE)

​Product Owner

Overall Purpose of the Position

The purpose of this role is to analyse, design and define technological solutions and system changes while supporting the Solution Architect in large scale initiatives, as necessary.

The main aim of the Senior System Analyst is to analyse business requirements and translate the requirements into detailed technical specifications – changing the WHAT into a HOW.

Operational Responsibilities

·To assist his/her manager and/or team lead to by sharing technical expertise on specific solutions.

·To assist the manager and/or team lead in defining and updating System Analysis process improvements and procedures.

·To create effective technical documentation to help facilitate the understanding of such technical requirements.

·To ensure completeness of technical requirements and functional architecture analysis for the design and implementation of technological solutions.

·To perform the assigned tasks in an efficient and effective manner, and within the agreed timelines and quality.

·To provide alternative technical solutions to overcome technical challenges, by being creative and innovative.

·Work efficiently and provide solutions that are of benefit to the Bank but still aligned with the Bank’s policies and Enterprise Architecture framework.

Analytical Responsibilities

  • To liaise with the business analyst/s and/or client/s to ensure compliance with business requirements and agreed specifications.
  • Design technical solution to achieve business objectives and document all work in accordance with agreed standards.
  • Validate and further develop functional requirements into technical requirements/specifications.
  • Derive non-functional requirements from a technical perspective (server uptime, bandwidth, network, etc).
  • Derive technical requirements/specifications.
  • Conduct technical impact assessment & determine dependencies (systems, architecture, data architecture, infrastructure, IT security perspective).
  • Preparing cost benefits and analysis reports for upgrades.

Parameterisation

  • To mentor and support colleagues through knowledge sharing.
  • To contribute and support during capacity and task planning of all System Analysis processes within both business-as-usual and project related activities

General Responsibilities

·To build relationships and liaise with various stakeholders across the business to ensure cohesion and drive a collaborative work environment.

·To submit any reports and/or supervise any projects and activities as may be directed from time to time.

·To support the manager and/or team lead in participate in the definition of an IT Governance framework and compliance, when needed.

·To support the manager and/or team lead during prioritisation of IT initiatives.

·To perform any duties that may be assigned to him/her from line management from time to time.

·Keeps abreast of new and emerging technologies and propose any relevant technical training for the System Analysist team.

Qualifications, Skills & Competencies

Mandatory

Skill

  • ·Knowledge of Information Systems Analysis and Software Development.

    ·Good communication skills (including written and verbal) - able to relate to various members of the organisation.

    ·Knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle.

    ·Customer Driven with an ability to prioritise issues based on impact.

    ·Excellent critical analysis and creative skills.

Experience

  • Three years of experience in areas of Systems Analysis or a similar role.

  • Experience of working under pressure and to tight deadlines.

  • Background in application development.

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or other related field.

Desirable

Skill

    ·Good presentation skills.

    ·Ability to tackle simultaneous tasks.

    ·Understanding the concept of CI/CD practices.

Experience in using CI/CD pipelines and tools

Job Description

Responsible for the design, development, testing, automation, and support of complex on-premises and cloud-based software and technology solutions. This role will help advance the Center of Excellence by delivering solutions across enterprise automation suites, application integration, scripting, reporting, and AI-enabled automation. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering fundamentals, hands-on automation platform experience, and the ability to learn and apply different technologies across a variety of complex assignments.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain automation solutions, integrations, scripts, reports, and AI-enabled solutions using the technologies best suited to each business need.
  • Write clean, testable, maintainable code following established software engineering standards.
  • Develop reusable frameworks, tools, and automation patterns using company-approved technologies.
  • Partner with engineering, architecture, infrastructure, and business teams to translate complex needs into technical solutions.
  • Support CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, and DevOps practices across development environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex development and production issues and implement solutions that improve reliability and performance.
  • Build reporting and monitoring capabilities.
  • Evaluate and implement generative AI use cases with appropriate testing, human oversight, and adherence to security and data-handling standards.
  • Research emerging technologies and provide technical guidance and mentorship to less experienced team members.

What You Bring   

  • Bachelor's degree or advanced degree (where required)
  • 5+ years of experience in related field.
  • In lieu of degree, 7+ years of experience in related field.

Bonus Points 

  • Experience with enterprise automation suites, with a strong preference for UiPath. Experience with Microsoft Power Automate is also valued.
  • Supporting experience in one or more of the following: Python, .NET/C#, PowerShell, Power BI, or generative AI for AI-assisted workflows and automation.
  • Experience with AWS services and cloud automation.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar technologies.
  • Experience creating reusable automation frameworks or capabilities within a Center of Excellence, platform engineering, DevOps, or enterprise technology organization.
  • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, security automation, and cloud governance practices.

What You’ll Get 

  • The opportunity to work at the cutting edge of health care delivery with a team that’s deeply invested in the community  
  • Work-life balance, flexibility, and the autonomy to do great work   
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage along with numerous health and wellness programs   
  • Parental leave and support plus adoption and surrogacy assistance   
  • Career development programs and tuition reimbursement for continued education   
  • 401k match including an annual company contribution   
  • Learn more   

Where You’ll Work

Our Hybrid Flex approach is built on presence with a purpose – giving you flexibility to work remotely with intentional in-person connection – that supports a workplace that’s flexible, connected, and future focused.

In a Hybrid-Flex role, you’ll work in the office at least two days a week for collaboration and connection. In a Remote Flex role, you’ll work virtually, with a few in-office visits each year for meaningful moments that matter.

Whether your role is Hybrid Flex or Remote Flex depends on the nature of the work and distance from our Durham headquarters. We welcome candidates from outside the local area and in any states listed on this job posting. Onsite expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Salary Range

At Blue Cross NC, we take great pride in a fair and equitable compensation package that reflects market-price and our starting salaries are typically planned near the middle of the range listed. Compensation decisions are driven by factors including experience and training, specialized skill sets, licensure and certifications and other business and organizational needs. Our base salary is part of a robust Total Rewards package that includes an Annual Incentive Bonus*, 401(k) with employer match, Paid Time Off (PTO), and competitive health benefits and wellness programs.

*Based on annual corporate goal achievement and individual performance.

$107,901.00 - $172,642.00

jobs.description:
Are you an engineering leader who has scaled a SaaS organization through managers and turned AI-assisted development into measurable results?

CXT Software provides the technology backbone for courier, route delivery, and healthcare logistics companies. Our customers run their daily physical operations on our software, so reliability, predictable delivery, and strong regression control are not optional.

We are looking for an AI-Native VP of Software Engineering to lead our engineering and SaaS operations organization end to end and to define how it builds and runs software in the AI era. You will own people, architecture, quality, delivery, production reliability, and customer outcomes. Our stack is .NET, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Angular, SQL, MAUI, and Azure PaaS.

Reporting to the CTO, you will shape how we build and run software with AI, verify adoption through real behavior rather than dashboards, and shape its evolution with evidence. You will be measured on quality, reliability, cycle time, predictability, and customer impact.

If you want to lead a serious engineering organization and define how it works with AI, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilties

  • Lead, hire, and develop Directors, architects, and their teams; set and hold the hiring bar.
  • Make AI-assisted development, testing, review, and operations the way the organization works; verify adoption through real behavior, not dashboards; and coach leaders and skeptical senior engineers through the change.
  • Run engineering experiments with baselines and clear scale, modify, or stop decisions.
  • Own quality, releases, and production reliability: uptime and SLAs, on-call, incidents, security operations, and cloud cost.
  • Own architecture across our products, including legacy modernization and standards for AI-generated code.
  • Plan and deliver the roadmap with Product, raise trade-offs early, and drive customer escalations to root cause with Customer Success.

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 12+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in engineering leadership and 2+ years managing managers.
  • Led a multi-team engineering organization through managers, across several products with separate codebases, including legacy modernization.
  • Led engineering for a B2B SaaS product and owned its production operations through a team: reliability, on-call, incidents, security operations, and cloud cost.
  • Uses AI coding assistants and agents in production work today, and has led their adoption across multiple teams with measured results.
  • Designed and run engineering experiments with baselines, success metrics, and clear decision criteria.
  • Hands-on experience running flow-based delivery (Kanban or similar) at scale, with CI/CD, automated testing, and release management.
  • Still reads code and reviews architecture; experience in our stack is a plus.
  • Led a remote, distributed engineering organization; professional English; regular overlap with North American business hours.

Nice to have

  • Software architect or Staff/Principal engineer background.
  • Logistics, routing, dispatch, courier, or healthcare operations software.
  • Azure managed services, infrastructure as code, SRE, SOC 2, or FinOps.
  • Integrating teams that join through acquisition, or running engineering across multiple business units.
  • Building AI-enabled product features such as embedded agents, MCP connectors, or AI vision.

Benefits

More than just perks, they're part of what makes working at CXT Software great.

  • Access to leading AI engineering tools and platforms, and a real mandate to shape how they are used across the organization.
  • 100% remote and global: live your best life wherever that may be, and never lose out on career opportunities because of it.
  • Flexible work hours: we work asynchronously and care about results and customer satisfaction, not when you're online.
  • Dedicated growth path: consistent, meaningful feedback and support toward your career goals.
  • Access to leading tools, playbooks, and technology across the Ionic portfolio.
  • Engaging community: coffee chats, happy hours, cooking classes, book clubs, and more.
CXT Software is an equal opportunity employer. This is a fully remote independent contractor engagement and is not eligible for company-sponsored employee benefit programs. We welcome applications from any country where we can lawfully engage you. If you need an accommodation during the application process, you can request it once you apply.
