jobs.description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Software Engineering Intern to join a team that builds infrastructure and agentic AI services for teams across the company. Our job is to remove other teams' bottlenecks: we build and run core internal services that power large geo-distributed infrastructure, and a growing share of what we ship is driven by AI agents. As an intern, you will work alongside senior engineers to design, build, and ship production systems – from backend services that run automated workflows at massive scale to AI agents that take routine work off engineers' plates. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience with agentic AI and modern infrastructure while contributing to real products used by teams across NVIDIA.


What you'll be doing:

  • Work with senior engineers to design, build, and improve backend services and APIs for internal platforms that run automated workflows at massive scale
  • Build AI agents and agentic workflows that connect LLMs to tools and internal services, and integrate them into production systems
  • Help make agents reliable and safe in production – from access control and guardrails to evaluating agent quality
  • Assist in building data pipelines and GPU job orchestration for synthetic data generation and model evaluation at scale
  • Implement and improve observability (tracing, metrics, logging) for distributed services and agents
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging, and apply software engineering best practices in a production environment
  • Work in a product-minded way: talk to internal users, prototype quickly, collect feedback, and iterate

What we need to see:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • Strong programming fundamentals in at least one of: Go (preferred), Python, or C#
  • Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms
  • Basic knowledge of software design patterns and API design concepts
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs – for example, a project, prototype, or coursework that uses LLM APIs
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git)
  • Understanding of database concepts and SQL
  • Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn new technologies
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience building AI agents or LLM-powered applications: tool/function calling, MCP, RAG, or agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit)
  • Experience with distributed systems concepts (REST APIs, microservices architecture) and containerization (Docker)
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), GPU workloads, and infrastructure automation
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes)
  • Experience with database technologies (MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch)

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the most desirable employers in the world. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If you are creative, autonomous and love a challenge, we want to hear from you. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

This is a scam targeting a number of companies, us included. If you receive any of these types of messages, we recommend that you don’t respond with any information and that you block and report those users.

  • The MANSCAPED Team


Who We Are - MANSCAPED® is a leading men’s grooming and lifestyle consumer brand on a mission to introduce and elevate a whole new self-care routine for men. What began as the category creator of below-the-waist grooming has quickly evolved into a global omnichannel powerhouse available around the world on manscaped.com, Amazon, and in major retailers including Target®, Walmart, and Best Buy. As a company, we’re more than just ball jokes (though, rest assured, there’s plenty of those). We proudly uphold seven core values – accountability, authenticity, collaboration, fun, humility, inclusivity, and innovation – which define our brand identity and drive our success. As a people-centric employer brand, we are deeply committed to fostering the growth, happiness, and holistic well-being of each individual on our team.

Who We’re Looking For - Reporting to the Sr. Director, Digital Technology Development, we are seeking a hands-on, full-stack Manager, Digital Technology Development to lead a team of developers, both onshore and offshore, who build and run the MANSCAPED® direct-to-consumer platform: the Shopify Plus storefront and checkout, the headless web experience, the Node.js middleware and integrations behind it, and the cloud infrastructure it runs on. This is a technical manager role: the ideal candidate spends a meaningful part of every week in the code – reviewing pull requests, setting engineering standards, unblocking developers and building features – while owning backlog and change management with the Team PM, hiring, performance management, vendor relationships and production health, and partnering with Product, DTC, Marketing, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Applications, the Digital Technology architect and leadership on budget, KPIs and the evolution of the stack.

 

The MANSCAPED® Way - At MANSCAPED®, what we do matters – but how we do it matters more. We take ownership of our work, showing up with accountability and a commitment to quality at every level. We work as one team, guided by a belief to unite, never divide, and to lead with empathy in how we support and challenge one another. The best ideas win, and they come from keeping our egos in check and our standards high. We stay humble, open to learning, and willing to grow. We bring fun to the journey, because great work shouldn’t come at the expense of enjoying what you do. We stay nimble and innovative, always looking for smarter and better ways to get things done. Ball work is honest work, and that mindset shows up in everything we do, including our proud partnership with the Testicular Cancer Society and our commitment to raising awareness of the ball-busting disease.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and prioritize quarterly, bi-annual and year-end goals and key initiatives, including key launch dates and peak-season code freezes aligned with other org deadlines
  • Lead team of developers (Onshore/Offshore) to ensure backlog is managed effectively; partner with Team PM on estimates, capacity planning, the change management process and new priorities
  • Own code quality for Digital Technology: define the code review process and standards for testing, CI/CD, secure coding and documentation, personally review architectural and high-risk pull requests, and lead resolution of technical issues in the programs being developed
  • Participate up to 20-30% in development and deployment related activities – building features, fixing production defects and developing initial SDK implementations for new software being onboarded by MANSCAPED®
  • Assure production functions are performing properly every day and all alerts from Site Reliability, QA and Cybersecurity are championed to closure, assign priority, and allocate resources as needed – use appropriate scrum or meetings to ensure these teams are effective in supporting Digital Technology
  • Track Digital Technology KPIs: site availability and performance, checkout health during key trading periods, and delivery metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore)
  • Participating in scrum meetings including backlog grooming, scrum of scrums (cross Team meeting weekly)
  • Hiring, Onboarding, performance management and career development for Digital Technology developers, including offshore consultants; raise offshore proficiency through pairing, code review and clear standards
  • Facilitate external vendor relationships and meetings, define ways of working and manage vendor onboarding/offboarding
  • Determine right mix of internal and external resources based on defined and agreed objectives with leadership
  • Be the point of contact for mission critical SaaS that MANSCAPED® depends on by building key relationships within the vendor (Like Shopify, Ordergroove, Kount, Ketch, Ablr, Netlify), being aware of support options and escalation paths
  • Work with Sr. Director, Digital Technology Development to ensure understanding of budget (including SaaS and cloud spend) and defining ownership of specific spend
  • Partner with the Digital Technology architect on designs, standards and the roadmap for the tech stack, and ensure the team builds to the agreed architecture
  • Build client relationships (DTC, Marketing, Legal, Product Management) for internal clients and external partners to ensure visibility and support
  • Champion secure development practices with Cybersecurity: dependency vetting, secret detection and vulnerability SLAs
  • Plan and facilitate face to face meetings for the Development team as necessary to promote cohesion

Qualifications:

Rise8 builds custom, secure software for government organizations, measuring success by impact: lives saved, time returned, and missions advanced.

We think big, start small, and scale fast with elite teams across product, design, and engineering to drive continuous delivery for critical missions.

We believe customer experience starts with employee experience, so we take care of our employees. Rise8 is where you’ll do the best work of your career—supported by a culture you won’t find anywhere else. We offer competitive pay and benefits, but what sets us apart is our commitment to autonomy, growth, and a culture rooted in kindness, candor, and continuous learning.

Certified as a Great Place to Work®, with 100% of employees saying they love working here, Rise8 is where bold ideas become real capabilities. Where mission meets meaning. And where fewer bad things happen because of bad software.

About You

  • You’re mission-driven and measure success by impact (lives saved, time returned, missions advanced), not activity.
  • You think big, start small, and scale fast. You treat time as the biggest vulnerability and security as something that enables speed.
  • You lead with kindness and candor: you give honest feedback, take it well, and raise the bar for everyone around you.
  • You’re an owner. You thrive with autonomy, act decisively, and stay steady when things are uncertain.

As a Platform Engineer III at Rise8, you will:

  • Create and implement automated configuration and deployment processes to enhance the performance, accessibility, and ease of management of the platform and its related services.
  • Establish and manage administrator and service accounts, while also maintaining accurate system documentation and effectively resolving technical issues.
  • Utilize scripting tools to craft self-service capabilities within the Platform as a Service (PaaS), fostering a seamless developer experience for development teams.
  • Collaborate closely with developers to diagnose and troubleshoot problems, ensuring smooth operations.
  • Take on the operational responsibility for the services under your team's ownership.
  • Thrive in an environment that nurtures your personal development and growth.
  • Ability to work "on-call" to support customer needs
  • Continuously enhance the product, delivering software that resonates positively with users and meets their needs effectively.
  • Champion AI-augmented ways of working across your engagement(s), leveraging AI tooling to accelerate delivery, reduce cycle time, and drive better outcomes at scale.

Qualifications

jobs.description:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

Jeeves is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our engineering team. You will design and build the backend systems that power Jeeves's financial platform — working across payments, cards, spend management, and compliance infrastructure that serves businesses across the Americas and beyond.
This is a backend engineering role at its core, we're looking for a strong backend engineer who knows how to work effectively with AI tools, understands where AI can accelerate development and product capabilities, and is comfortable integrating AI-powered features into production backend systems.
Location: This is a full-time remote position.

What You'll Do:

    Backend Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable backend services that process financial transactions and serve Jeeves customers across 20+ countries.
  • Write clean, testable, production-quality code in Go, Python, or Node.js/TypeScript; participate actively in design and code reviews.
  • Build and consume RESTful and GraphQL APIs; design inter-service communication using gRPC, message queues, and event-driven architectures.
  • Design and optimize relational and non-relational database schemas (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) for correctness, performance, and scale.
  • Own backend features end-to-end — from scoping and technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Implement security best practices: authentication, authorization, input validation, and data protection across distributed services.

    • AI-Assisted Feature Development

  • Integrate LLM API calls (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into backend services as product features — such as spend categorization, document parsing, or natural language workflows — ensuring those integrations are reliable, observable, and cost-efficient.
  • Build backend pipelines that consume AI-generated outputs safely: validate structured outputs, handle fallback scenarios, and design graceful degradation when AI services are unavailable or return low-confidence results.
  • Collaborate with AI and data science teams to integrate model outputs into backend APIs — bridging experimental AI work and production systems.
  • Use AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, etc.) fluently as part of your everyday development workflow.

    • Reliability & Operations

  • Instrument services with structured logging, distributed tracing, and metrics for full operational visibility.
  • Participate in on-call rotation; respond to production incidents and contribute to post-incident reviews.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements, testing infrastructure, and deployment practices.

    • Cross-Regional Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering, product, compliance, and data teams across multiple time zones and regions — communicating in both English and Spanish or Portuguese as the situation requires.
  • Contribute to a globally distributed engineering culture through thorough documentation, async design reviews, and thoughtful pull request feedback.
  • Bring your regional perspective to product and engineering conversations — our LATAM customers have specific needs, and engineers who understand those markets make our product better.

Requirements:

    Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience building and operating production systems.

  • Fluent in English — professional fluency required for daily work with global teams in written and spoken contexts.

  • Strong proficiency in at least one backend language: Go, Python, or Node.js/TypeScript.

  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven backend systems.

  • Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred): schema design, query optimization, and data modeling.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate third-party APIs reliably in production — including error handling, retry logic, and observability.

  • Experience working on globally distributed teams across time zones and regions.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of everyday engineering work — integrating LLM API outputs into backend services and using AI coding assistants fluently.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, or a regulated industry — familiarity with ledger systems, payment rails, or financial compliance (KYC/AML, PCI-DSS) is a strong plus.

  • Fluent in Spanish or Portuguese — preferred for collaboration with LATAM teammates, customers, and operational partners.

  • Prior experience at a startup or high-growth scale-up, comfortable building in ambiguity without heavy process support.

  • Experience with multi-currency systems or cross-border payment processing.

  • Familiarity with message queue systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and event-driven architecture.

  • Global work experience — prior roles at companies operating across multiple countries and regulatory environments.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff Director
jobs.excerpt: About Nerdio At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.
jobs.description:
About Nerdio

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

About the role

Nerdio has an incredible opportunity for a hard-charging, rigorous, "learn it all" individual to partner closely with our President and Co-Founder. This is a front-row seat to how a fast-growing software company actually gets run. You will help drive and implement the biggest decisions in our GTM organization and be in a role with significant accountability and visibility into your decisions.

As Chief of Staff, GTM, you will own the rhythm of the business for Nerdio's entire Go-To-Market organization. The operating cadence, the metrics, the meetings and the follow-through that keep a fast-moving team pointed at the same goals. You'll prepare for and advise on our most important customer and partner engagements. You'll also work hand in hand with Revenue Operations, Finance, HR, IT and Sales leadership to make the whole GTM engine run better.

You will report to Nerdio's President and GTM leader. Your job is to turn strategy into focused priorities, processes that scale, and results we can measure. You'll be a core member of the GTM team’s Leadership Team and will work to get leaders aligned and clear out whatever is slowing us down across the customer journey. Removing friction and speeding up processes needs to be your superpower.

The ideal candidate loves figuring things out and crossing items off lists. You dig into a messy situation, form a point of view, and walk in with a clear recommendation for a senior leader. If you want to learn how to run a company by helping run one, this is the job.

This is a demanding, high-impact role that requires exceptional commitment, flexibility, and responsiveness to the evolving priorities of the President and the GTM organization. The hours are long, and your schedule will often follow the President's. The trade-off is worth it. In a few years you'll pick up more than most people learn in ten and you'll come out ready to run something big yourself.

What you'll do

  • Rhythm of the business for GTM: leadership meetings, MBR/QBR, AOP Planning cycles, operating cadence, executive business reviews, and additional internal meetings that keep the organization focused, aligned, and accountable.
  • GTM planning, strategic initiative execution, and follow-through and accountability on commitments made in leadership meetings.
  • Commercial and customer meeting preparation, including acting as a strategic advisor ahead of and following key customer, partner, and executive engagements.
  • Business insights, Sales Opex, budget partnership, and decision support for GTM leadership.
  • Internal GTM operations, partnering with HR, Finance, Revenue Operations, and IT to optimize rhythm of business, resourcing, and performance.
  • Process, systems, and AI-enabled improvements that help GTM teams operate with greater focus, speed, and accountability.
  • Tracking all follow ups and actions for the President.

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by the clarity of GTM priorities, effectiveness of cross-functional execution, the ability to build scalable operating practices that support Nerdio's next stage of growth and the speed by which you can process and get things done. Additionally, success will be measured on the President’s ability to focus time and attention on the highest-leverage priorities for Nerdio.

Your Partnership with the President

  • Drives the President's staff/leadership meetings, capturing decisions and action items, then owns follow-up and accountability for commitments made there, holding leaders to agreed actions and timelines.
  • Owns the internal GTM meetings and operating cadence (e.g., leadership meetings, business reviews, planning sessions): sets the agenda, prepares the materials, runs the meeting, and drives follow-through.
  • Prepares the President for commercial and customer engagements and serves as a strategic advisor on them: synthesizing account and pipeline context, framing key asks and risks, and following up on commitments afterward. Some travel will be required to accompany the President to customer and partner engagements.
  • Acts as a filter/prioritizes what reaches the President's desk; helps manage executive time and focus (the "business manager" piece).
  • May represent the President in certain forums when he isn't in the room.
  • Operates with a high degree of discretion and trust - will be exposed to confidential strategy, people, and performance information.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive GTM operations strategy aligned with our overall business objectives. Work with executive leadership to make sure our strategy and annual plan are integrated and drive the success of the organization. Build trust with GTM leadership.
  • Cross Functional Partnership: Work closely with Finance, HR, IT, Revenue Operations, and other GTM teams to keep everyone aligned and collaborating well. Build processes that improve communication and coordination between departments and foster a culture of collaboration and efficiency.
  • Revenue Insights & Accountability: Partner closely with Revenue Operations to maintain visibility into pipeline e health, sales execution, and partner sales contribution on behalf of the President. Surface risks, gaps, and opportunities early. Translate these insights into recommendations for GTM leadership, driving accountability, and follow through on agreed actions.
  • AI and Technology Enablement: Act as the President’s connective tissue with Business Systems and IT on the GTM technology roadmap, helping inform where AI and automation could improve GTM productivity, forecasting and customer journey visibility, and championing pilots led by those functions.
  • Performance Metrics: Partner with GTM LT to establish KPIs and metrics that measure the effectiveness of GTM. Report regularly on performance and give the executive team the insight they need to make good decisions.

How You'll Live Our Values in This Role

Nerdio's values don't change by level, but the size of the impact on our culture does. You are expected to operate with broad, org wide scope. In this role, that looks like:

  • Put Our Customers and People First: Build customer and people outcomes into strategy from the start.
  • Move Fast: Set a clear operating rhythm for the GTM organization and remove friction that slows execution. Make timely decisions, create alignment quickly, and help teams move with focus even when information is incomplete.
  • Own It: Own outcomes across the GTM organization, including the parts you don't fully control. Own all tracking and follow-up of actions.
  • Have Fun: Create space for curiosity, craftsmanship, and practical experimentation while keeping the organization focused on outcomes. Model the belief that serious work and a positive team culture can reinforce each other.

Qualifications

  • Availability. You are expected to be available when the President is working and even when he Is not working. This is a role for someone who can make Nerdio their priority.
  • We are open to candidates earlier in their career (typically 5 to 7 years of experience) who demonstrate exceptional rigor, executive presence, and a track record of outperformance in a competitive environment. We value demonstrated potential over having already done every part of this role.
  • Experience engaging directly with senior executives, whether as a Chief of Staff, Business Manager, or similar internal partner, or as an advisor to executive clients or portfolio company leadership (e.g., in consulting or investing) - including managing executive priorities and follow through.
  • Thrives in ambiguity, exercises sound judgment, and adapts quickly to evolving executive and business priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead GTM planning, operating cadence, executive reporting, strategic initiatives, and cross-functional execution at scale.
  • Track record of running disciplined operating rhythms and holding senior leaders accountable to commitments and follow-through.
  • Commercial acumen and the ability to prepare for and advise in customer and partner meetings, synthesizing complex context into a clear point of view.
  • Strong analytical judgment and business acumen, with the ability to turn data into clear insights, recommendations, and executive-level decisions.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders across GTM, Finance, HR, Product, IT, and Revenue Operations.
  • Proven ability to build trust, influence without direct authority, and drive alignment across teams, priorities, and time zones.

Level Calibration

Nerdio will calibrate the role as Director or Sr. Director based on the candidate's depth of experience, scope of prior leadership, executive operating experience, and ability to independently shape GTM strategy and operating systems.

Additional Information

We're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diverse world we serve. At Nerdio, you'll find inclusive teams, flexible thinking, and real opportunities to grow your career, all while making work better for IT professionals everywhere.

If this sounds like a journey you want to be part of, we'd love to meet you.

Benefits and Incentives

  • Competitive Base and Incentive Plan
  • Stock Options
  • Health and Welfare Plans*
  • Life and Disability Plans*
  • Retirement Plan*
  • Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off, including your birthday off!
  • Collaborative Team Culture

* Benefits for international employees, outside the US, vary by country.

Nerdio is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Nerdio is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Bugcrowd helps security teams move faster by identifying the exposures that matter most so they can act first and stay ahead of attackers. By combining the power of humans and AI, teams can preempt attack paths and prevent breaches. Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others. Visit .

This is a seasoned engineer role in which you lead technical efforts across multiple teams or subsystems, owning system architecture and development across the stack. A Senior Software Engineer drives technical innovation, acts as a mentor and process advocate, driving improvements that scale beyond a single team. You will exercise high discretion over technical decisions and influence department-level business outcomes. You will set the architectural direction for the systems you own, make and document the key design tradeoffs, and provide strong leadership within and across scrum teams to deliver on that vision.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Proactively research, prototype, and introduce technologies and system designs for green-field products.

  • Primary IC for green-field product, ensuring long-term code maintainability, readability, and extensibility.
  • Continuously evolve team processes, driving scalable improvements in delivery, quality, and collaboration.

API & Integration

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and secure APIs, UIs and integration services.
  • Implement RESTful, RPC, and event-driven APIs/UIs for internal and external systems.
  • Collaborate with product, data, and platform teams to ensure seamless system interoperability.
  • Manage API lifecycle including versioning, authentication, monitoring, and performance optimization.
  • Develop and maintain integration pipelines between SaaS systems, data sources, and third-party applications.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues, conduct root cause analysis, and implement fixes.
  • Support continuous improvement through automation, observability, and best practices.

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience of software development experience
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript.
  • Extensive experience with React and JavaScript web development frameworks (Next.js preferred)
  • Experience with ORM frameworks and relational databases, including data modeling and provenance tracking patterns (Prisma, Drizzle, PostgreSQL)
  • Experience building long-running, fault-tolerant workflows with durable execution engines (Inngest, Temporal, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience integrating state-of-the-art LLMs into production systems, including agent design, tool use, and evaluation
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns, and experiencing building external API integrations (pub/sub, webhook, ETL, etc.).
  • Excellent debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Experience

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

Carrying and / or lifting - Must be able to carry / move laptop as needed throughout the work day.
Environment - remote, work-from-home 100% of the time with travel to client sites

Pay Range Disclosure

Our compensation philosophy is to foster a collaborative community that rewards, attracts and retains the best possible talent. The provided salary details are based on US national averages and we retain the flexibility to tailor to the needs of the business.

This position may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary bonus program or commission plan, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Culture

  • We regularly hear from both customers and researchers that Bugcrowd feels like a family, and we strive to maintain that internally as well.

At Bugcrowd, we are solving security threats and vulnerabilities that are relevant to everyone, therefore we believe solving these problems takes all kinds of backgrounds. We value the perspectives and experiences people from underrepresented backgrounds bring.

Job Summary

The Institutional Data Analytics + Assessment (IDA+A) office within Purdue University's Office of the Provost is seeking a collaborative and motivated Full Stack Developer to design, develop, and maintain modern web applications and digital solutions that support some of Purdue University's most important academic initiatives.

Working alongside data scientists, analysts, and campus partners, you'll create scalable solutions that support curriculum analytics, faculty annual performance review, institutional assessment, and other strategic initiatives across the University.

This position offers the opportunity to participate in the full software development lifecycle—from gathering requirements and designing solutions to developing, testing, deploying, and enhancing applications. You'll collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver complete solutions from user interface design through backend architecture, cloud deployment, and ongoing support. You'll also gain experience with Microsoft Azure, accessibility standards, enterprise software development, and modern development practices while contributing to projects that have a meaningful impact across Purdue.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, collaborating with others, and building thoughtful software that delivers an exceptional user experience.

This position reports to the Director of Institutional Data Governance. Hybrid and 100% remote work options are available. Purdue University will not sponsor employment authorization for this position.

For full consideration, a cover letter is required for this position.

The anticipated annual salary range for this position is $60,000.00 to $67,000.00. The final salary offer will be determined based on various factors, including internal equity, available budget, and relevant experience.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks two Journeyman Cloud / System Engineers to support enterprise servers, operating systems, virtualization platforms, cloud services, infrastructure appliances, component lifecycle activities, and outage restoration for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks two Journeyman Cloud / System Engineers to support enterprise servers, operating systems, virtualization platforms, cloud services, infrastructure appliances, component lifecycle activities, and outage restoration for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Cloud / System Engineers will provide hands-on technical support for server and operating-system administration, virtualization, appliance integration, cloud connectivity, infrastructure maintenance, technology refreshes, and service restoration. These positions will implement approved configurations, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and support secure and reliable enterprise operations.

The successful candidates will work with the Cloud / System Engineering Lead, network teams, application teams, cybersecurity personnel, service-management teams, Government stakeholders, and vendors to maintain resilient and supportable enterprise services.

These positions are remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area. After-hours work may be required during outages, deployments, upgrades, maintenance windows, and component-refresh activities.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Cloud / System Engineer will:

  • Install, configure, administer, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot enterprise servers and supporting infrastructure.
  • Support Windows Server, Linux, or other approved enterprise operating systems.
  • Configure and maintain physical and virtual servers, operating-system services, enterprise applications, and infrastructure appliances.
  • Administer and support enterprise virtualization platforms, hypervisors, management servers, clusters, hosts, and virtual machines.
  • Monitor server and virtualization availability, performance, utilization, capacity, health, and operational status.
  • Diagnose and resolve operating-system, server, virtualization, appliance, storage, cloud-connectivity, and performance issues.
  • Support integration of infrastructure appliances with network, storage, virtualization, identity, monitoring, logging, backup, and security services.
  • Support cloud operations and integration among cloud, on-premises, continuity, and remote environments.
  • Assist with configuration and troubleshooting of Virtual Private Clouds, DNS, load balancers, API connectivity, certificates, and related cloud services.
  • Implement approved infrastructure configurations, technical changes, security updates, and operational procedures.
  • Apply operating-system updates, vendor patches, firmware upgrades, security patches, and approved configuration changes.
  • Test updates and configuration changes before implementation in production environments when required.
  • Support server, virtualization, software, appliance, and infrastructure-component refreshes.
  • Stage, install, configure, migrate, test, validate, and document replacement components.
  • Support lifecycle planning, inventory validation, configuration management, equipment refresh, and disposition activities.
  • Maintain accurate system, asset, configuration, warranty, licensing, and lifecycle records.
  • Support workload migrations, platform upgrades, hardware replacements, and infrastructure-modernization initiatives.
  • Develop or execute approved implementation plans, migration procedures, test steps, validation criteria, rollback procedures, and outage contingencies.
  • Participate in Outage Response Team activities involving systems, cloud services, virtualization platforms, infrastructure appliances, or supporting components.
  • Support incident diagnosis, mitigation, workarounds, recovery actions, restoration, and service validation.
  • Gather logs, configuration details, monitoring data, timelines, and technical evidence for incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
  • Escalate complex technical issues to senior engineers, vendors, cloud providers, and other support organizations.
  • Track restoration activities, technical dependencies, assigned actions, and corrective measures through completion.
  • Configure and support backup, restoration, replication, high-availability, fault-tolerance, disaster-recovery, and continuity capabilities.
  • Conduct backup and recovery testing to verify that mission-critical systems and data can be restored.
  • Support VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, Site Recovery Manager, NSX, or comparable virtualization technologies.
  • Support infrastructure automation and configuration-management activities using approved tools and scripts.
  • Assist with Infrastructure as Code implementations using Terraform, Ansible, AWS CloudFormation, or comparable technologies.
  • Configure systems and appliances in accordance with applicable DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides and approved security baselines.
  • Support remediation of IAVAs, CND Directives, vulnerabilities, POA&M items, and security-control deficiencies.
  • Collect and maintain evidence supporting RMF, ATO, cybersecurity, audit, and inspection activities.
  • Follow approved incident, problem, change, configuration, release, availability, and service-continuity processes.
  • Maintain system diagrams, configuration records, build documents, operational procedures, field guides, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting documentation.
  • Identify recurring issues, capacity constraints, obsolete components, configuration risks, and modernization opportunities.
  • Recommend improvements that increase system availability, automation, security, scalability, supportability, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 6 years of relevant cloud engineering, systems engineering, systems administration, virtualization, or enterprise infrastructure experience.
  • Current professional certification relevant to systems, cloud, operating systems, virtualization, or enterprise infrastructure engineering.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise systems or cloud infrastructure in a federal or Department of Defense environment.
  • Experience administering Windows Server, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, or comparable enterprise operating systems.
  • Experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, Site Recovery Manager, NSX, VMware Cloud Foundation, or comparable virtualization technologies.
  • Experience supporting Amazon Web Services, AWS GovCloud, Microsoft Azure Government, or another Government-authorized cloud environment.
  • Experience configuring or troubleshooting VPCs, DNS, load balancers, APIs, digital certificates, compute, storage, monitoring, and cloud connectivity.
  • Experience integrating infrastructure appliances with enterprise network, storage, virtualization, identity, monitoring, logging, backup, and security services.
  • Experience performing server, virtualization, appliance, software, and infrastructure-component refreshes.
  • Experience supporting system migrations, platform upgrades, hardware replacements, and modernization activities.
  • Experience supporting outages, service restoration, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking.
  • Experience with high availability, fault tolerance, backups, restoration, replication, disaster recovery, and continuity of operations.
  • Experience using Terraform, Ansible, AWS CloudFormation, PowerShell, Python, Bash, or comparable automation and Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  • Experience applying DISA STIGs and supporting DoD RMF, ATO, IAVA, CND Directive, vulnerability-remediation, and POA&M requirements.
  • Experience maintaining system diagrams, configuration records, build documents, implementation plans, test results, and standard operating procedures.
  • Certifications such as AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator, Red Hat Certified System Administrator, VMware Certified Professional, CompTIA Server+, or equivalent credentials.
  • ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, configuration-management, and team-collaboration skills.
  • Ability to support after-hours outages, deployments, maintenance windows, upgrades, migrations, and component-refresh activities when required.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

jobs.excerpt: Who Are Massive Rocket? Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect.
jobs.description:
Who Are Massive Rocket?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.
Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

We’re looking for an experienced Principal Data Architect to turn complex client requirements into scalable data solutions for global brands. You’ll lead technical discovery, design end-to-end data architectures, and build roadmaps that connect customer data, identity, and marketing technology to measurable business outcomes.

Working closely with client stakeholders and our Data Engineering teams, you’ll provide technical direction, guide architecture decisions, and ensure solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with business goals.

What Will You Do?

  • Lead client discovery workshops to assess existing data platforms, identity frameworks, integrations, and business requirements.
  • Align marketing, data, engineering, and product stakeholders on scope, priorities, and success measures.
  • Design end-to-end data architectures integrating Snowflake, Databricks, mParticle, Hightouch, Braze, and wider MarTech platforms.

  • Plan migrations from marketing, loyalty, and messaging platforms into modern data architectures.
  • Develop technical roadmaps, estimate delivery effort, define project phases, and secure client sign-off before implementation.
  • Evaluate data technologies and tools based on business requirements, scalability, performance, and cost.
  • Guide Data Engineering teams in designing and optimising batch, event-driven, and low-latency data pipelines.
  • Establish best practices for data validation, monitoring, performance optimisation, and governance.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations that demonstrate business value.
  • Mentor engineers and consultants, lead technical reviews, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Support client pitches, technical presentations, workshops, and opportunities to expand existing engagements.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 8+ years of experience in Data Architecture or Solution Architecture, including at least 5 years in technical leadership.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms, with Hightouch experience being a plus.
  • Proven experience integrating cloud data warehouses with MarTech, CRM, customer engagement, and analytics platforms.
  • Strong understanding of identity resolution, customer profiles, and linking anonymous and known customer activity across multiple data sources.
  • Extensive experience in data modelling, reverse ETL, pipeline architecture, data integration, and performance optimisation.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with familiarity with version control, CI/CD, and modern engineering practices.
  • Experience leading discovery workshops and translating business requirements into robust technical architectures.
  • Ability to scope and estimate delivery phases, document technical designs, and secure formal client approval.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or consultants and providing technical direction across multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience in an agency or consulting environment, managing multiple client engagements.
  • Willingness to travel to client locations when required.

Desirable

  • Certifications in Snowflake, data architecture, CDPs, or relevant MarTech platforms.
  • Familiarity with Braze, Amplitude, GA4, and marketing automation within composable CDP or warehouse-native architectures.
  • Understanding of data privacy, security, consent, and regulatory requirements for customer data.
  • Experience developing technical proposals, delivering client presentations, and leading workshops or training sessions.
  • A track record of introducing new technologies or architectural improvements that deliver measurable business outcomes.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else
• A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win
• A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond
• Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best
• Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter
• Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work
Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment
ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)
References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready
For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required

A Quick Note on Applications

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

jobs.title: Sr. Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a Senior Security Engineer to lead and advance the security tooling that tests and validates our software against compliance and cybersecurity standards.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Security Engineer to lead and advance the security tooling that tests and validates our software against compliance and cybersecurity standards. In this role, you will ensure our toolchain is consistently enforced, highly trustworthy, and continuously enhanced as our products, customer base, and regulatory requirements expand. You will also be a key early contributor as we design and implement our application security and security operations functions.

You will be the technical authority for how security checks are configured, tuned, and enforced across our software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will translate compliance and Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements into automated, risk-based controls that give engineers fast, actionable feedback early in development. Your expertise in AI-based automation will be key to success. The goal is a pipeline calibrated to the speed of organizational need: secure by default, automated wherever possible, and supported by clear human review when automation flags risk.

On the other end of the SDLC, you will help implement automated and manual pen-testing and other security-related testing capabilities across a range of deployment environments. You will help develop our security operations capabilities with faster and more automated incident response and incident management. Applying an AI-first approach to these functions will enable faster, more efficient, higher-quality outcomes.

This role supports regulated and security-sensitive environments, including systems hosted for Government customers, and partners closely with engineering, product, and cybersecurity leadership.

Core Responsibilities

    Own and evolve the security toolchain

  • Serve as the technical owner of our pipeline security tooling, including static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), secrets detection, container scanning, and artifact signing

  • Assess tooling effectiveness and coverage, identify gaps, and recommend and lead improvements, consolidation, or replacement as needs evolve

  • Develop automated and manual pen-testing capabilities with rapid feedback loops into the engineering process.

  • Help mature the security operations and incident response capabilities of the company.

  • Define the long-term roadmap for security tooling and processes in partnership with Cybersecurity and Engineering leadership

    • Tune controls to compliance requirements

  • Translate National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, and RMF control requirements into enforceable pipeline gates, thresholds, and policies

  • Evolve and maintain risk-based pass/fail criteria that balance security assurance with delivery speed and minimize false positives

  • Ensure tooling outputs produce assessor-ready evidence that supports authorizations, continuous monitoring, and audits

  • Own the exception and manual-review process for findings that fail automated checks, so decisions are documented and traceable

    • Enforce integrity and consistency

  • Ensure security results cannot be bypassed or tampered with, including enforcement of artifact signing, signature verification before deployment, commit signing, branch protection, and repository rulesets

  • Automate the creation and maintenance of software bills of materials (SBOMs) and vulnerability exploitability exchange (VEX) data for delivered software

    • Drive shift-left adoption

  • Move security checks to the earliest practical point (developer workstation, pre-commit, pull request, etc.)

  • Partner with engineering teams to embed security into their workflows, supported by clear standards and guidance, so the secure path is the easy path

  • Apply artificial intelligence (AI) tooling to accelerate vulnerability triage, remediation, and security automation, and evaluate emerging AI capabilities for the toolchain

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years in DevSecOps, application security, security operations and incident response, and general security engineering, including at least 3 years owning security tooling in continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines

  • Deep hands-on experience configuring, tuning, and enforcing SAST, SCA, secrets detection, and container scanning tools in production pipelines, including risk-based gates, vulnerability thresholds, and exception processes

  • Demonstrated experience mapping security tooling and pipeline controls to NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, or RMF requirements, and producing evidence for assessments or authorizations

  • Track record of evaluating, selecting, or evolving security tooling, and influencing engineering teams without direct authority

  • Scripting or automation experience in Python, Bash, or similar

  • Security+ or equivalent Department of Defense (DoD) 8140 qualifying certification, or ability to obtain within 2 months of hire

  • U.S. citizen residing and working in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with tools such as GitHub, Argo CD, JFrog, and Snyk

  • Experience in DoD software factory or Government DevSecOps environments (for example, Platform One, Iron Bank, or Big Bang)

  • Experience supporting Authorization to Operate (ATO) efforts, including control assessment and Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) management

  • Experience with software supply chain integrity and policy-as-code practices, such as artifact signing, signature verification, SBOMs, Open Policy Agent (OPA), or Kyverno

  • Experience applying AI and large language model (LLM) tools to security engineering, such as AI-assisted triage, code review, or remediation

  • Experience with penetration testing tools, processes, strategies.

  • Familiarity with the cloud and container environments where pipelines run and are deployed (for example, Github, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS)

  • Advanced certifications such as CISSP, SecurityX (CASP+), or GIAC (GSSP, GCSA, or similar)

  • Active security clearance (Top Secret highly desired)

About Istari Digital

    Istari is a digital engineering software company building open, scalable infrastructure for engineering data. Our platform lets customers simply and securely integrate engineering models across disciplines, organizations, and security levels — whether they're designing prototypes, performing virtual testing, or training AI and autonomy for complex systems.

    Focus is rewarded. Finish is remembered.

    Facts are friendly. Even when they are not fun.

    Fellowship is fundamental. Make others successful.
